```tsx
import { RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, RETENTION, type AppealRow, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type RestoreGap, type RestoreView, type SealRelease } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES, MODERATION_MESSAGES, RECOVERY_WORDS, RELEASE_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { AppealsView } from "../src/screens/Appeals";
import { CaseScreenView, releaseParams, type CaseScreenViewProps, type ReleaseProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { CustodyLines } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { RestoreScreen } from "../src/screens/Restore";
import { releaseAction } from "../src/step-up";
import { bothTimes, dateTime } from "../src/ui";
import { decision, frozenCase, NO_STANDING, overview } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The release on the console (3d design, sections 7.2, 8.2, 8.5, 8.7 and 8.8; Task 2), server-rendered: the block
 * "Release" under a seal for good in force, in each state of 8.9's Task 2 row (a recorded leave with the control; the
 * answer illegal without a leave, with [release.assessed] and no control; not_illegal, no_assessment and no answer
 * without it; a leave beside not_illegal with [release.conflict]; more posts than one release names, with [release.more];
 * greyed for a moderator; "The author may be told" in each of its three values; [release.done] once released), the params
 * the key signs, Appeals' [appeals.released], Home's two lines, After a restore's class release without a control, and
 * the words of each code. Every number is printed from the answer or a constant.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;

const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
const SEAL_ACTION = "e1f20314-2536-4849-9ab5-d0e1f2031425";
const SEAL_DECISION = "f2031425-3647-495a-8bc6-e1f203142536";
const POST = "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
const LEAVE = "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa";

/** A release block as the API answers it for a seal reported, assessed illegal, moved, with a leave from a court. */
function block(overrides: Partial<SealRelease> = {}): SealRelease {
  return {
    reported: true,
    theirReference: "ST 12/34",
    answer: "illegal",
    answeredAt: "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z",
    handedOverAt: null,
    quarantined: true,
    preserved: false,
    leave: { id: LEAVE, from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-15", untold: false, untoldUntil: null },
    tellHeld: false,
    postIds: [POST],
    remaining: 0,
    silenceDays: null,
    releasedAt: null,
    basis: null,
    backupsClearAt: null,
    noticeHeld: null,
    releasedPosts: 0,
    releasedImages: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** The frozen case with a seal for good in force whose decision carries this release block. */
function sealedCase(release: SealRelease, custody: CaseDecision["custody"] = { files: 4, moved: 4, movedAt: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z", toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }): CaseView {
  const view = frozenCase();
  return {
    ...view,
    decisions: [
      ...view.decisions,
      decision({
        id: SEAL_DECISION,
        kind: "final",
        ruleId: "R2",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        suspect: true,
        needsAdmin: true,
        actions: [{ id: SEAL_ACTION, kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
        custody,
        release,
      }),
    ],
  };
}
const as = (role: "admin" | "moderator"): ReleaseProps => ({ role, busy: false, error: null, onRelease: noop });
const markup = (view: CaseView, release: ReleaseProps = as("admin")) => html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} release={release} />);
const page = (view: CaseView, release: ReleaseProps = as("admin")) => text(markup(view, release));
const W = RELEASE_WORDS;

describe("the release block (3d design, section 8.5)", () => {
  test("a recorded leave: the facts, the words, the ground and the one control, for an admin", () => {
    const shown = page(sealedCase(block()));
    for (const label of [W.facts.reported.label, W.facts.answer.label, W.facts.leave.label, W.facts.tell.label, W.facts.quarantined.label, W.facts.preserved.label]) expect(shown).toContain(label);
    expect(shown).toContain("4 O 1/26");
    expect(shown).toContain("ST 12/34");
    expect(shown).toContain(W.what);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.tells);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.backups(RETENTION.backupDays));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.periodUnset);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.leave("from a court"));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.sign(1));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.button);
    expect(shown).not.toContain(W.assessed);
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()))).toMatch(/<button type="button"[^>]*>Release and destroy<[/]button>/);
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()))).not.toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled=""[^>]*>Release and destroy/);
    // The references are an outsider's text: drawn in a frame that says whose words they are.
    expect(shown).toContain("As recorded from the authority");
  });

  test("no leave: the answer illegal is [release.assessed] and every other answer, or none, [release.nothing]; neither offers a control", () => {
    const assessed = page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null })));
    expect(assessed).toContain(W.assessed);
    expect(assessed).not.toContain(W.button);
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer: "not_illegal" })))).toContain(W.notIllegal);
    for (const answer of ["no_assessment", "other", null] as const) {
      const shown = page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer, answeredAt: answer === null ? null : "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z" })));
      expect(shown, String(answer)).toContain(W.nothing);
      expect(shown, String(answer)).not.toContain(W.button);
    }
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ leave: null, answer: null, answeredAt: null })))).toContain(`${W.facts.answer.label}${W.facts.answer.none}`);
  });

  test("a leave beside the answer not_illegal: [release.conflict] above the control", () => {
    const shown = page(sealedCase(block({ answer: "not_illegal" })));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.conflict);
    expect(shown).toContain(W.button);
    expect(shown.indexOf(W.conflict)).toBeLessThan(shown.indexOf(W.button));
  });

  test("more posts than one release names: [release.more] with the constant and the count", () => {
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ remaining: 3 })))).toContain(W.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 3));
    expect(W.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 3)).toContain(`the first ${RELEASE_POSTS_MAX} of them`);
  });

  test("greyed for a moderator, with admin_required's words, and the control disabled", () => {
    const shown = page(sealedCase(block()), as("moderator"));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.adminOnly);
    expect(markup(sealedCase(block()), as("moderator"))).toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled=""[^>]*>Release and destroy/);
  });

  test('"The author may be told" in each of its three values', () => {
    expect(page(sealedCase(block()))).toContain(`${W.facts.tell.label}${W.facts.tell.atOnce}`);
    const open = page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...block().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: null } })));
    expect(open).toContain(W.facts.tell.untold(null));
    const until = "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z";
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...block().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: until } })))).toContain(W.facts.tell.untold(bothTimes(until)));
    expect(page(sealedCase(block({ tellHeld: true })))).toContain(W.facts.tell.record);
  });

  test("once released: [release.done] with the files left, the notice's state and the backups' day", () => {
    const released = block({ postIds: [], releasedAt: "2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z", basis: "leave", backupsClearAt: "2026-11-17T10:00:00.000Z", noticeHeld: true, releasedPosts: 1, releasedImages: 2 });
    const shown = page(sealedCase(released, { files: 0, moved: 0, movedAt: null, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 4, lost: 0 }));
    expect(shown).toContain(W.done(bothTimes("2026-10-18T10:00:00.000Z"), 1, 2, 4, true, bothTimes("2026-11-17T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(shown).toContain("held until the person may be told");
    expect(shown).not.toContain(W.button);
  });

  test("the params the key signs are the block's posts, the ground leave and the recorded leave with its reference; the action names the seal", () => {
    expect(releaseParams(block())).toEqual({ postIds: [POST], basis: "leave", leaveId: LEAVE, theirReference: "4 O 1/26" });
    expect(releaseParams(block({ leave: null }))).toBeNull();
    expect(releaseParams(block({ postIds: [] }))).toBeNull();
    expect(releaseAction(SEAL_ACTION, releaseParams(block())!)).toEqual({ action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: SEAL_ACTION }, params: releaseParams(block()) });
  });

  test("no word of the block calls a release a destruction done, and every code a release route answers has the console's words", () => {
    for (const words of [W.what, W.tells, W.leave("from a court"), W.done("x", 1, 1, 1, false, "y")]) expect(words).not.toMatch(/no longer holds|destroyed it/);
    for (const code of ["release_not_open", "release_not_reported", "release_not_quarantined", "release_preserved", "release_no_leave", "release_period_unset", "release_period_running", "release_mismatch"] as const) {
      expect(CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES as readonly string[]).toContain(code);
      expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES[code].length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    }
    expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.release_period_unset).toBe(W.periodUnset);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/recovery-release.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForModeration } from "../../src/auth";
import { restoreImport } from "../../src/cli/restore";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { restoreView } from "../../src/moderation/gaps";
import { releaseNotices } from "../../src/moderation/release";
import { exportLines } from "../../src/staff";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, imagePost, postFrozen, report, restoreForTest, snapshotForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";
import { moveForTest, reportForTest } from "./release-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A sealed post of this file. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * A restore cannot bring a released image back into keeping, and loses none of the release's acts in silence (3d design,
 * sections 6.2, 7.3 and 8.7; 12.1 row 17; LAB D2 to D4 on the built code). Before the backup: two seals for good,
 * reported and moved; a leave for the first, and a leave for the second that is later withdrawn. Then, lost with the
 * restore: the release of the first; a new leave for the second and its release; the withdrawal; and a leave recorded
 * and withdrawn within the lost work. After restoreForTest and restore-import: one gap of the class release for each
 * release, for the lost leave and for the lost withdrawal, none for the leave recorded and withdrawn after the backup;
 * the app's site stays closed. release-replay marks the posts and erases their rows, a seal still standing freezes
 * nothing (D4), and a second run finds them present; the replay of the release whose leave is lost is born held and is
 * told in the dispatch round after release-leave --gap records the leave again under its id; release-leave --withdraw
 * --gap closes the last gap; the list prints the released files to destroy. The file restores the database it found.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: a restore and the replay of releases (3d Task 2)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let found: string;
  let appOrigin: string;
  let head: { seq: number; hash: string };
  let backup: string;
  let tail: string[] = [];
  let first: Sealed;
  let second: Sealed;
  let firstRelease: string;
  let secondRelease: string;
  let lostLeave: string;
  let withdrawnLeave: string;
  const mails: string[] = [];
  const auth = new Proxy({} as AuthForModeration, {
    get: (_target, member) => {
      if (typeof member !== "string" || member === "then") return undefined;
      if (member === "mailAccount") return async (_userId: string, message: { template: string }) => (mails.push(message.template), "sent");
      if (member === "mailStaff") return async () => 1;
      if (member === "overdueContacts") return async () => 0;
      return async () => undefined;
    },
  });

  const readHead = async () => {
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ seq: string; hash: string }>(sql`select seq::text as seq, hash from public.audit_head where id = 1`);
    return { seq: Number(row!.seq), hash: row!.hash };
  };
  const cli = async (args: string[], input = "") => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input, "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(LF) };
  };
  const leaveOf = (text: string) => /leave ([0-9a-f-]{36}) recorded/.exec(text)![1]!;
  async function sealed(): Promise<Sealed> {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 2);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return { ...p, caseId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(migrateDb, outcome.decisionId) };
  }
  async function release(seal: Sealed, leaveId: string, reference: string): Promise<string> {
    const params = { postIds: [seal.postId], basis: "leave" as const, leaveId, theirReference: reference };
    const confirmed = await world.confirmAction(admin, { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: seal.sealActionId }, params });
    const outcome = await world.moderation.forStaff.release(admin.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    await world.moderation.settle();
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the release was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return outcome.releaseId;
  }
  const releases = async (postId: string) =>
    migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; replay_of: string | null; author_notice: string; leave_id: string | null }>(
      sql`select id, replay_of, author_notice, leave_id from public.releases where ${postId}::uuid = any(post_ids) order by released_at, id`,
    );
  const erased = async (postId: string) => (await migrateDb.execute<{ erased: boolean }>(sql`select erased_at is not null as erased from public.post_media where post_id = ${postId}::uuid`)).map((row) => row.erased);
  const openGaps = async () =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; action: string; leave: string | null; release: string | null }>(
      sql`select id, action, metadata ->> 'leaveId' as leave, metadata ->> 'releaseId' as release from public.restore_gaps where class = 'release' and closed_at is null order by place`,
    )).map((row) => ({ ...row }));

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    appOrigin = config.APP_ORIGIN;
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    found = await snapshotForTest(migrateDb);
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb, { auth });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    // Before the backup.
    first = await sealed();
    second = await sealed();
    for (const seal of [first, second]) {
      await reportForTest(migrateDb, seal.sealActionId, { answer: "illegal" });
      await moveForTest(migrateDb, seal.mediaIds);
    }
    const firstLeave = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", first.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "1 A 1/26", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    withdrawnLeave = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "authority", "--reference", "WRONG 2", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, metadata) select '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, 'filler', jsonb_build_object('n', n) from generate_series(1, 5) n`);
    head = await readHead();
    backup = await snapshotForTest(migrateDb);
    // The lost work.
    firstRelease = await release(first, firstLeave, "1 A 1/26");
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", withdrawnLeave, "--operator", "op"])).code).toBe(0);
    lostLeave = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "2 B 2/26", "--day", "2026-10-03", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    secondRelease = await release(second, lostLeave, "2 B 2/26");
    const passing = leaveOf((await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "PASSING", "--day", "2026-10-03", "--operator", "op"])).text);
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", passing, "--operator", "op"])).code).toBe(0);
    const through = (await readHead()).seq;
    for await (const line of exportLines(apiDb, head.seq - 3, through)) tail.push(JSON.stringify(line));
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, found);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("restore-import: a gap of the class release for each release, the lost leave and the lost withdrawal; none for a leave recorded and withdrawn after the backup; the site stays closed", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, backup);
    expect(await readHead()).toEqual(head);
    expect(await releases(first.postId)).toEqual([]);
    const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, [], Buffer.from(tail.map((line) => line + LF).join(""), "utf8"), appOrigin);
    expect(done.ok).toBe(true);
    const gaps = await openGaps();
    expect(gaps.map((gap) => [gap.action, gap.release ?? gap.leave])).toEqual([
      ["seal_released", firstRelease],
      ["release_leave_withdrawn", withdrawnLeave],
      ["release_leave_recorded", lostLeave],
      ["seal_released", secondRelease],
    ]);
    const view = await restoreView({ apiDb });
    expect(view.mayOpen).toBe(false);
    expect(view.retentionMay).toBe(true);
    // Before the replay the restored database counts the images as sealed and kept.
    expect(await erased(first.postId)).toEqual([false, false]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, first.postId)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("release-replay: the posts marked, the rows erased, the gaps closed; a seal that stands freezes nothing; a second run finds them present; a line no gap names is refused", async () => {
    const replayed = await cli(["release-replay"], tail.join(LF));
    expect(replayed.lines[0]).toBe("out release-replay: 2 releases and 0 ends of a hold in the copy; 0 already present.");
    expect(replayed.lines).toContain(`out release-replay: release ${firstRelease} of ${(JSON.parse(tail.find((line) => line.includes(firstRelease) && line.includes("seal_released"))!) as { at: string }).at}: 1 posts marked released, 2 image rows erased.`);
    expect(replayed.lines.at(-1)).toMatch(/^out release-replay: run the Quarantine steps now, with an inventory first/);
    expect(await erased(first.postId)).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, first.postId)).toBe(false);
    const [replay] = await releases(first.postId);
    expect(replay).toMatchObject({ replay_of: firstRelease, author_notice: "none" });
    // The second release rests on a leave the restore lost: its replay is held until the leave is recorded again.
    const [heldReplay] = await releases(second.postId);
    expect(heldReplay).toMatchObject({ replay_of: secondRelease, author_notice: "held", leave_id: lostLeave });
    expect((await openGaps()).map((gap) => gap.action)).toEqual(["release_leave_withdrawn", "release_leave_recorded"]);
    const again = await cli(["release-replay"], tail.join(LF));
    expect(again.lines[0]).toBe("out release-replay: 2 releases and 0 ends of a hold in the copy; 2 already present.");
    expect(again.code).toBe(0);
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ target_type: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where action = 'release_replayed' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`);
    expect(audit).toMatchObject({ target_type: "release", metadata: { replayOf: secondRelease, posts: 1, images: 2, upload: false } });
    // A line that no open gap names is refused, and nothing changes for it.
    const forged = JSON.parse(tail.find((line) => line.includes("seal_released"))!) as { metadata: string };
    forged.metadata = JSON.stringify({ ...(JSON.parse(forged.metadata) as Record<string, unknown>), releaseId: randomUUID() });
    const refused = await cli(["release-replay"], JSON.stringify(forged));
    expect(refused.code).toBe(1);
    expect(refused.text).toMatch(/replay_no_gap/);
  });

  test("release-leave --gap records the lost leave again under its id; the held replay is told in the next dispatch round; --withdraw --gap closes the last gap and the site may open", async () => {
    const gaps = await openGaps();
    const leaveGap = gaps.find((gap) => gap.action === "release_leave_recorded")!;
    const again = await cli(["release-leave", second.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "2 B 2/26", "--day", "2026-10-03", "--operator", "op", "--gap", leaveGap.id]);
    expect(again.code).toBe(0);
    expect(again.lines).toEqual([
      `out release-leave: leave ${lostLeave} recorded for seal ${second.sealActionId}, on the record of its report: from court, reference 2 B 2/26, of 2026-10-03; the person may be told. An admin can now release it on the case.`,
      `out release-leave: gap ${leaveGap.id} is closed: the leave is recorded again.`,
    ]);
    const due = new Date(Date.now() + 60_000);
    // The two releases of the lost work mailed their notices at once; the replay of the second is told once more now.
    const sentBefore = mails.length;
    expect(await releaseNotices({ ...world.moderation.deps, auth }, new Date(), due, () => undefined)).toBe(1);
    expect((await releases(second.postId))[0]!.author_notice).toBe("sent");
    expect(mails.slice(sentBefore)).toEqual(["release_notice"]);
    const withdrawGap = (await openGaps()).find((gap) => gap.action === "release_leave_withdrawn")!;
    const withdrawn = await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", withdrawnLeave, "--operator", "op", "--gap", withdrawGap.id]);
    expect(withdrawn.code).toBe(0);
    expect(await openGaps()).toEqual([]);
    expect((await restoreView({ apiDb })).mayOpen).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the list after the replay prints the released files under destroy, and the record of a destroy line names the replay", async () => {
    const listed = await cli(["quarantine-list"]);
    for (const seal of [first, second]) for (const mediaId of seal.mediaIds) for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) expect(listed.lines).toContain(`out destroy ${mediaId} ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)}`);
    const receipt = first.mediaIds.flatMap((mediaId) => MEDIA_SIZES.map((size) => `destroy ${mediaId} ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)} 1234 ${"b".repeat(64)} store`)).join(LF);
    expect((await cli(["quarantine-record"], receipt)).code).toBe(0);
    const [replay] = await releases(first.postId);
    const named = await migrateDb.execute<{ release_id: string }>(sql`select release_id from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${`{${first.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    expect(named.map((row) => row.release_id)).toEqual([replay!.id, replay!.id, replay!.id, replay!.id]);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/release-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { MEDIA_SIZES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * 3d Task 2: fixtures of the release (3d design, sections 6.2, 7.2 and 12). 3f's records of a report, the quarantine's
 * rows and the leaves are the migrator's alone, so every write and read here is made as the migrator. The release itself
 * is never written here: it is the API's seal_release, under an admin's key, or the command line's replay.
 */

/** The release's four tables, which a suite counts before and after. */
export const RELEASE_TABLES = ["public.releases", "public.release_posts", "public.release_leaves", "public.release_notices"] as const;

/** How many rows each of the release's tables holds, as the migrator (release_leaves is closed to the API role). */
export async function releaseCounts(q: Db | DbTx): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const table of RELEASE_TABLES) counts[table] = (await q.execute<{ n: number }>(sql.raw(`select count(*)::int as n from ${table}`)))[0]!.n;
  return counts;
}

/** A leave or an instruction to destroy, as release-leave records it. */
export interface LeaveInput {
  from: "authority" | "court";
  reference?: string;
  receivedOn?: string;
  untold?: boolean;
  untoldUntil?: string | null;
}

/** What reportForTest wrote: the seal's record of a report, and the leave when one was asked for. */
export interface ReportedForTest {
  notificationId: string;
  leaveId: string | null;
}

/** The seal's record of a report, as seal_report finds it (seal_record), or null. */
export async function sealRecord(q: Db | DbTx, sealActionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ id: string | null }>(sql`select public.seal_record(${sealActionId}::uuid) as id`);
  return row?.id ?? null;
}

/** A leave recorded against a record, as release-leave records it (the row only; the command writes its audit row too). */
export async function leaveForTest(q: Db | DbTx, notificationId: string, leave: LeaveInput): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    insert into public.release_leaves (notification_id, leave_from, reference, received_on, untold, untold_until, recorded_by)
    values (${notificationId}::uuid, ${leave.from}, ${leave.reference ?? "AZ 1/26"}, ${leave.receivedOn ?? "2026-10-01"}::date,
            ${leave.untold ?? false}, ${leave.untoldUntil ?? null}::timestamptz, 'the operator')
    returning id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/**
 * The fixture of 3d's section 12, `reportForTest(action, { answer, handedOver, leave })` (Task 2): as the migrator, the
 * seal's record of a report is written sent, as notification-sent leaves it, and answered, as notification-answer does,
 * when an answer is given; with `handedOver` a production of the seal's files is recorded as delivered, as the
 * hand-over's record writes one; with `leave`, the leave to destroy as release-leave records it.
 */
export async function reportForTest(
  q: Db | DbTx,
  sealActionId: string,
  options: { answer?: "not_illegal" | "illegal" | "no_assessment" | "other" | null; handedOver?: boolean; leave?: LeaveInput | null } = {},
): Promise<ReportedForTest> {
  const notificationId = await sealRecord(q, sealActionId);
  if (notificationId === null) throw new Error("the seal opened no record of a report");
  await q.execute(sql`
    update public.authority_notifications
       set state = 'sent', sent_at = coalesce(sent_at, now()), authority = 'A test authority', channel = 'portal', sent_kinds = array['files'],
           duties = case when cardinality(duties) = 0 then array['dsa18_1'] else duties end, not_kept_version = 1, closed_at = coalesce(closed_at, now())
     where id = ${notificationId}::uuid and state <> 'sent'`);
  if (options.answer !== undefined && options.answer !== null) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set answer = ${options.answer}, answered_at = now(), their_reference = 'ST 12/34' where id = ${notificationId}::uuid`);
  }
  if (options.handedOver) {
    await q.execute(sql`
      insert into public.productions (instrument, notification_id, seal_action_id, account_id, produced, files, delivered_at, recorded_by)
      select 'notification', n.id, ${sealActionId}::uuid, n.account_id, array['files'], '[]'::jsonb, now(), 'the operator'
        from public.authority_notifications n where n.id = ${notificationId}::uuid`);
  }
  const leaveId = options.leave ? await leaveForTest(q, notificationId, options.leave) : null;
  return { notificationId, leaveId };
}

/** Both files of each image recorded as moved into the quarantine, as quarantine-record writes an `in` line. */
export async function moveForTest(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  for (const mediaId of mediaIds) {
    for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
      await q.execute(sql`
        insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256)
        values (${mediaId}::uuid, ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)}, 1234, ${"b".repeat(64)})
        on conflict do nothing`);
    }
  }
}

/** A seal's releases and its posts' marks, newest first, as the migrator reads them. */
export async function releasesOf(q: Db | DbTx, sealActionId: string): Promise<{ id: string; post_ids: string[]; basis: string; leave_id: string | null; author_notice: string; backups_clear_at: string }[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string; post_ids: string[]; basis: string; leave_id: string | null; author_notice: string; backups_clear_at: string }>(sql`
    select r.id, r.post_ids::text[] as post_ids, r.basis, r.leave_id, r.author_notice, r.backups_clear_at::text
      from public.releases r where r.seal_action_id = ${sealActionId}::uuid order by r.released_at desc, r.id`);
  return found.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, the releases that name these posts with their marks and the replays of them, the leaves and
 * the day's notices of these seals' records, and the quarantine's rows of these images. The release's tables are kept
 * for good in production; only a suite's own cleanup deletes them.
 */
export async function removeReleases(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, posts: readonly string[], sealActionIds: readonly string[], mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) or post_id = any(${uuids(posts)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.release_posts where post_id = any(${uuids(posts)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.releases where post_ids && ${uuids(posts)} or seal_action_id = any(${uuids(sealActionIds)})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`
    delete from public.release_leaves l
     where l.notification_id in (select n.id from public.authority_notifications n where n.seal_action_id = any(${uuids(sealActionIds)}))`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.release_notices where subject_id = any(${uuids(sealActionIds)})`);
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/release-flow.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES, RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, type SealReleasedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForModeration } from "../../src/auth";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation";
import { appealsList } from "../../src/moderation/appeals";
import { overview } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { authorNotices, authorRelease, releaseNotices } from "../../src/moderation/release";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, appealOf, imagePost, removeDecided, removeFixtures, report } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, removeRecords, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";
import { moveForTest, releaseCounts, releasesOf, removeReleases, reportForTest, sealRecord } from "./release-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A sealed post of this file: its author, its images, its case, the sealing decision and its seal's ledger row. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  decisionId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * The release as an admin takes it (3d design, sections 7.2, 7.14, 8.10 and 9.6; 12.1 rows 16 and 18), through the
 * moderation module's own function under real staff keys: the leave recorded by staff.js release-leave, the case answer's
 * release block, the release and its confirmed audit row, the alert seal_released to every staff account, the author's
 * notice at once, or born held while the leave is not to be told and sent by the dispatch round that finds the hold
 * ended, the author's two reads, Home's list and the appeal's mark, the withdrawal of a leave a release rests on refused,
 * release-show, and the destroy line's record taking the release's id. Every mail goes to a recording auth interface.
 * The last test removes what the file made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the release, as an admin takes it (3d Task 2)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let startedAt: string;
  let releasesBefore: Record<string, number>;
  /** At once: reported, moved, a leave from a court. Held: the same with the leave not to be told. */
  let atOnce: Sealed;
  let held: Sealed;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const accountMails: { userId: string; template: string }[] = [];
  const staffMails: string[] = [];

  /** The auth module's interface as moderation calls it, recording every mail and taking each. */
  const auth = new Proxy({} as AuthForModeration, {
    get: (_target, member) => {
      if (typeof member !== "string" || member === "then") return undefined;
      if (member === "mailAccount") return async (userId: string, message: { template: string }) => (accountMails.push({ userId, template: message.template }), "sent");
      if (member === "mailStaff") return async (message: { template: string }) => (staffMails.push(message.template), 1);
      if (member === "overdueContacts") return async () => 0;
      return async () => undefined;
    },
  });

  const cli = async (args: string[], input = "") => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! }, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input, "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(LF) };
  };

  async function sealed(): Promise<Sealed> {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 2);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return { ...p, caseId, decisionId: outcome.decisionId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(migrateDb, outcome.decisionId) };
  }

  /** The release block of the seal's decision, as the console reads the case. */
  const blockOf = async (member: RealStaff, seal: Sealed) => {
    const view = await world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(member.session, seal.caseId);
    return view.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === seal.decisionId)!;
  };
  /** The release, under the member's real key, with the params the block shows, through the module's own function. */
  async function release(member: RealStaff, seal: Sealed, params?: SealReleasedParams) {
    const block = (await blockOf(member, seal)).release!;
    const signed: SealReleasedParams = params ?? { postIds: block.postIds, basis: "leave", leaveId: block.leave!.id, theirReference: block.leave!.reference };
    const confirmed = await world.confirmAction(member, { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: seal.sealActionId }, params: signed });
    try {
      const outcome = await world.moderation.forStaff.release(member.session, confirmed, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
      await world.moderation.settle();
      return outcome;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ModerationError) return err.code;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const dispatchDeps = () => ({ ...world.moderation.deps, auth });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    startedAt = (await migrateDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;
    releasesBefore = await releaseCounts(migrateDb);
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb, { auth });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    atOnce = await sealed();
    held = await sealed();
    for (const seal of [atOnce, held]) {
      await reportForTest(migrateDb, seal.sealActionId, { answer: "illegal" });
      await moveForTest(migrateDb, seal.mediaIds);
    }
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz`);
    await removeReleases(migrateDb, posts, [atOnce.sealActionId, held.sealActionId], [...atOnce.mediaIds, ...held.mediaIds]);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id, moderator.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id, moderator.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  test("release-leave records a leave from the paper, with its audit row, and refuses what it cannot record", async () => {
    for (const command of ["release-leave", "release-show", "release-replay"]) expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
    const unsealed = await cli(["release-leave", randomUUID(), "--by", "court", "--reference", "4 O 1/26", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "the operator"]);
    expect(unsealed.text).toMatch(/^err release-leave: [0-9a-f-]{36} is not the ledger row of a seal for good in force; nothing changed$/);
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", atOnce.sealActionId, "--by", "police", "--reference", "x", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "op"])).text).toBe("err release-leave: --by is authority or court; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", atOnce.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "x", "--day", "2999-01-01", "--operator", "op"])).text).toBe(
      "err release-leave: --day 2999-01-01 is after today: a leave bears the day it was given; nothing changed",
    );
    expect((await cli(["release-leave", atOnce.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "x", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "op", "--until", "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"])).text).toBe(
      "err release-leave: --until is given only with --untold, or with --end-untold; nothing changed",
    );
    const recorded = await cli(["release-leave", atOnce.sealActionId, "--by", "court", "--reference", "4 O 1/26", "--day", "2026-10-01", "--operator", "the operator"]);
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(0);
    const id = /leave ([0-9a-f-]{36}) recorded/.exec(recorded.text)![1]!;
    expect(recorded.lines).toEqual([
      `out release-leave: leave ${id} recorded for seal ${atOnce.sealActionId}, on the record of its report: from court, reference 4 O 1/26, of 2026-10-01; the person may be told. An admin can now release it on the case.`,
    ]);
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string; target_id: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from public.audit_log where action = 'release_leave_recorded' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect({ ...audit }).toEqual({
      action: "release_leave_recorded",
      actor_id: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
      target_type: "notification",
      target_id: await sealRecord(migrateDb, atOnce.sealActionId),
      metadata: { leaveId: id, from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-01", untold: false, untoldUntil: null },
    });
    // The second seal's leave is not to be told, with an open end.
    const untold = await cli(["release-leave", held.sealActionId, "--by", "authority", "--reference", "AZ 7/26", "--day", "2026-10-02", "--operator", "the operator", "--untold"]);
    expect(untold.text).toMatch(/the person is not to be told, with no end recorded[.] An admin can now release it on the case[.]$/);
  });

  test("the case answer's release block: the facts, the posts the key names, no period; a moderator is refused admin_required", async () => {
    const decision = await blockOf(admin, atOnce);
    expect(decision.release).toMatchObject({ reported: true, answer: "illegal", quarantined: true, preserved: false, tellHeld: false, postIds: [atOnce.postId], remaining: 0, silenceDays: null, releasedAt: null });
    expect(decision.release!.leave).toMatchObject({ from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-01", untold: false, untoldUntil: null });
    expect((await blockOf(admin, held)).release).toMatchObject({ tellHeld: true, leave: { untold: true, untoldUntil: null } });
    expect(await release(moderator, atOnce)).toBe("admin_required");
    expect(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX).toBe(1000);
  });

  test("a release under an admin's key: the record, its confirmed audit row, the alert to every staff account, and the notice at once", async () => {
    const outcome = await release(admin, atOnce);
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ caseId: atOnce.caseId });
    const releaseId = (outcome as { releaseId: string }).releaseId;
    const [row] = await releasesOf(migrateDb, atOnce.sealActionId);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ id: releaseId, post_ids: [atOnce.postId], basis: "leave", author_notice: "sent" });
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ actor_id: string; target_type: string; target_id: string; step_up: unknown; metadata: { params: Record<string, unknown>; releaseId: string } }>(
      sql`select actor_id, target_type, target_id, step_up, metadata from public.audit_log where action = 'seal_released' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect([audit!.actor_id, audit!.target_type, audit!.target_id, audit!.step_up !== null, audit!.metadata.releaseId]).toEqual([admin.id, "seal", atOnce.sealActionId, true, releaseId]);
    expect(audit!.metadata.params).toMatchObject({ postIds: [atOnce.postId], basis: "leave", theirReference: "4 O 1/26" });
    // Every staff account is alerted, without a throttle: one row of the outbox, its mail claimed.
    const alerts = await migrateDb.execute<{ facts: Record<string, unknown>; mailed: boolean }>(
      sql`select facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'seal_released' and created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz`,
    );
    expect(alerts.map((a) => [a.facts.posts, a.facts.uploads, a.mailed])).toEqual([[1, 0, true]]);
    expect(staffMails).toContain("seal_released");
    expect(accountMails.filter((mail) => mail.template === "release_notice")).toEqual([{ userId: atOnce.authorId, template: "release_notice" }]);
    // The answer: the block reads released, the custody its files left; Home lists the release; the author reads it.
    const decision = await blockOf(admin, atOnce);
    expect(decision.release).toMatchObject({ postIds: [], releasedAt: expect.any(String), basis: "leave", noticeHeld: false, releasedPosts: 1, releasedImages: 2 });
    expect(decision.custody).toMatchObject({ files: 0, filesLeft: 4 });
    const home = await overview(world.moderation.deps, admin.session);
    expect(home.destructive.find((entry) => entry.caseId === atOnce.caseId)).toMatchObject({ kind: "seal_released", refusalId: null });
    expect(home.quarantine.undestroyed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    const notices = await authorNotices(world.moderation.deps, atOnce.authorId);
    expect(notices.notices.map((notice) => notice.id)).toContain(releaseId);
    const view = await authorRelease(world.moderation.deps, atOnce.authorId, releaseId);
    expect(view).toMatchObject({ id: releaseId, basis: "leave", upload: false, postCount: 1, images: 2, sealDecisionId: atOnce.decisionId, posts: [{ id: atOnce.postId }] });
    // Nobody else reads it, and its id names nothing to a stranger.
    await expect(authorRelease(world.moderation.deps, held.authorId, releaseId)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "not_found" });
    // A second release of the seal finds every post released; the leave it rests on cannot be withdrawn.
    expect(await release(admin, atOnce, { postIds: [atOnce.postId], basis: "leave", leaveId: decision.release!.leave!.id, theirReference: "4 O 1/26" })).toBe("release_not_open");
    const withdraw = await cli(["release-leave", "--withdraw", decision.release!.leave!.id, "--operator", "the operator"]);
    expect(withdraw.text).toBe(`err release-leave: leave_used: a release already rests on leave ${decision.release!.leave!.id}; nothing changed`);
  });

  test("a waiting appeal of a released seal stays open and is marked with the release", async () => {
    await appealOf(apiDb, atOnce.decisionId, atOnce.authorId);
    const page = await appealsList(world.moderation.deps, admin.session);
    const row = page.appeals.find((appeal) => appeal.decisionId === atOnce.decisionId);
    expect(row?.released).toMatchObject({ basis: "leave", at: expect.any(String) });
  });

  test("a release on a leave not to be told is born held: no mail, no list, no read; the dispatch round after the hold ends sends it once", async () => {
    const before = accountMails.length;
    const outcome = await release(admin, held);
    const releaseId = (outcome as { releaseId: string }).releaseId;
    expect((await releasesOf(migrateDb, held.sealActionId))[0]).toMatchObject({ id: releaseId, author_notice: "held" });
    expect(accountMails.length).toBe(before);
    expect((await authorNotices(world.moderation.deps, held.authorId)).notices).toEqual([]);
    await expect(authorRelease(world.moderation.deps, held.authorId, releaseId)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "not_found" });
    const due = new Date(Date.now() + 60_000);
    expect(await releaseNotices(dispatchDeps(), new Date(), due, () => undefined)).toBe(0);
    expect((await releasesOf(migrateDb, held.sealActionId))[0]!.author_notice).toBe("held");
    // The operator ends the hold on telling with the command; the next round moves the notice and sends it, once.
    const leaveId = (await blockOf(admin, held)).release!.leave!.id;
    const ended = await cli(["release-leave", "--end-untold", leaveId, "--until", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString()]);
    expect(ended.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`^out release-leave: leave ${leaveId}: the person may be told from [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$`));
    expect(await releaseNotices(dispatchDeps(), new Date(), due, () => undefined)).toBe(1);
    expect((await releasesOf(migrateDb, held.sealActionId))[0]!.author_notice).toBe("sent");
    expect(accountMails.slice(before)).toEqual([{ userId: held.authorId, template: "release_notice" }]);
    expect(await releaseNotices(dispatchDeps(), new Date(), due, () => undefined)).toBe(0);
    expect((await authorNotices(world.moderation.deps, held.authorId)).notices.map((notice) => notice.id)).toEqual([releaseId]);
  });

  test("release-show prints the record; a destroy line's record takes the release's id, and release-show counts it", async () => {
    const [row] = await releasesOf(migrateDb, atOnce.sealActionId);
    const listed = await cli(["quarantine-list"]);
    for (const mediaId of atOnce.mediaIds) for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) expect(listed.lines).toContain(`out destroy ${mediaId} ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)}`);
    const receipt = atOnce.mediaIds.flatMap((mediaId) => MEDIA_SIZES.map((size) => `destroy ${mediaId} ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)} 1234 ${"b".repeat(64)} quarantine`)).join(LF);
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], receipt);
    expect(recorded.lines[0]).toMatch(/^out quarantine-record: 0 files recorded as moved, 0 as returned, 4 as destroyed, 0 as lost, 0 found without a record[.]/);
    const withIds = await migrateDb.execute<{ release_id: string }>(sql`select release_id from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${`{${atOnce.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    expect(withIds.map((r) => r.release_id)).toEqual([row!.id, row!.id, row!.id, row!.id]);
    const shown = await cli(["release-show", row!.id]);
    expect(shown.code).toBe(0);
    expect(shown.lines[0]).toMatch(new RegExp(`^out release-show: release ${row!.id}: ground leave, leave or instruction from court, reference 4 O 1/26, of 2026-10-01, released [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$`));
    expect(shown.lines[1]).toBe("out release-show: posts 1; image rows erased 2; files destroyed 4 of 4, lost 0.");
    expect(shown.lines.filter((line) => /^out release-show: files[/][0-9a-f]{2}[/]/.test(line))).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(shown.lines.at(-2)).toMatch(/^out release-show: no backup that is deleted on time holds these files after [0-9T:.Z-]+; a backup kept for an authority is destroyed by hand[.]$/);
    expect(shown.lines.at(-1)).toMatch(/^out release-show: author's notice: sent [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$/);
    // It prints no answer of an authority: the record copies none.
    expect(shown.text).not.toMatch(/illegal|assess/);
    expect((await cli(["release-show", randomUUID()])).text).toMatch(/^err release-show: no release has the id [0-9a-f-]{36}; nothing changed$/);
  });

  test("this file left nothing behind but its audit rows", async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where created_at >= ${startedAt}::timestamptz`);
    await removeReleases(migrateDb, posts, [atOnce.sealActionId, held.sealActionId], [...atOnce.mediaIds, ...held.mediaIds]);
    expect(await releaseCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(releasesBefore);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/release-ledger.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { RELEASE_BASES, RELEASE_LEAVE_FROM, RELEASE_NOTICE_STATES, RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, RELEASE_RULES, RETENTION, type SealReleasedParams } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { appendConfirmedAudit } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../../src/staff";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, act, hex64, imagePost, newTestStaff, postFrozen, raised, removeDecided, removeFixtures, report, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { orderForTest, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING, removeRecords, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";
import { leaveForTest, moveForTest, releaseCounts, removeReleases, reportForTest, sealRecord } from "./release-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/** A sealed post of this file: its author, its images, its case, the sealing decision and its seal's ledger row. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  decisionId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * The release on the database (3d design, sections 6.2, 6.9, 7.2 and 12.1 rows 16 and 18; LAB D1 as tests on the built
 * code, with 3f's real seal_report): seal_release's refusals in its order (release_not_open, release_not_reported,
 * release_not_quarantined, release_preserved, release_no_leave whatever the authority's answer, release_period_unset,
 * admin_required), the leave that passes it, releases_confirmed at commit (release_mismatch), what a release writes and
 * what it never writes, the end of the freeze through the seal and a new freeze through a new item, the leave's guard and
 * its withdrawal, the three holds on telling, the grants, the closed lists and the mirror of release_rules(). The seals
 * commit with real keys and the records, moves and leaves as the migrator; every release here is made in a transaction
 * that is rolled back, with a made-up confirmation of a placeholder key, its commit check run in a savepoint (`set
 * constraints ... immediate`). The release that commits under a real key is release-flow.test.ts's.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the release on the database (3d Task 2)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let releasesBefore: Record<string, number>;
  let startedAt: string;
  /** Placeholder keys: an audit row they confirm is only ever written in a transaction that is rolled back. */
  let staffAdmin: TestStaff;
  let otherAdmin: TestStaff;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  /** Sealed for good, two images: the file's main seal. Sealed while deciding. Sealed for good over a post with an erased image row. */
  let good: Sealed;
  let deciding: Sealed;
  let erasedOne: Sealed;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const allMedia = () => [...good.mediaIds, ...deciding.mediaIds, ...erasedOne.mediaIds];
  const allSeals = () => [good.sealActionId, deciding.sealActionId, erasedOne.sealActionId];

  /** A post with images, reported on the path for child sexual abuse material, and sealed by the admin's real key. */
  async function sealed(images: number, how: "final" | "deciding", beforeSeal?: (p: { postId: string; mediaIds: string[] }) => Promise<void>): Promise<Sealed> {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    if (beforeSeal) await beforeSeal(p);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, how === "final" ? SEAL_FOR_GOOD : SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return { ...p, caseId, decisionId: outcome.decisionId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(migrateDb, outcome.decisionId) };
  }

  /** The params a console would sign for a release of this seal on this leave: its lowest unreleased posts, the leave and its reference. */
  const params = (seal: Sealed, leaveId: string | null, reference: string | null = "AZ 1/26", basis: SealReleasedParams["basis"] = "leave"): SealReleasedParams => ({
    postIds: [seal.postId],
    basis,
    leaveId,
    theirReference: reference,
  });

  /** How a test's release writes its audit row: confirmed (the default), none, a plain row, another admin's, other params or another target. */
  interface How {
    audit?: "confirmed" | "none" | "plain";
    auditBy?: TestStaff;
    auditParams?: Record<string, unknown>;
    auditTarget?: string;
    /** Run inside the savepoint after the release and its commit check, as the API's role, with the release's id. */
    then?: (tx: DbTx, releaseId: string) => Promise<void>;
  }

  /**
   * One release in a transaction that is rolled back, as the API's role, as the release's route writes it: seal_release
   * with the given basis and leave by `staff`, then the audit row (as `how` says), then releases_confirmed made to run at
   * once. Answers "ok" or the code the database raised.
   */
  async function tryRelease(staff: TestStaff, action: string, p: SealReleasedParams | (Omit<SealReleasedParams, "basis"> & { basis: string }), how: How = {}): Promise<string> {
    let outcome = "ok";
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      try {
        await tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
          const [row] = await sp.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select public.seal_release(${action}::uuid, ${p.basis}, ${p.leaveId}::uuid, ${staff.id}::uuid) as id`);
          const releaseId = row!.id;
          const by = how.auditBy ?? staff;
          const metadata = { params: how.auditParams ?? p, releaseId };
          if (how.audit === "plain") {
            await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: by.id, action: "seal_released", targetType: "seal", targetId: how.auditTarget ?? action, requestId: null, metadata });
          } else if (how.audit !== "none") {
            await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, {
              actorId: by.id,
              keyId: by.keyId,
              action: "seal_released",
              targetType: "seal",
              targetId: how.auditTarget ?? action,
              metadata,
              staffSession: randomUUID(),
              actionHash: hex64(),
              stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
              requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
              expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
            });
          }
          await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.releases_confirmed immediate`);
          await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.releases_confirmed deferred`);
          if (how.then) await how.then(sp, releaseId);
        });
      } catch (err) {
        const refused = raised(err);
        outcome = refused?.code === "P0001" ? refused.message : `unexpected: ${refused?.code ?? ""} ${(err as Error).message}`;
      }
    });
    return outcome;
  }

  /** The seal's record, answered and of which answer, as the migrator sets it: notification-answer's write. */
  const answer = (seal: Sealed, word: string | null) =>
    migrateDb.execute(
      word === null
        ? sql`update public.authority_notifications set answer = null, answered_at = null where id = public.seal_record(${seal.sealActionId}::uuid)`
        : sql`update public.authority_notifications set answer = ${word}, answered_at = now() where id = public.seal_record(${seal.sealActionId}::uuid)`,
    );
  /** release_facts as the API's role reads it, times as text. */
  const facts = async (q: Db | DbTx, action: string) => ({ ...(await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.release_facts(${action}::uuid)`))[0]! });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    releasesBefore = await releaseCounts(migrateDb);
    startedAt = (await migrateDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    staffAdmin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    otherAdmin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    moderator = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    for (const member of [staffAdmin, otherAdmin, moderator]) await staffProfile(apiDb, member);
    good = await sealed(2, "final");
    deciding = await sealed(1, "deciding");
    // A post one of whose two image rows is erased before the seal: seal_posts.images counts both rows (0016), and the
    // erased one keeps no file to move.
    erasedOne = await sealed(2, "final", async (p) => {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.post_media set erased_at = now() where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
    });
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeReleases(migrateDb, posts, allSeals(), allMedia());
    await removeOrders(migrateDb, orders);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [...authors, staffAdmin.id, otherAdmin.id, moderator.id]);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  test("the grants: no right on release_leaves, a read of the release's other tables, two columns of the notice, and the functions the API's role may call", async () => {
    const [rights] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, boolean>>(sql`
      select has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_leaves', 'SELECT') as leaves_sel, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_leaves', 'INSERT') as leaves_ins,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_leaves', 'UPDATE') as leaves_upd,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.releases', 'SELECT') as releases_sel, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.releases', 'INSERT') as releases_ins,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.releases', 'author_notice', 'UPDATE') as notice_upd, has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.releases', 'post_ids', 'UPDATE') as posts_upd,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_posts', 'SELECT') as marks_sel, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_posts', 'INSERT') as marks_ins,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_posts', 'UPDATE') as marks_upd, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_posts', 'DELETE') as marks_del,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_notices', 'INSERT') as notices_ins, has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_notices', 'objection', 'UPDATE') as objection_upd,
             has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.post_media', 'erased_at', 'UPDATE') as erased_upd,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_rules()', 'EXECUTE') as rules,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_facts(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as facts,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.seal_release(uuid, text, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as release,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_tellable(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as tellable,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_announce(uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as announce,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_replay(uuid, uuid[], text, uuid, text, timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') as replay,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.seal_record(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as record,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.release_may_tell(uuid, uuid, uuid[])', 'EXECUTE') as may_tell,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.seal_report(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as report`);
    expect({ ...rights }).toEqual({
      leaves_sel: false,
      leaves_ins: false,
      leaves_upd: false,
      releases_sel: true,
      releases_ins: false,
      notice_upd: true,
      posts_upd: false,
      marks_sel: true,
      marks_ins: false,
      marks_upd: false,
      marks_del: false,
      notices_ins: false,
      objection_upd: true,
      erased_upd: false,
      rules: true,
      facts: true,
      release: true,
      tellable: true,
      announce: true,
      replay: false,
      record: false,
      may_tell: false,
      report: false,
    });
    // As the API's role: no leave can be read or invented, no mark written, no image row erased.

    expect(await refusedAsApi(sql`select count(*) from public.release_leaves`)).toBe("42501");
    expect(await refusedAsApi(sql`insert into public.release_leaves (notification_id, leave_from, reference, received_on, untold) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'court', 'x', current_date, false)`)).toBe("42501");
    expect(await refusedAsApi(sql`insert into public.release_posts (post_id, release_id) values (gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid())`)).toBe("42501");
    expect(await refusedAsApi(sql`update public.post_media set erased_at = now() where id = ${good.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`)).toBe("42501");
  });

  test("the closed lists are the contracts' and release_rules() is RELEASE_RULES with RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, its backups RETENTION's", async () => {
    const listed = async (table: string, name: string) => {
      const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ def: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) as def from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass and c.conname = ${name}`);
      return [...row!.def.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)'::text/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    };
    expect(await listed("releases", "releases_basis")).toEqual([...RELEASE_BASES]);
    expect(await listed("release_leaves", "release_leaves_from")).toEqual([...RELEASE_LEAVE_FROM]);
    expect(await listed("releases", "releases_notice")).toEqual([...RELEASE_NOTICE_STATES]);
    const [rules] = await apiDb.execute<{ silence_days: number | null; period_notice_days: number; backup_days: number; posts_max: number }>(sql`select * from public.release_rules()`);
    expect({ silenceDays: rules!.silence_days, periodNoticeDays: rules!.period_notice_days, backupDays: rules!.backup_days }).toEqual({ ...RELEASE_RULES });
    expect(rules!.posts_max).toBe(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX);
    expect(rules!.backup_days).toBe(RETENTION.backupDays);
  });

    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_until = now() - interval '1 second' where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`);

  test("what a release writes: one row, its marks, the erased image rows, and no decision or ledger row; the post is no longer frozen through the seal, and a new suspect item freezes it again", async () => {
    const [leave] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.release_leaves where notification_id = public.seal_record(${good.sealActionId}::uuid) and leave_from = 'authority' order by recorded_at limit 1`);
    const counted = async (tx: DbTx) => ({ ...(await tx.execute<{ d: number; a: number }>(sql`select (select count(*)::int from public.decisions) as d, (select count(*)::int from public.decision_actions) as a`))[0]! });
    let ledgerBefore: { d: number; a: number } | null = null;
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      ledgerBefore = await counted(tx);
    });
    expect(await postFrozen(apiDb, good.postId)).toBe(true);
    const outcome = await tryRelease(staffAdmin, good.sealActionId, params(good, leave!.id), {
      then: async (tx, releaseId) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
          select r.seal_action_id, r.post_ids::text[] as post_ids, r.basis, r.leave_id, r.their_reference, r.released_by, r.replay_of, r.author_notice,
                 r.backups_clear_at - r.released_at >= make_interval(days => 30) as backups_after, r.backups_clear_at - r.released_at < make_interval(days => 31) as backups_within
            from public.releases r where r.id = ${releaseId}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...row }).toEqual({
          seal_action_id: good.sealActionId,
          post_ids: [good.postId],
          basis: "leave",
          leave_id: leave!.id,
          their_reference: "AZ 1/26",
          released_by: staffAdmin.id,
          replay_of: null,
          author_notice: "pending",
          backups_after: true,
          backups_within: true,
        });
        const marks = await tx.execute<{ release_id: string }>(sql`select release_id from public.release_posts where post_id = ${good.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(marks.map((mark) => mark.release_id)).toEqual([releaseId]);
        const images = await tx.execute<{ erased: boolean; state: string }>(sql`select erased_at is not null as erased, moderation_state::text as state from public.post_media where post_id = ${good.postId}::uuid`);
        // The rows are erased; the image's state stays sealed: the seal stays in force as a measure.
        expect(images.map((image) => [image.erased, image.state])).toEqual([
          [true, "sealed"],
          [true, "sealed"],
        ]);
        expect(await counted(tx)).toEqual(ledgerBefore);
        const [inForce] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.measures_in_force where id = ${good.sealActionId}::uuid`);
        expect(inForce!.n).toBe(1);
        // Not frozen through the seal any more; a new unanswered suspect item freezes it again through the first arm.
        expect(await postFrozen(tx, good.postId)).toBe(false);
        await report(tx, aPost(good.postId), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(tx, good.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The seal's custody: no unerased row, both files of both images left to destroy, and the home's count of them.
        const [custody] = await tx.execute<{ files: number; files_left: number }>(sql`select files, files_left from public.seal_custody(${good.sealActionId}::uuid)`);
        expect({ ...custody }).toEqual({ files: 0, files_left: 4 });
        const [counts] = await tx.execute<{ undestroyed: number }>(sql`select undestroyed from public.quarantine_counts()`);
        expect(counts!.undestroyed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
        // A second release of the same seal in the same transaction finds every post released.
        const second = await tx
          .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.seal_release(${good.sealActionId}::uuid, 'leave', ${leave!.id}::uuid, ${staffAdmin.id}::uuid)`))
          .then(() => null, (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message);
        expect(second).toBe("release_not_open");
      },
    });
    expect(outcome).toBe("ok");
  });
```
