  test("3f: at 360 by 740 px, Disable for an order on three of four items with one key: options that bind the fourth are refused before the key is asked; then the key confirms the order's facts and the three items, the check from outside lists each address as text, [clock.partial] and [effect.rest] say what is left, and a moderator may no longer correct the record", async () => {
    // At a phone's width, as every screen of orders is checked (design, section 8.10).
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const order = orderFixture({ reference: "BKA-2026-7", posts: 4 });
    fixtures.state.orders.push(order);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/orders/${order.id}`);
    const block = effectBlock();
    for (const line of [ORDER_WORDS.order.effectWhat, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectPreserve, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectTold, ORDER_WORDS.order.effectAnyone]) await shown(block.getByText(line, { exact: true }));
    // Every item that can be disabled is ticked; the person unticks the fourth.
    await page.locator("li.block").filter({ hasText: ORDER_WORDS.order.item(4) }).getByLabel(ORDER_WORDS.order.effectTick).uncheck();
    const button = block.getByRole("button", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.effectButton(3) });
    const before = await signatures();
    const options = fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed;
    const writes = fixtures.state.orderWrites.length;
    // The API asks the key to confirm the effect on four items: the key is never asked.
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await button.click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.orderWrites).toHaveLength(writes);
    await cleanOnPhone();
    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the three items: one key for all of them.
    await button.click();
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.orderWrites.length === writes + 1, "the effect");
    const chosen = order.items
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((item) => ({ itemId: item.id, postId: item.postId! }))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0));
    expect(fixtures.state.orderWrites.at(-1)).toEqual({
      what: "effected",
      id: order.id,
      key: true,
      body: { kind: "tco_removal", memberState: "DE", authority: order.authority, reference: "BKA-2026-7", sectionC: false, emergency: false, withholdFromAuthor: true, urgent: false, items: chosen },
    });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const at = order.items[0]!.disabledAt!;
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.checkOutside(bothTimes(at), 3)));
    for (const item of order.items.slice(0, 3)) await shown(page.locator("section.block ul.blocks li").filter({ hasText: item.link }).first());
    expect(await page.locator('a[href^="https://korbat.example/"]').count()).toBe(0);
    const deadline = bothTimes(order.clock!.deadlineAt!);
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.clock.partial(3, 4, bothTimes(at), 1, deadline)));
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.effectRest(1, deadline)));
    await shown(page.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.preservedUntil(bothTimes(order.items[0]!.preserveUntil!)), { exact: true }).first());
    await shown(effectBlock().getByRole("button", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.effectButton(1) }));
    // Once an item is disabled, a correction is an admin's with the key: a moderator is offered Section C's tick alone.
    const correct = page.locator("section.block").filter({ has: page.getByRole("heading", { name: ORDER_WORDS.order.correctTitle }) });
    await shown(correct.getByText(ORDER_WORDS.order.correctSilence));
    expect(await correct.getByLabel(ORDER_WORDS.form.reference).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await cleanOnPhone();
  });

  test("3f Task 6: at 360 by 740 px, Download since my last copy asks the key, records the copy only once the whole file has arrived, and a download cut short records nothing", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const head = Math.max(...fixtures.state.audit.map((row) => row.seq));
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/audit`);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadFirst(AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.key, { exact: true }));
      const before = await signatures();
      const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadButton });
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(1, head, head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: 0, through: head });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toEqual([{ through: head, hash: fixtures.state.audit.find((row) => row.seq === head)!.hash }]);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.download(head, AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      // Nothing newer: no key is asked.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.none(head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      // Ten more rows, and a body that breaks off after three of them: the key confirmed it, nothing is marked.
      const newer = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({ ...fixtures.state.audit[0]!, seq: head + 10 - i, hash: (head + 10 - i).toString(16).padStart(64, "a"), actionHash: null, keyId: null, action: "staff_sign_in" }));
      fixtures.state.audit.unshift(...newer);
      fixtures.state.exportCut = 3;
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.broken, { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: head, through: head + 10 });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(fixtures.state.copyPlace).toBe(head);
      // Pressed again, the download starts at the same place and is recorded.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(head + 1, head + 10, 10), { exact: true }));
      expect(fixtures.state.marks.at(-1)!.through).toBe(head + 10);
      await texts();
      await cleanOnPhone();
    } finally {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    }
  });

  /** The case as the fixtures hold it, with a seal for good of its own, in force or lifted, whose custody is as given. */
  function withSealForGood(view: CaseView, custody: NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["custody"]>, inForce: boolean): CaseView {
    const interim = view.decisions[0]!;
    return {
      ...view,
      decisions: [
        ...view.decisions,
        {
          ...interim,
          id: "a3142536-4758-496a-9bd7-f20314253647",
          kind: "final",
          needsAdmin: true,
          decidedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
          actions: [{ ...interim.actions[0]!, id: "b4253647-5869-4a7b-8ce8-031425364758", noEffect: null, inForce }],
          custody,
        },
      ],
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3d Task 2: the release, at a phone's width

  const RELEASE_LEAVE = "c5364758-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-142536475869";
  /** A release block as the API answers it: a seal reported, assessed illegal, moved, with a leave from a court and a hostile reference. */
  function releaseBlock(overrides: Partial<NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>> = {}): NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]> {
    return {
      reported: true,
      theirReference: HOSTILE.bidi,
      answer: "illegal",
      answeredAt: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
      handedOverAt: null,
      quarantined: true,
      preserved: false,
      leave: { id: RELEASE_LEAVE, from: "court", reference: "4 O 1/26", receivedOn: "2026-10-15", untold: false, untoldUntil: null },
      tellHeld: false,
      postIds: [POST_ID],
      remaining: 0,
      silenceDays: null,
      releasedAt: null,
      basis: null,
      backupsClearAt: null,
      noticeHeld: null,
      releasedPosts: 0,
      releasedImages: 0,
      ...overrides,
    };
  }
  /** The case with a seal for good in force whose decision carries this release block and its custody, all files moved. */
  function withRelease(view: CaseView, release: NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>): CaseView {
    const sealed = withSealForGood(view, { files: 2, moved: 2, movedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000).toISOString(), toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }, true);
    return { ...sealed, decisions: sealed.decisions.map((decided, index) => (index === sealed.decisions.length - 1 ? { ...decided, release } : decided)) };
  }
  const releaseRegion = () => page.getByRole("region", { name: RELEASE_WORDS.title, exact: true });

  test("3d Task 2: at 360 by 740 px, the release block in each state: a leave with the control, an assessment without one, the answers that support nothing, a conflict, more posts than one release names, and the author's telling in its three values", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    const view = fixtures.state.cases.get(CASE_FROZEN)!;
    const until = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString();
    const states: [NonNullable<CaseView["decisions"][number]["release"]>, string[], boolean][] = [
      [releaseBlock(), [RELEASE_WORDS.leave("from a court"), RELEASE_WORDS.sign(1), `${RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.label}${RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.atOnce}`], true],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null }), [RELEASE_WORDS.assessed], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: "not_illegal" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.notIllegal], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: "no_assessment" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.nothing], false],
      [releaseBlock({ leave: null, answer: null, answeredAt: null }), [RELEASE_WORDS.nothing, RELEASE_WORDS.facts.answer.none], false],
      [releaseBlock({ answer: "not_illegal" }), [RELEASE_WORDS.conflict], true],
      [releaseBlock({ remaining: 7 }), [RELEASE_WORDS.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, 7)], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...releaseBlock().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: until } }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.untold(bothTimes(until))], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true, leave: { ...releaseBlock().leave!, untold: true, untoldUntil: null } }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.untold(null)], true],
      [releaseBlock({ tellHeld: true }), [RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell.record], true],
    ];
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
      for (const [block, words, control] of states) {
        fixtures.state.cases.set(CASE_FROZEN, withRelease(view, block));
        await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`);
        await shown(releaseRegion());
        const text = (await releaseRegion().textContent()) ?? "";
        for (const sentence of words) expect(text, sentence).toContain(sentence);
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.what);
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.backups(RETENTION.backupDays));
        expect(text).toContain(RELEASE_WORDS.periodUnset);
        expect(await releaseRegion().getByRole("button", { name: RELEASE_WORDS.button }).count(), words[0]).toBe(control ? 1 : 0);
        // The authority's reference is an outsider's text, in its frame, never in a label's place.
        expect(await releaseRegion().locator(".frame").count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        await texts();
        await cleanOnPhone();
      }
    } finally {
      fixtures.state.cases.set(CASE_FROZEN, view);
      fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 });

const GapCloseBody = GapClosedParams.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
/** 3f Task 6: no import ever ran, unless a step sets one. */
export const NO_RESTORE: RestoreView = { importedAt: null, mayOpen: true, retentionMay: true, gaps: [], holds: [] };
/** 3f Task 6: the actor every line of the download names: the fixtures keep a handle per row, not an account. */
const LINE_ACTOR = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa";

/** The authenticator data's flags (WebAuthn L3, section 6.1). */
const FLAG_UV = 0x04;
const FLAG_BE = 0x08;
const FLAG_BS = 0x10;

const iso = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString();
const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
const b64url = (bytes: number) => randomBytes(bytes).toString("base64url");

interface KeyRecord extends StaffKey {
  /** The credential the browser made; null for the keys the person held before the walk, which no authenticator holds. */
  credentialId: string | null;
}

interface SessionRecord {
  handle: string;
  token: string;
  csrf: string;
  browser: string;
  createdAt: number;
  lastUsedAt: number;
  /** The credential of the key that opened it; null for the fixtures' other sessions. */
  credentialId: string | null;
}

export interface RequestRecord {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  status: number;
  activity: boolean;
}

/**
 * The audit log: places 1 to 160, one row every 97 minutes up to now, so the newest page, Load older and Go to place each
 * have rows to show, and the home screen's sign-ins reach back past 7 days. Actions, targets and actors take hostile
 * values in turn.
 */
function auditLog(now: number): AuditEntry[] {
  const rows: AuditEntry[] = [];
  for (let seq = AUDIT_ROWS; seq >= 1; seq--) {
    const kind = seq % 4 === 0 ? "revoked" : seq % 9 === 0 ? "hostile" : "signin";
    rows.push({
      seq,
      hash: hex64(),
      createdAt: iso(now - (AUDIT_ROWS - seq) * ROW_SPACING_MS),
      actorHandle: ACTOR_HANDLES[seq % ACTOR_HANDLES.length] ?? null,
      action: kind === "revoked" ? "staff_session_revoked" : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.script : "staff_sign_in",
      targetType: kind === "revoked" ? "staff_session" : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.quote : null,
      targetId: kind === "revoked" ? randomUUID() : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.url : null,
      actionHash: kind === "revoked" ? hex64() : null,
      // 3f Task 6: the key a step-up confirmed a row with; a revocation is one, by the walk's own key.
      keyId: kind === "revoked" ? FIXTURE_KEY_ID : null,
    });
  }
  return rows;
}

/** The authenticator data inside a CBOR attestation object: the byte string under the text key "authData". */
function authDataOf(attestationObject: Buffer): Buffer | null {
  // A CBOR text string of 8 bytes (0x68) spelling authData, then the byte string (major type 2) it maps to.
  const key = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x68]), Buffer.from("authData")]);
  const at = attestationObject.indexOf(key);
  if (at === -1) return null;
  let i = at + key.length;
  const head = attestationObject[i];
  if (head === undefined || head >> 5 !== 2) return null;
  let length = head & 0x1f;
  i += 1;
  // The length is in the head itself, or in the 1, 2 or 4 bytes after it.
  if (length === 24) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt8(i);
    i += 1;
  } else if (length === 25) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
  } else if (length === 26) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt32BE(i);
    i += 4;
  } else if (length > 23) {
    return null;
  }
  return attestationObject.subarray(i, i + length);
}

/** The flags byte of authenticator data, which follows the 32-byte hash of the relying party ID. */
const flagsOf = (authData: Buffer | null): number | null => (authData && authData.length > 32 ? authData[32]! : null);

/** The staff refusal for an authenticator's flags, or null: user verified, and neither backup-eligible nor backed up. */
function flagRefusal(flags: number | null): "staff_key_refused" | "staff_key_not_user_verified" | "staff_key_not_device_bound" | null {
  if (flags === null) return "staff_key_refused";
  if ((flags & FLAG_UV) === 0) return "staff_key_not_user_verified";
  if ((flags & (FLAG_BE | FLAG_BS)) !== 0) return "staff_key_not_device_bound";
  return null;
}

function cookies(req: IncomingMessage): Map<string, string> {
  const jar = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const part of (req.headers.cookie ?? "").split(";")) {
    const at = part.indexOf("=");
    if (at > 0) jar.set(part.slice(0, at).trim(), part.slice(at + 1).trim());
  }
  return jar;
}

/** The staff cookies as the API sets them: __Host- names, Secure, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, 12 hours, the session's HttpOnly. */
const COOKIE = "Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Strict";
const SESSION_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff";
const CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
const CLEAR_COOKIES = [`${SESSION_COOKIE}=; ${COOKIE}; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0`, `${CSRF_COOKIE}=; ${COOKIE}; Max-Age=0`];

/**
 * The status the API answers each staff refusal with (apps/api/src/auth/staff/), so the console meets here what it meets
 * behind Caddy; a unit test (fixture-statuses.test.ts) checks it against the API's own source.
 */
export const REFUSAL_STATUS = {
  staff_enrollment_invalid: 400,
  staff_key_refused: 400,
  staff_key_invalid: 401,
  staff_session_required: 401,
  staff_key_not_user_verified: 403,
  staff_key_not_device_bound: 403,
  staff_key_suspended: 403,
  staff_step_up_required: 403,
  staff_step_up_invalid: 403,
  staff_key_limit: 409,
} as const satisfies Record<StaffErrorCode, number>;

class Refusal extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    readonly headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = {},
  ) {
    super(code);
  }
}

/** A staff refusal with the API's own status for its code. */
const refuse = (code: StaffErrorCode, headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = {}) => new Refusal(REFUSAL_STATUS[code], code, headers);

/**
 * A challenge in the other ceremonies' 58-byte layout (the contracts' CEREMONY_CHALLENGE), with the purpose's code, a
 * fresh nonce, `binding` (zeros for a sign-in, bound to nothing) and a random seal, since only this server reads it back.
 */
function ceremonyChallenge(purpose: "staff_signin" | "staff_register", binding: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE.bindingBytes)): string {
  const c = CEREMONY_CHALLENGE;
  const bytes = randomBytes(c.bytes);
  bytes[c.versionAt] = c.version;
  bytes[c.purposeAt] = CHALLENGE_PURPOSES[purpose];
  bytes.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000), c.expiryAt);
  binding.copy(bytes, c.bindingAt);
  return bytes.toString("base64url");
}

/**
 * The status the API answers each moderation refusal the fixtures use with (apps/api/src/moderation/context.ts); the
 * unit test that holds the staff statuses to the API's source holds these too.
 */
export const MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS = { text_not_found: 409, text_invalid: 422, text_quotes_user: 422, rate_limited: 429, image_refused: 404, staff_recused: 403, case_changed: 409, snapshot_mismatch: 409, reviewer_conflict: 403, strike_mismatch: 409 } as const;

/** The kinds of text a decision or a correction names: the ones a case's answer hands back as drafts while no decision has named them. */
const DRAFT_KINDS: readonly string[] = ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason"];

/** What an item reads once a decision answered it. */
const ITEM_OUTCOMES = { restricted: { incompatible: "restricted_rule", illegal: "restricted_legal" }, no_violation: "no_violation", not_evident: "not_evident" } as const;

/**
 * 3e (design, sections 7.4 and 7.11): what the database holds a decision's strike and its overruling to, as a problem's
 * words or null. A final restriction under a korbat rule other than R2 that answers no suspect item gives a strike
 * exactly when the case's answer said one is due; a correction or a review overrules the strike of the decision it
 * reverses exactly when it reverses that decision whole, and never signs a strike.
 */
function strikeProblem(view: CaseView, kind: string, outcome: string, ground: string | null, ruleId: string | null, actions: readonly { kind: string }[], reviewed: CaseDecision | undefined): string | null {
  const strikes = actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike");
  const overrules = actions.some((action) => action.kind === "overrule");
  if (kind === "correction" || kind === "review") {
    if (strikes) return "a strike signed with a reversal";
    const standing = reviewed?.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike" && action.inForce) ?? false;
    return overrules !== (standing && outcome === "reversed") ? "an overruling that the reversal does not bear out" : null;
  }
  if (overrules) return "an overruling signed with a decision that reverses nothing";
  const suspect = view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null && item.suspect);
  const due = kind === "final" && outcome === "restricted" && ground === "incompatible" && ruleId !== "R2" && !suspect && (view.strikeDue?.due ?? false);
  return strikes !== due ? "a strike the case's answer did not say is due, or none where it said one is" : null;
}

/** The author's band of active strikes once a decision gave one more. */
const NEXT_BAND = { "0": "1", "1": "2", "2": "3_or_more", "3_or_more": "3_or_more" } as const;

/**
 * The case as a confirmed decision leaves it, changed in place: the decision with its measures in the case's list and
 * history, the next version, a lifted measure no longer in force, a seal with what the case reaches, and after a final
 * decision the items it answered, the measures taken while deciding ended, and the case closed when nothing is left open.
 */
function applyDecision(view: CaseView, params: CaseDecidedParams, written: { facts: string | null; reason: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, staffHandle: string): void {
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = randomUUID();
  const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === params.reviewsDecisionId);
  const actions: CaseDecision["actions"] = params.actions.map((action) => {
    const lifts: readonly string[] | null = MEASURES[action.kind].lifts;
    if (lifts !== null) {
      const lifted = corrected?.actions.find((held) => held.inForce && lifts.includes(held.kind) && held.mediaId === action.mediaId);
      if (lifted) {
        lifted.inForce = false;
        lifted.liftedBy = id;
        // 3e Task 4: a lift answers the measure's reply, and one before the start leaves a measure that never ran.
        if (lifted.reply && lifted.reply.answeredAt === null) lifted.reply = { ...lifted.reply, answeredAt: at, answeredBy: id };
        if (lifted.period && lifted.period.startsAt === null) lifted.period = { ...lifted.period, state: "never" };
        if (view.standing) view.standing = { ...view.standing, live: false };
      }
      const ground = "orderGround" in action && action.orderGround !== undefined ? { orderGround: action.orderGround } : {};
      return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: lifted?.id ?? null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, ...ground };
    }
    // 3e Task 4: a suspension or a termination carries its days and whether it was announced; an announced one has no
    // start until its mail's outcome is known, and the account's measure is live from the decision on.
    if (action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate") {
      if (view.standing) view.standing = { ...view.standing, live: true };
      const period = action.announced ? { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" as const } : { startsAt: at, endsAt: action.days ? new Date(Date.parse(at) + action.days * 86_400_000).toISOString() : null, state: "running" as const };
      return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, days: action.days ?? null, announced: action.announced ?? null, period };
    }
    const reach = view.suspicion?.reach ?? { posts: 0, images: 0 };
    const sealed = action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: reach.posts, images: reach.images, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] } : null;
    // 3e: a strike counts STANDING_RULES.strikeDays from its decision, and nothing rests on it yet.
    const strike = action.kind === "strike" ? { countsUntil: new Date(Date.parse(at) + STANDING_RULES.strikeDays * 86_400_000).toISOString(), restedOnBy: [] } : {};
    return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed, ...NO_STANDING, ...strike };
  });
  // 3e Task 4: a kept correction answers the corrected decision's reply; one filed before the start then fixes the start
  // at the later of now and the earliest start.
  if (params.kind === "correction" && params.outcome === "kept" && corrected) {
    for (const held of corrected.actions) {
      if (!held.reply || held.reply.answeredAt !== null) continue;
      held.reply = { ...held.reply, answeredAt: at, answeredBy: id };
      if (held.reply.onTime && held.period) {
        const start = new Date(Math.max(Date.parse(held.earliestStart ?? at), Date.parse(at))).toISOString();
        held.period = { startsAt: start, endsAt: held.days ? new Date(Date.parse(start) + held.days * 86_400_000).toISOString() : null, state: "announced" };
      }
    }
  }
  // 3e Task 5: a kept correction of a "No breach" decision withdraws all of its marks together.
  if (params.kind === "correction" && params.outcome === "kept" && corrected && corrected.outcome === "no_violation") {
    view.items = view.items.map((item) => (item.answeredBy === corrected.id && item.unfounded ? { ...item, unfounded: false, markWithdrawn: true } : item));
  }
  const suspect = view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null && item.suspect);
  view.decisions = [
    ...view.decisions,
    {
      id,
      kind: params.kind,
      outcome: params.outcome,
      ground: params.ground,
      ruleId: params.ruleId,
      rulesVersion: params.rulesVersion,
      redressVersion: params.redressVersion,
      category: params.category,
      categoryKeyword: params.categoryKeyword,
      source: "report",
      decidedAt: at,
      staffHandle,
      throughSeq: params.throughSeq,
      answersFromSeq: params.kind === "final" ? view.answeredSeq + 1 : null,
      reviewsDecisionId: params.reviewsDecisionId,
      snapshotId: params.snapshotId,
      suspect,
      unseen: false,
      needsAdmin: false,
      endedInterim: false,
      facts: written.facts,
      reason: written.reason,
      legalReference: written.legalReference,
      actions,
    },
  ];
  view.history = [...view.history, { at, event: "decision", refId: id, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: params.kind, outcome: params.outcome, staffHandle, result: null }];
  view.stateVersion += 1;
  // 3e: the post now carries a strike that stands, and its author has one more.
  if (actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike")) {
    view.strikeDue = { due: false, why: "already_struck" };
    if (view.authorStanding) view.authorStanding = { ...view.authorStanding, activeStrikes: NEXT_BAND[view.authorStanding.activeStrikes] };
  }
  if (actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") && view.suspicion) view.suspicion = { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, sealed: view.suspicion.reach.images, served: 0 } };
  if (params.kind !== "final" || (params.outcome !== "restricted" && params.outcome !== "no_violation" && params.outcome !== "not_evident")) return;
  const outcome = params.outcome === "restricted" ? ITEM_OUTCOMES.restricted[params.ground ?? "incompatible"] : ITEM_OUTCOMES[params.outcome];
  // 3e Task 5: the items it answers, each marked when the key signed its mark.
  view.items = view.items.map((item) => (item.outcome === null && item.seq <= params.throughSeq ? { ...item, outcome, answeredBy: id, unfounded: params.unfounded.includes(item.id) } : item));
  view.answeredSeq = params.throughSeq;
  if (view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null)) return;
  // The case is closed: what was done while deciding has ended, and the post reads as the decision's measure left it.
  view.closedAt = at;
  for (const decided of view.decisions) if (decided.kind === "interim") for (const action of decided.actions) if (MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null) action.inForce = false;
  if (view.target.type === "post" && actions.some((action) => action.kind === "remove")) view.target = { ...view.target, state: "removed", level: "removed" };
}

/**
 * The case as a confirmed review leaves it, changed in place: the review with its reversals in the case's list and
 * history, the measures it lifts no longer in force, the appeal answered, the next version, and a post whose removal was
 * lifted shown again.
 */
function applyReview(view: CaseView, reviewed: CaseDecision, params: AppealsReviewedParams, reason: string, staffHandle: string): void {
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = randomUUID();
  const actions: CaseDecision["actions"] = params.actions.map((action) => {
    const lifts: readonly string[] = MEASURES[action.kind].lifts ?? [];
    const lifted = reviewed.actions.find((held) => held.inForce && lifts.includes(held.kind) && held.mediaId === action.mediaId);
    if (lifted) {
      lifted.inForce = false;
      lifted.liftedBy = id;
    }
    return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: lifted?.id ?? null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING };
  });
  view.decisions = [
    ...view.decisions,
    {
      id,
      kind: "review",
      outcome: params.outcome,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      rulesVersion: params.rulesVersion,
      redressVersion: params.redressVersion,
      category: params.category,
      categoryKeyword: null,
      source: reviewed.source,
      decidedAt: at,
      staffHandle,
      throughSeq: 0,
      answersFromSeq: null,
      reviewsDecisionId: reviewed.id,
      snapshotId: params.snapshotId,
      suspect: reviewed.suspect,
      unseen: false,
      needsAdmin: false,
      endedInterim: false,
      facts: null,
      reason,
      legalReference: null,
      actions,
    },
  ];
  view.appeals = view.appeals.map((appeal) => (appeal.id === params.appealId ? { ...appeal, answeredAt: at, result: params.outcome, answeredBy: id, reviewer: null, mayReview: false } : appeal));
  view.history = [
    ...view.history,
    { at, event: "decision", refId: id, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: "review", outcome: params.outcome, staffHandle, result: null },
    { at, event: "appeal_answered", refId: params.appealId, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: null, outcome: null, staffHandle: null, result: params.outcome },
  ];
  view.stateVersion += 1;
  if (view.target.type === "post" && actions.some((action) => action.kind === "restore")) view.target = { ...view.target, state: "visible", level: "visible" };
}

/** `raw` answers bytes of this type in place of JSON: an image. */
type Answer = { status: number; body?: unknown; raw?: { type: string; bytes: Buffer }; headers?: Record<string, string | string[]> };

export type FixtureApi = ReturnType<typeof createFixtureApi>;

/** 3f: a message at the contact point as the API lists it, nobody's yet. */
function contactMessage(id: string, receivedMs: number, folder: "inbox" | "junk", stale: boolean): ContactMessage {
  return { id, folder, receivedAt: iso(receivedMs), seenAt: iso(stale ? receivedMs + 5 * HOUR : receivedMs + 20_000), stale, disposition: null, handledAt: null, handledBy: null, orders: [] };
}

/** 3f: three stale messages an outage left, which the walk closes together. */
export function staleMessages(now: number): ContactMessage[] {
  return ["8f3c4d5e-6f70-4182-9394-a5b627c8d9e0", "904d5e6f-7081-4293-a4a5-b6c738d9e0f1", "a15e6f70-8192-43a4-b5b6-c7d849e0f102"].map((id, i) => contactMessage(id, now - (30 + i) * HOUR, "inbox", true));
}

/** 3f, Task 2: what a link of an order names, as the API's resolver tells them apart: a post, an account, or nothing korbat serves. */
function linkKindOf(link: string): OrderItemView["linkKind"] {
  if (/^https:[/][/]korbat[.]example[/]p[/][0-9a-z-]+$/.test(link)) return "post";
  if (/^https:[/][/]korbat[.]example[/]@[0-9a-z_]+$/.test(link)) return "account";
  return "other";
}

/** 3f: an item as the API answers it once its link is recorded: a post's author and preview are outsiders' words, nothing is done yet. */
function orderItem(link: string, position: number, addedAt: string): OrderItemView {
  const linkKind = linkKindOf(link);
  return {
    id: randomUUID(),
    position,
    link,
    linkKind,
    addedAt,
    unverified: true,
    postId: linkKind === "post" ? randomUUID() : null,
    post: linkKind === "post" ? { authorHandle: HOSTILE.img, state: "visible", images: 1, preview: HOSTILE.quote, createdAt: addedAt, deletedOn: null } : null,
    decisionId: null,
    caseId: null,
    inForce: false,
    disabledAt: null,
    noEffect: null,
    preserveUntil: null,
    preserveEndedAt: null,
    erasedAt: null,
    reinstatedAt: null,
    reinstatedGround: null,
    closedAt: null,
    closedReason: null,
    gap: false,
  };
}

/** 3f: a removal order's clock from its start: the hour, and the target five minutes before it; no deadline without a start. */
function runningClock(start: string | null, itemsOpen: number): NonNullable<OrderView["clock"]> {
  const deadline = start === null ? null : iso(Date.parse(start) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000);
  return { clockStart: start, stopped: false, stoppedAt: null, stopGround: null, deadlineAt: deadline, targetAt: deadline === null ? null : iso(Date.parse(deadline) - 5 * 60_000), itemsOpen, firstEffectAt: null, lastEffectAt: null, withinHour: null };
}

/** The six months and a day of a removal order's preservation, from a disabling (ORDER_RULES), as the database counts them. */
function preservedUntil(at: string): string {
  const until = new Date(at);
  until.setUTCMonth(until.getUTCMonth() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths);
  until.setUTCDate(until.getUTCDate() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMarginDays);
  return until.toISOString();
}

/**
 * 3f, Task 3: an order a step of the walk puts in place, as the API answers it once its links are recorded: of its kind,
 * with `posts` links that each name a post, told or held (Section C, with the hold's end), checked or not, and received
 * a few minutes ago, so that its hour runs.
 */
export function orderFixture(options: { reference: string; posts: number; kind?: "tco_removal" | "dsa_art9"; sectionC?: boolean; verified?: boolean; holdUntil?: string | null }): OrderView {
  const now = Date.now();
  const at = iso(now - 5 * 60_000);
  const kind = options.kind ?? "tco_removal";
  const tco = kind === "tco_removal";
  const sectionC = options.sectionC ?? false;
  const items = Array.from({ length: options.posts }, (_, i) => orderItem(`https://korbat.example/p/${options.reference.toLowerCase()}-${i + 1}`, i + 1, at));
  const holdUntil = options.holdUntil ?? null;
  return {
    id: randomUUID(),
    kind,
    memberState: "DE",
    authority: HOSTILE.long,
    reference: options.reference,
    openedAt: at,
    state: tco ? "running" : "no_clock",
    clock: tco ? runningClock(at, items.length) : null,
    dueAt: null,
    closedAt: null,
    closeGround: null,
    items,
    itemsInForce: 0,
    verified: options.verified ?? false,
    noticesHeld: 0,
    channel: "mailbox",
    messageId: null,
    receivedAt: at,
    sentAt: null,
    issuedAt: null,
    sectionC,
    emergency: false,
    crossBorder: false,
    withholdFromAuthor: tco || sectionC,
    preserve: tco,
    openedBy: PERSON_HANDLE,
    openedVia: "console",
    importedAt: null,
    tellPerson: null,
    events: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: "opened", ground: null, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" }],
    owed: { received: false, verification: !(options.verified ?? false), issuedAt: tco && sectionC, texts: true, document: true, holdUntil: !tco && sectionC && holdUntil === null, tellPerson: false, scrutinyUntil: null },
    hold: sectionC ? { until: holdUntil, basis: tco ? "regulation" : "authority", open: holdUntil === null, extended: false, endedAt: null, endReason: null, releasedAt: null, noticesHeld: 0 } : null,
    mayClose: true,
    mayEvents: tco ? ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"] : ["receipt_confirmed", "closed_without_effect"],
    mayCorrect: "entry",
  };
}

/** 3f: an order's line on the list, from its page. */
function orderSummary(view: OrderView): OrderSummary {
  const { id, kind, memberState, authority, reference, openedAt, state, clock, dueAt, closedAt, closeGround, itemsInForce, verified, noticesHeld } = view;
  return { id, kind, memberState, authority, reference, openedAt, state, clock, dueAt, closedAt, closeGround, items: view.items.length, itemsInForce, verified, noticesHeld };
}

export function createFixtureApi() {
  const now = Date.now();
  // The account's WebAuthn user handle, which the enrolment's options carry and a discoverable staff key returns.
  const userHandle = b64url(32);
  const state = {
    /** The origin the page is served from, set once the server listens. */
    origin: "",
    /** The console is off: every staff path answers 404, as the API does while CONSOLE_ORIGIN is unset. */
    off: false,
    enrolmentToken: b64url(32),
    enrolmentUsed: false,
    /** The next step-up options bind another action than the one the page asked for: the revocation of another session. */
    mismatchNextStepUp: false,
    /** 3d Task 2: every release the page sent, by the seal's ledger row, with the params the key confirmed. */
    releases: [] as { actionId: string; params: unknown }[],
    /** 3d Task 2: the release of the seal that the Appeals list's appeal of a seal is about, or null ([appeals.released]). */
    appealReleased: null as AppealRow["released"],
    /**
     * The next sign-in options carry a step-up challenge for an action of this server's choosing, as an API under an
     * attacker's control would hand out to have the key sign it at an ordinary sign-in.
     */
    stepUpChallengeAtNextSignIn: false,
    signInOptionsServed: 0,
    keys: EXISTING_KEY_NAMES.map(
      (name, i): KeyRecord => ({ id: randomUUID(), name, createdAt: iso(now - (30 + i) * 24 * HOUR), lastUsedAt: i === 0 ? iso(now - 2 * HOUR) : null, credentialId: null }),
    ),
    sessions: new Map<string, SessionRecord>(),
    audit: auditLog(now),
    /** Challenges handed out and not yet spent, by their base64url text: what each was issued for, a step-up's with the hash of the action it binds. */
    challenges: new Map<string, { purpose: "register" | "signin" | "step_up"; target?: string; hash?: string }>(),
    /** The handles the page revoked with its key. */
    revoked: [] as string[],
    /** The cases the console can open: a post's, a frozen post's, an account's, and the one a quoting post links to. */
    cases: new Map<string, CaseView>([
      [CASE_POST, postCase()],
      [CASE_FROZEN, frozenCase()],
      [CASE_ACCOUNT, accountCase()],
      [CASE_QUOTED, postCase({ id: CASE_QUOTED, items: [], decisions: [], notes: [] })],
      [CASE_SEALABLE, sealableCase(CASE_SEALABLE, ACCOUNT_SEALABLE)],
      [CASE_DECLINE, sealableCase(CASE_DECLINE, ACCOUNT_DECLINE)],
      [CASE_ADMIN, adminCase()],
      [CASE_CHANGED, plainCase(CASE_CHANGED, "f5d8e7da-4906-48da-91e6-25c413a8f7e1")],
      [CASE_DRAFTS, plainCase(CASE_DRAFTS, "f5d8e7da-4906-48da-91e6-25c413a8f7e2")],
      [CASE_APPEALED, appealedCase()],
      // 3e: the case of the run that signs a strike.
      [CASE_STRIKE, strikeCase()],
    ]),
    /** The role the signed-in person holds: a moderator, unless a step of the walk makes them an admin. */
    role: "moderator" as StaffMe["role"],
    /** Every decision the key confirmed: the case and the params, as the page sent them. */
    decisions: [] as { caseId: string; params: CaseDecidedParams }[],
    /** Every review the key confirmed: the reviewed decision and the params, as the page sent them. */
    reviews: [] as { decisionId: string; params: AppealsReviewedParams }[],
    /** Every image the page asked for, by its path, in order. */
    imageRequests: [] as string[],
    /**
     * The next image is refused though the page was right to ask for it: what the API answers when a report froze the
     * post between the page's read of the case and the browser's request for the image.
     */
    refuseNextImage: false,
    /**
     * The next read of a case is refused as a recusal: what the API answers when an account linked to the person came
     * to take part in the case since the page read it.
     */
    recuseNextCaseRead: false,
    /**
     * Every text the page saved, in order, with its salt and the digest it sent and the server recomputed; `used` once a
     * decision named it. A text saved when its field lost focus is here before any key is asked: the walk counts them.
     */
    texts: [] as { id: string; caseId: string; kind: string; text: string; salt: string; digest: string; createdAt: string; used?: boolean }[],
    /**
     * The next save of a text is refused with this code, as the API refuses a text that quotes what someone wrote about
     * the case (422) or a save over the minute's limit (429). Nothing is stored.
     */
    refuseNextSave: null as "text_quotes_user" | "rate_limited" | null,
    /**
     * A case and a kind of text: that case's answers carry its newest saved draft of the kind with other words under the
     * digest of what the person saved, as an API under an attacker's control would answer to put its own words into a
     * decision's draft. The page must drop it.
     */
    forgedDraft: null as { caseId: string; kind: string } | null,
    /**
     * The next save is answered with the digest of another text, one of this server's own choosing which it stores as
     * the person's: what an API under an attacker's control would answer to have the key confirm a reason nobody wrote.
     */
    hostileNextSave: false,
    /** The digests such answers carried. An action the page then builds from one of them is its fault. */
    forgedDigests: [] as string[],
    /** Every reveal the key confirmed: the item and the digest of its saved reason. */
    reveals: [] as { itemId: string; reasonDigest: string }[],
    /** Every finding the page opened. */
    findings: [] as FindingRequest[],
    snapshotsTaken: 0,
    stepUpOptionsServed: 0,
    /**
     * 3f: the messages at the contact point, newest first, which the Contact point screen lists and closes: one a few
     * minutes old in the inbox and one in the junk folder that arrived hours before korbat saw it. The walk adds more.
     */
    contactMessages: [
      contactMessage("6d1a2b3c-4d5e-4f60-8172-839405a6b7c8", now - 4 * 60_000, "inbox", false),
      contactMessage("7e2b3c4d-5e6f-4071-8283-94a516b7c8d9", now - 5 * HOUR, "junk", true),
    ] as ContactMessage[],
    /** Every close the page sent, with the word it chose, in order. */
    contactClosed: [] as { id: string; disposition: string }[],
    /** 3f: the home screen's contact point and alert channel, as the overview answers them. */
    authorities: { contact: { open: 0, oldestAt: null, dueAt: null }, alerts: { channel: "ok", since: null } } as Pick<StaffOverview, "contact" | "alerts">,
    /** 3f, Task 5: the reports to the authorities owed, as reports_owed() answers them through the overview. */
    reportsOwed: { total: 0, items: [] } as StaffOverview["reportsOwed"],
    /**
     * 3f, Task 6: the session's own newest copied place, every download the page confirmed and every mark it sent; a
     * number of lines after which the next download's body is cut; the copy's age and the gaps of a restore as the overview
     * answers them; what a restore lost, and the gaps closed as not needed.
     */
    copyPlace: null as number | null,
    exports: [] as { after: number; through: number }[],
    marks: [] as { through: number; hash: string }[],
    exportCut: null as number | null,
    copy: { newestAt: iso(now - 2 * HOUR), overdue: false } as StaffOverview["copy"],
    restoreOverview: { open: 0, measures: 0, importedAt: null } as StaffOverview["restore"],
    /** 3d Task 1: the quarantine's four values, as quarantine_counts() answers them through the overview. */
    quarantine: { dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 0, oldest: null } as StaffOverview["quarantine"],
    /** 3d Task 2: the releases of the last 30 days that Home lists ([home.released]). */
    destructive: [] as StaffOverview["destructive"],
    restore: NO_RESTORE,
    gapsClosed: [] as string[],
    /** 3f, Task 2: the orders the walk opened, as their pages stand, and every write the page sent for them, with whether a key confirmed it. */
    orders: [] as OrderView[],
    orderWrites: [] as { what: "opened" | "items" | "event" | "corrected" | "effected"; id: string; body: unknown; key: boolean }[],
    requests: [] as RequestRecord[],
    problems: [] as string[],
  };
  // Two other live sessions of the person's, started earlier from other browsers and used minutes ago: one to revoke, one
  // for the mismatched step-up.
  for (const [i, browser] of OTHER_BROWSERS.entries()) {
    const handle = randomUUID();
    state.sessions.set(handle, { handle, token: b64url(32), csrf: b64url(32), browser, createdAt: now - (3 + i) * HOUR, lastUsedAt: now - (2 + 3 * i) * 60_000, credentialId: null });
  }

  const problem = (text: string) => state.problems.push(text);

  /** A ceremony's client data: its type, a challenge this server issued for `purpose` (spent here), and the page's origin. */
  function clientData(encoded: string, type: "webauthn.create" | "webauthn.get", purpose: "register" | "signin" | "step_up", refusal: StaffErrorCode) {
    let data: { type?: unknown; challenge?: unknown; origin?: unknown };
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encoded, "base64url").toString("utf8"));
    } catch {
      problem(`${type}: client data that is not JSON`);
      throw refuse(refusal);
    }
    const issued = typeof data.challenge === "string" ? state.challenges.get(data.challenge) : undefined;
    if (data.type !== type || data.origin !== state.origin || issued?.purpose !== purpose) {
      problem(`${type}: client data for ${String(data.type)} at ${String(data.origin)}, challenge ${issued ? issued.purpose : "unknown"}`);
      throw refuse(refusal);
    }
    state.challenges.delete(data.challenge as string);
    return issued;
  }

  /** The session the staff cookie names, as requireStaff reads it: never cached, refused with both cookies cleared. */
  function requireStaff(req: IncomingMessage): SessionRecord {
    const jar = cookies(req);
    const session = [...state.sessions.values()].find((s) => s.token === jar.get(SESSION_COOKIE));
    const at = Date.now();
    if (!session || at >= session.createdAt + ABSOLUTE_MS || at >= session.lastUsedAt + IDLE_MS) throw refuse("staff_session_required", { "set-cookie": CLEAR_COOKIES });
    if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD" && req.headers["x-staff-csrf"] !== jar.get(CSRF_COOKIE)) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: the staff CSRF header does not echo the staff CSRF cookie`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
    // Only a request its person's action started moves the idle end.
    if (req.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1") session.lastUsedAt = at;
    return session;
  }

  function me(session: SessionRecord): StaffMe {
    const at = Date.now();
    const absoluteEnd = session.createdAt + ABSOLUTE_MS;
    const idleEnd = Math.min(session.lastUsedAt + IDLE_MS, absoluteEnd);
    return {
      handle: PERSON_HANDLE,
      role: state.role,
      sessionHandle: session.handle,
      idleExpiresAt: iso(idleEnd),
      idleSecondsLeft: Math.max(0, Math.floor((idleEnd - at) / 1000)),
      absoluteExpiresAt: iso(absoluteEnd),
      absoluteSecondsLeft: Math.max(0, Math.floor((absoluteEnd - at) / 1000)),
      // 3f: the home state whose facts the console reads, and the contact point Annex II names.
      homeState: "DE",
      contactPoint: "authorities@korbat.example",
    };
  }

  function auditPage(query: URLSearchParams): AuditPage {
    const action = query.get("action");
    const cursor = query.get("cursor");
    const at = query.get("at");
    // 3f Task 6: what one key confirmed, in a period.
    const key = query.get("key");
    const from = query.get("from");
    const to = query.get("to");
    let rows = action === null ? state.audit : state.audit.filter((row) => row.action === action);
    if (key !== null) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.keyId === key && row.actionHash !== null && (from === null || row.createdAt >= from) && (to === null || row.createdAt <= to));
    if (cursor !== null) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.seq < Number(cursor));
    if (at !== null) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.seq <= Number(at));
    const entries = rows.slice(0, STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE);
    return { entries, nextCursor: rows.length > entries.length ? entries[entries.length - 1]!.seq : null, copy: { lastPlace: state.copyPlace } };
  }

  /**
   * 3f Task 6 (8.7, 10.5): the download's lines for the places after `after` up to `through`, oldest first, each naming the
   * row before it, as the API writes them; `cut` ends the body after that many lines, as a download that broke off.
   */
  function exportBody(after: number, through: number, cut: number | null): Buffer {
    const rows = state.audit.filter((row) => row.seq > after && row.seq <= through).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    const lines = rows.map((row) => {
      const before = state.audit.find((other) => other.seq === row.seq - 1);
      const line: AuditExportLine = {
        v: 1,
        place: row.seq,
        id: row.seq,
        at: row.createdAt,
        actor: LINE_ACTOR,
        action: row.action,
        targetType: row.targetType,
        targetId: row.targetId,
        requestId: null,
        staffSession: null,
        keyId: row.keyId,
        actionHash: row.actionHash,
        stepUp: null,
        metadata: JSON.stringify({ email: "never-shown@korbat.example" }),
        prevHash: before?.hash ?? "0".repeat(64),
        hash: row.hash,
      };
      return JSON.stringify(line);
    });
    const kept = cut === null ? lines : lines.slice(0, cut);
    return Buffer.from(kept.map((line) => `${line}${String.fromCharCode(10)}`).join(""), "utf8");
  }

  /** 3f: an order's step-up: by the session's own key, over a challenge issued for exactly this action on exactly this order. */
  async function confirmedOrder(stepUp: OrderEventRecordRequest["stepUp"], action: StaffStepUpActionInput, session: SessionRecord): Promise<void> {
    const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
    const hash = await stepUpActionHash(action);
    if (issued.target !== action.target.id || issued.hash !== hash || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
      problem(`${action.action}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}, over ${issued.hash === hash ? "these" : "other"} params`);
      throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
    }
    const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
    if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : refusal);
  }

  /**
   * 3f, Task 3: an order as the API answers it to this person: once an item was disabled a correction is an admin's with
   * the key, and only Section C's tick under caution for anyone else; a removal order's one extension is an admin's.
   */
  function orderAnswer(view: OrderView): OrderView {
    const given = view.items.some((item) => item.disabledAt !== null);
    const admin = state.role === "admin";
    const events = view.mayEvents.filter((kind) => kind !== "hold_extended");
    const hold = view.hold;
    const extendable = admin && view.closedAt === null && view.kind === "tco_removal" && view.sectionC && hold !== null && !hold.extended && hold.releasedAt === null && hold.endedAt === null;
    return { ...view, mayCorrect: view.closedAt !== null ? null : !given ? "entry" : admin ? "admin" : "caution", mayEvents: extendable ? [...events, "hold_extended"] : events };
  }

  /** The nearest deadline of the contact point's mail or of an order with an item still open, as the overview answers it. */
  function nearestDue(): string | null {
    const dues = [state.authorities.contact.dueAt, ...state.orders.filter((order) => order.closedAt === null && order.clock !== null && order.clock.itemsOpen > 0).map((order) => order.clock!.deadlineAt)];
    return dues.filter((due): due is string => due !== null).sort()[0] ?? null;
  }

  /** A step-up challenge in the contracts' layout; its seal is random, since only this server reads it back. */
  async function stepUpChallenge(sessionHandle: string, action: StaffStepUpActionInput): Promise<string> {
    const layout = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
    const bytes = randomBytes(layout.bytes);
    bytes[layout.versionAt] = layout.version;
    bytes[layout.purposeAt] = layout.purpose;
    bytes.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000), layout.expiryAt);
    Buffer.from(await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action))).copy(bytes, layout.bindingAt);
    return bytes.toString("base64url");
  }

  /**
   * A case as its route answers it: with the person's saved texts of a decision's kinds that no decision has named yet,
   * oldest first, each with its salt, so that the page can hold it to its digest. The forged draft, where a step asked for
   * one, carries this server's words under the saved digest.
   */
  function caseAnswer(view: CaseView): CaseView {
    const drafts = state.texts
      .filter((text) => text.caseId === view.id && DRAFT_KINDS.includes(text.kind) && !text.used)
      .map((text): StaffTextDraft => ({ id: text.id, kind: text.kind as StaffTextDraft["kind"], text: text.text, salt: text.salt, digest: text.digest, createdAt: text.createdAt }));
    const forged = state.forgedDraft;
    const last = forged !== null && forged.caseId === view.id ? drafts.findLast((draft) => draft.kind === forged.kind) : undefined;
    return { ...view, drafts: drafts.map((draft) => (draft === last ? { ...draft, text: FORGED_DRAFT } : draft)) };
  }

  /**
   * The appeals of the fixtures' cases that no review has answered, newest first, as the list's route answers them: each
   * with its case, its decision and the marks the case's own answer carries, and never the appellant's statement.
   */
  /** 3e Task 4: the replies that wait in the fixtures' cases, oldest first, as the queue's first page lists them: never their text. */
  function queueReplies(): QueueReply[] {
    const rows: QueueReply[] = [];
    for (const view of state.cases.values()) {
      for (const decided of view.decisions) {
        for (const action of decided.actions) {
          if ((action.kind !== "suspend" && action.kind !== "terminate") || !action.reply || action.reply.answeredAt !== null) continue;
          rows.push({ caseId: view.id, decisionId: decided.id, kind: action.kind, days: action.days, filedAt: action.reply.filedAt, onTime: action.reply.onTime, endsAt: action.period?.endsAt ?? null });
        }
      }
    }
    return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.filedAt < b.filedAt ? -1 : 1));
  }

  /**
   * 3e Task 4: the Standing screen's four lists, each with a row the walk reads: an account at the ladder's strikes whose
   * handle the walk opens a case on, a reporting record, a notice korbat could not send (a hostile handle, shown as text)
   * and a termination that waits for its appeal.
   */
  function standingLists(): StandingLists {
    return {
      atThreeStrikes: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: STANDING_HANDLE, caseId: null, activeStrikes: 3, ruleId: "R1", newestOn: "2026-10-04", maxDays: 3, mayTerminate: false }] },
      reportingRecords: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "rep_orter", caseId: null, reports: 8, unfounded: 5, warnedOn: null, marksSince: null }] },
      noticesUndelivered: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_POST, decidedOn: "2026-10-01", startsAt: "2026-10-15T09:00:00.000Z" }] },
      terminationsWaiting: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "term_inated", caseId: CASE_POST, decidedOn: "2026-09-01", finalOn: null, heldBy: "appeal", replyOnTime: null }] },
    };
  }

  function pendingAppeals(): AppealRow[] {
    const rows: AppealRow[] = [];
    for (const view of state.cases.values()) {
      for (const appeal of view.appeals) {
        const decided = view.decisions.find((found) => found.id === appeal.decisionId);
        if (appeal.result !== null || appeal.reviewer === null || !decided) continue;
        rows.push({
          id: appeal.id,
          caseId: view.id,
          decisionId: decided.id,
          filedAt: appeal.filedAt,
          decidedAt: decided.decidedAt,
          deadline: iso(Date.parse(decided.decidedAt) + 182 * 24 * HOUR),
          ruleId: decided.ruleId,
          legal: decided.ground === "illegal",
          actions: decided.actions.map((action) => action.kind),
          reviewer: appeal.reviewer,
          needsAdmin: appeal.needsAdmin,
          mayReview: appeal.mayReview,
          standingFirst: false,
        });
      }
    }
    return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.filedAt < b.filedAt ? 1 : -1));
  }

  function parse<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, body: unknown, what: string): T {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      problem(`${what}: a body the contracts refuse`);
      throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
    }
    return parsed.data;
  }

  /** One staff route's answer. */
  async function route(req: IncomingMessage, url: URL, body: unknown): Promise<Answer> {
    const key = `${req.method} ${url.pathname}`;

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/enroll/options") {
      const input = parse(StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, body, key);
      if (input.token !== state.enrolmentToken || state.enrolmentUsed) throw refuse("staff_enrollment_invalid");
      // Bound, as the API binds it, to the enrolment's id, which the page is never told: random bytes stand for its hash.
      const challenge = ceremonyChallenge("staff_register", randomBytes(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE.bindingBytes));
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "register" });
      const securityKey = input.kind === "security_key";
      // As @simplewebauthn/server 14.0.2 writes them for the console: the security-key hint only with cross-platform attachment.
      const options = {
        challenge,
        rp: { id: "localhost", name: "korbat" },
        user: { id: userHandle, name: input.name, displayName: input.name },
        pubKeyCredParams: [-8, -7, -257].map((alg) => ({ alg, type: "public-key" })),
        timeout: 300_000,
        attestation: "none",
        excludeCredentials: state.keys.filter((k) => k.credentialId !== null).map((k) => ({ id: k.credentialId, type: "public-key" })),
        authenticatorSelection: { residentKey: "required", userVerification: "required", requireResidentKey: true, ...(securityKey ? { authenticatorAttachment: "cross-platform" } : {}) },
        extensions: { credProps: true },
        ...(securityKey ? { hints: ["security-key"] } : {}),
      };
      // As in production, the console's relying party ID is not the app's, so the page may signal a refused key.
      return { status: 200, body: { options, rpShared: false } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/enroll/verify") {
      const input = parse(StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, body, key);
      if (input.token !== state.enrolmentToken || state.enrolmentUsed) throw refuse("staff_enrollment_invalid");
      clientData(input.response.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.create", "register", "staff_key_refused");
      const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(authDataOf(Buffer.from(input.response.response.attestationObject, "base64url"))));
      // A refusal leaves the link usable, so the person can try another key.
      if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal);
      state.enrolmentUsed = true;
      const stored: KeyRecord = { id: randomUUID(), name: input.name, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), lastUsedAt: null, credentialId: input.response.id };
      state.keys.push(stored);
      return { status: 200, body: { key: { id: stored.id, name: stored.name, createdAt: stored.createdAt, lastUsedAt: stored.lastUsedAt } } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signin/options") {
      if (body !== undefined) problem(`${key}: a body, where the route takes none`);
      state.signInOptionsServed += 1;
      if (state.stepUpChallengeAtNextSignIn) {
        state.stepUpChallengeAtNextSignIn = false;
        // The forged case: a step-up challenge for revoking one of the person's sessions, bound to a handle of this
        // server's choosing. Never recorded as issued, so an assertion made over it would be a problem here too.
        const victim = [...state.sessions.values()][0]?.handle ?? randomUUID();
        const challenge = await stepUpChallenge(randomUUID(), { action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: victim }, params: {} });
        return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: [] } } };
      }
      const challenge = ceremonyChallenge("staff_signin");
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "signin" });
      return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: [] } } };
    }

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signin/verify") {
      const input = parse(StaffSignInVerifyRequest, body, key);
      clientData(input.response.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "signin", "staff_key_invalid");
      const staffKey = state.keys.find((k) => k.credentialId !== null && k.credentialId === input.response.id);
      if (!staffKey || input.response.response.userHandle !== userHandle) throw refuse("staff_key_invalid");
      const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(input.response.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
      // Read after the signature, as the API reads them; staff_key_refused stands for flags it cannot read at all.
      if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_key_invalid" : refusal);
      staffKey.lastUsedAt = iso(Date.now());
      const session: SessionRecord = {
        handle: randomUUID(),
        token: b64url(32),
        csrf: b64url(32),
        browser: CURRENT_BROWSER,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastUsedAt: Date.now(),
        credentialId: staffKey.credentialId,
      };
      state.sessions.set(session.handle, session);
      const setCookies = [`${SESSION_COOKIE}=${session.token}; ${COOKIE}; HttpOnly; Max-Age=43200`, `${CSRF_COOKIE}=${session.csrf}; ${COOKIE}; Max-Age=43200`];
      return { status: 200, body: me(session), headers: { "set-cookie": setCookies } };
    }

    // Everything below needs a staff session.
    const routes = new Set([
      "GET /api/staff/me",
      "GET /api/staff/sessions",
      "GET /api/staff/keys",
      "GET /api/staff/audit",
      "POST /api/staff/signout",
      "POST /api/staff/step-up/options",
      "GET /api/staff/overview",
      "GET /api/staff/queue",
      "GET /api/staff/appeals",
      "POST /api/staff/findings",
      "GET /api/staff/standing",
      // 3f: the contact point.
      "GET /api/staff/contact",
      // 3f, Task 2: the orders.
      "GET /api/staff/orders",
      "POST /api/staff/orders",
      // 3f, Task 6: the audit log's download and its mark, and what a restore lost.
      "POST /api/staff/audit/export",
      "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark",
      "GET /api/staff/restore",
    ]);
    const revoke = req.method === "DELETE" && /^\/api\/staff\/sessions\/[^/]+$/.test(url.pathname);
    const ofCase = /^\/api\/staff\/cases\/([0-9a-f-]{36})(?:\/(snapshots|texts|decisions))?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    const image = req.method === "GET" ? IMAGE_PATH.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    const reveal = req.method === "POST" ? /^\/api\/staff\/items\/([0-9a-f-]{36})\/reveal$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    const review = req.method === "POST" ? /^\/api\/staff\/decisions\/([0-9a-f-]{36})\/review$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3f: a message closed, by its id in the path. An id that is no lower-case uuid is the route's 400, as the API's.
    const closing = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]contact[/]([^/]+)[/]close$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3f, Task 2: an order, its links, its events and its corrections, by its id in the path.
    const ofOrder = /^[/]api[/]staff[/]orders[/]([^/]+)(?:[/](items|events|correct|effect))?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    // 3f, Task 6: a gap closed as not needed, by its id in the path.
    const gapClose = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]restore[/]gaps[/]([0-9a-f-]{36})[/]close$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    // 3d Task 2: an admin's release of a seal for good, by the seal's ledger row.
    const sealRelease = req.method === "POST" ? /^[/]api[/]staff[/]seals[/]([0-9a-f-]{36})[/]release$/.exec(url.pathname) : null;
    if (!routes.has(key) && !revoke && !ofCase && !image && !reveal && !review && !closing && !ofOrder && !gapClose && !sealRelease) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    const session = requireStaff(req);

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3), answered from the fixtures' cases.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/overview") {
      // The path's three lists: one decision of another staff account that answered a report without a seal, and what
      // the walk itself did, read from the cases as they now stand.
      const cases = [...state.cases.values()];
      const declined = cases.flatMap((view) => view.sealsDeclined.filter((text) => text.staffHandle === PERSON_HANDLE).map((text) => ({ at: text.createdAt, handle: text.staffHandle, caseId: view.id })));
      const seals = cases.flatMap((view) =>
        view.decisions
          .filter((decided) => decided.kind === "interim" && decided.staffHandle === PERSON_HANDLE)
          .flatMap((decided) => decided.actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "seal_media" && action.inForce).map((action) => ({ at: decided.decidedAt, handle: decided.staffHandle, caseId: view.id, posts: action.sealed?.posts ?? 0, images: action.sealed?.images ?? 0 }))),
      );
      // The appeals: those of the fixtures' cases that still wait, and one more that nobody at korbat can review now.
      const waiting = pendingAppeals().length + 1;
      return {
        status: 200,
        body: overview({
          appealsWaiting: waiting,
          appealsYouMayReview: pendingAppeals().filter((row) => row.mayReview).length,
          appealsWithoutReviewer: 1,
          reveals: { total: 1 + state.reveals.length, items: [{ at: iso(now - 26 * HOUR), handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_POST }] },
          protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: iso(now - 3 * HOUR), handle: HOSTILE.img, caseId: CASE_FROZEN, kind: "dismissed" }] },
          sealsDeclined: { total: declined.length, items: declined },
          interimSeals: { total: seals.length, items: seals },
          // Two due rules are late, so the home screen shows its line for late erasures with the runbook's sentence.
          erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 2 },
          // 3f: what the walk's step set, nothing at the contact point and a working channel otherwise.
          ...state.authorities,
          contact: { ...state.authorities.contact, dueAt: nearestDue() },
          reportsOwed: state.reportsOwed,
          copy: state.copy,
          restore: state.restoreOverview,
          quarantine: state.quarantine,
          destructive: state.destructive,
        }),
      };
    }
    // 3f: the contact point's messages, newest first, all or only those nobody handled, a page at a time.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/contact") {
      const open = url.searchParams.get("open");
      const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor");
      if ((open !== null && open !== "1") || (cursor !== null && !/^[0-9]+$/.test(cursor))) throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      const listed = state.contactMessages.filter((m) => open === null || m.disposition === null).sort((a, b) => b.receivedAt.localeCompare(a.receivedAt));
      const from = cursor === null ? 0 : Number(cursor);
      const items = listed.slice(from, from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
      return { status: 200, body: { items, nextCursor: from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE < listed.length ? String(from + CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE) : null } };
    }
    if (closing) {
      const id = closing[1]!;
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id)) {
        problem(`POST ${url.pathname}: an id that is not a lower-case uuid`);
        throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      }
      const request = parse(ContactCloseRequest, body, "the close of a message");
      const found = state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (found.disposition !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "message_handled");
      found.disposition = request.disposition;
      found.handledBy = PERSON_HANDLE;
      found.handledAt = new Date().toISOString();
      state.contactClosed.push({ id, disposition: request.disposition });
      return { status: 204 };
    }
    // 3f, Task 2: the orders, opened from a message or without one, with their links, their events and their corrections.
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/orders") {
      const open = state.orders.filter((order) => order.closedAt === null).map(orderSummary);
      return { status: 200, body: { open, closed: state.orders.filter((order) => order.closedAt !== null).map(orderSummary) } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/orders") {
      const request = parse(OrderOpenRequest, body, "the opening of an order");
      const at = new Date().toISOString();
      const message = request.messageId === null ? null : (state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === request.messageId) ?? null);
      if (request.messageId !== null && message === null) throw new Refusal(422, "order_needs_message");
      if (message !== null && message.disposition !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "message_handled");
      const tco = request.kind === "tco_removal";
      const receivedAt = message === null ? null : message.receivedAt;
      const items = request.links.map((link, i) => orderItem(link, i + 1, at));
      const view: OrderView = {
        id: randomUUID(),
        kind: request.kind,
        memberState: request.memberState,
        authority: request.authority,
        reference: request.reference,
        openedAt: at,
        state: !tco ? "no_clock" : receivedAt === null ? "unknown_deadline" : "running",
        clock: tco ? runningClock(receivedAt, items.length) : null,
        dueAt: null,
        closedAt: null,
        closeGround: null,
        items,
        itemsInForce: 0,
        verified: false,
        noticesHeld: 0,
        channel: request.channel,
        messageId: request.messageId,
        receivedAt,
        sentAt: null,
        issuedAt: null,
        sectionC: request.sectionC,
        emergency: request.emergency,
        crossBorder: request.memberState !== "DE",
        withholdFromAuthor: request.withholdFromAuthor,
        preserve: tco,
        openedBy: PERSON_HANDLE,
        openedVia: "console",
        importedAt: null,
        tellPerson: null,
        events: [{ id: randomUUID(), kind: "opened", ground: null, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" }],
        owed: { received: receivedAt === null, verification: true, issuedAt: tco, texts: true, document: true, holdUntil: false, tellPerson: request.kind === "dsa_art10", scrutinyUntil: null },
        hold: request.sectionC ? { until: null, basis: tco ? "regulation" : "authority", open: true, extended: false, endedAt: null, endReason: null, releasedAt: null, noticesHeld: 0 } : null,
        mayClose: true,
        mayEvents: tco ? ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"] : ["receipt_confirmed", "closed_without_effect"],
        mayCorrect: "entry",
      };
      state.orders.push(view);
      if (message !== null) Object.assign(message, { disposition: "order", handledAt: at, handledBy: PERSON_HANDLE, orders: [view.id] });
      state.orderWrites.push({ what: "opened", id: view.id, body: request, key: false });
      return { status: 201, body: view };
    }
    if (ofOrder) {
      const id = ofOrder[1]!;
      const part = ofOrder[2];
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id)) {
        problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: an id that is not a lower-case uuid`);
        throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      }
      const view = state.orders.find((order) => order.id === id);
      if (!view) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (req.method === "GET" && part === undefined) return { status: 200, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      if (req.method !== "POST" || part === undefined) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      const at = new Date().toISOString();
      if (part === "items") {
        const request = parse(OrderItemsRequest, body, "the links added to an order");
        view.items.push(...request.links.map((link, i) => orderItem(link, view.items.length + i + 1, at)));
        if (view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen += request.links.length;
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "items", id, body: request, key: false });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "events") {
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(OrderEventRecordRequest, body, "an order's event");
        await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "order_event_recorded", target: { type: "order", id }, params }, session);
        if (!orderAnswer(view).mayEvents.includes(params.kind)) throw new Refusal(422, "order_event_refused");
        // 3f, Task 3: a removal order's one extension, recorded by an admin: the hold runs its extension longer, once.
        if (params.kind === "hold_extended" && view.hold !== null && view.hold.until !== null) {
          view.hold = { ...view.hold, extended: true, until: iso(Date.parse(view.hold.until) + ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays * 86_400_000) };
          const message = state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === params.messageId);
          if (message) Object.assign(message, { disposition: "order", handledAt: at, handledBy: PERSON_HANDLE, orders: [view.id] });
        }
        const clock = view.clock;
        if (params.kind === "annex3_sent" && clock !== null && params.ground !== null) {
          Object.assign(clock, { stopped: true, stoppedAt: at, stopGround: params.ground, deadlineAt: null, targetAt: null });
          view.state = "stopped";
          view.mayEvents = ["grounds_ceased", "clarification_received", "closed_without_effect"];
        }
        if ((params.kind === "clarification_received" || params.kind === "grounds_ceased") && clock !== null) {
          // A fresh hour from the clarification's delivery, or from the Annex III when that is later; from now when the grounds cease.
          const message = params.messageId === null ? null : state.contactMessages.find((m) => m.id === params.messageId);
          const from = message ? iso(Math.max(Date.parse(message.receivedAt), Date.parse(clock.stoppedAt ?? at))) : at;
          Object.assign(clock, runningClock(from, clock.itemsOpen), { stoppedAt: null, stopGround: null });
          view.state = "running";
          view.mayEvents = ["annex3_sent", "closed_without_effect"];
        }
        view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: params.kind, ground: params.ground, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "event", id, body: params, key: true });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "correct") {
        const request = parse(OrderCorrectRequest, body, "the correction of an order");
        const rule = orderAnswer(view).mayCorrect;
        if (rule === null) throw new Refusal(409, "order_closed");
        if (rule === "caution" && Object.keys(request.facts).some((member) => member !== "sectionC")) throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
        if (rule === "admin") {
          if (request.stepUp === undefined) throw refuse("staff_step_up_required");
          await confirmedOrder(request.stepUp, { action: "order_corrected", target: { type: "order", id }, params: { facts: request.facts } }, session);
        } else if (request.stepUp !== undefined) problem(`${url.pathname}: a key asked for a correction under the rule ${rule}`);
        const { closeItems, ...facts } = request.facts;
        for (const close of closeItems ?? []) {
          const item = view.items.find((found) => found.id === close.itemId);
          if (!item || item.closedAt !== null || item.disabledAt !== null) throw new Refusal(422, "order_event_refused");
          Object.assign(item, { closedAt: at, closedReason: close.reason });
          if (view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen -= 1;
        }
        Object.assign(view, facts);
        view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: "corrected", ground: rule, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: null, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "corrected", id, body: request.facts, key: request.stepUp !== undefined });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      if (part === "effect") {
        // 3f, Task 3: "Disable for an order", confirmed by the key over exactly these facts and these items.
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(OrderEffectRequest, body, "an order's effect");
        await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "order_effected", target: { type: "order", id }, params }, session);
        if (view.closedAt !== null) throw new Refusal(409, "order_closed");
        if (view.kind === "dsa_art9" && !view.verified && !(state.role === "admin" && params.urgent)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_not_verified");
        const facts: Record<string, unknown> = { kind: view.kind, memberState: view.memberState, authority: view.authority, reference: view.reference, sectionC: view.sectionC, emergency: view.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: view.withholdFromAuthor };
        if (Object.entries(facts).some(([member, value]) => (params as Record<string, unknown>)[member] !== value)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_changed");
        const chosen = params.items.map((one) => view.items.find((item) => item.id === one.itemId && item.postId === one.postId && !item.inForce && item.closedAt === null));
        if (chosen.some((item) => item === undefined)) throw new Refusal(409, "order_changed");
        for (const item of chosen as OrderItemView[]) {
          if (item.disabledAt === null && view.clock !== null) view.clock.itemsOpen -= 1;
          Object.assign(item, {
            inForce: true,
            disabledAt: item.disabledAt ?? at,
            decisionId: randomUUID(),
            caseId: randomUUID(),
            preserveUntil: view.preserve ? preservedUntil(at) : null,
            preserveEndedAt: null,
            erasedAt: null,
            reinstatedAt: null,
            reinstatedGround: null,
