```ts
            post: item.post === null ? null : { ...item.post, state: "disabled", preview: null },
          });
          view.events.push({ id: randomUUID(), kind: "effect_given", ground: null, at, effectiveAt: null, itemId: item.id, by: PERSON_HANDLE, via: "console" });
        }
        view.itemsInForce = view.items.filter((item) => item.inForce).length;
        const open = view.items.filter((item) => item.disabledAt === null && item.closedAt === null).length;
        if (view.clock !== null) {
          view.clock.firstEffectAt ??= at;
          view.clock.lastEffectAt = at;
          if (open === 0) Object.assign(view.clock, { withinHour: view.clock.deadlineAt === null ? null : Date.parse(at) <= Date.parse(view.clock.deadlineAt) });
        }
        if (open === 0) view.state = "given_effect";
        view.mayEvents = [...view.mayEvents.filter((kind) => kind !== "closed_without_effect" && kind !== "annex2_sent"), ...(view.kind === "tco_removal" ? (["annex2_sent"] as const) : [])];
        state.orderWrites.push({ what: "effected", id, body: params, key: true });
        return { status: 201, body: orderAnswer(view) };
      }
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/standing") return { status: 200, body: standingLists() };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/queue") {
      // Two pages: the two urgent cases, then the rest behind a cursor.
      const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor");
      if (cursor !== null && cursor !== "second-page") throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      const page: QueuePage = cursor === null ? { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(0, 2), nextCursor: "second-page", replies: queueReplies() } : { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(2), nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
      return { status: 200, body: page };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/appeals") {
      // One page: what waits in the fixtures' cases, newest first, and an appeal of a seal that only an admin reviews and
      // that korbat's one admin took part in, so that the list shows each mark.
      if (url.searchParams.get("cursor") !== null) throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
      const unreviewable: AppealRow = {
        id: "28a1b20d-7c39-4b0d-84a9-58f746db2a23",
        caseId: CASE_FROZEN,
        decisionId: "39b2c31e-8d4a-4c1e-95ba-69a857ec3b34",
        filedAt: iso(now - 30 * HOUR),
        decidedAt: iso(now - 9 * 24 * HOUR),
        deadline: iso(now + 170 * 24 * HOUR),
        ruleId: "R2",
        legal: false,
        actions: ["seal_media"],
        reviewer: "none_single_staff",
        needsAdmin: true,
        mayReview: false,
        standingFirst: false,
        released: state.appealReleased,
      };
      return { status: 200, body: { appeals: [unreviewable, ...pendingAppeals()], nextCursor: null } satisfies AppealsPage };
    }
    if (review) {
      const what = "POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review";
      const decisionId = review[1]!;
      const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(AppealReviewRequest, body, what);
      const found = [...state.cases.values()].find((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.id === decisionId));
      const reviewed = found?.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === decisionId);
      if (!found || !reviewed) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      // The assertion: by the session's own key, over a challenge issued for exactly this review of exactly this decision.
      const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
      const hash = await stepUpActionHash({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
      if (issued.target !== decisionId || issued.hash !== hash || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
        problem(`${what}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}, over ${issued.hash === hash ? "these" : "other"} params`);
        throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
      }
      if (params.stateVersion !== found.stateVersion) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
      const appeal = found.appeals.find((filed) => filed.decisionId === decisionId && filed.result === null);
      // The appeal the key confirmed is the decision's pending one, and this person is one the case's answer let review it.
      if (!appeal || appeal.id !== params.appealId) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
      if (!appeal.mayReview) {
        problem(`${what}: a review by someone the case's answer did not mark as its reviewer`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.reviewer_conflict, "reviewer_conflict");
      }
      const [newest] = found.snapshots;
      const shownDigest = !newest || newest.withheld ? null : await snapshotDigest({ ...newest });
      if (!newest || params.snapshotId !== newest.id || params.snapshotDigest !== shownDigest) {
        problem(`${what}: a snapshot that is not the case's newest as the page was shown it`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.snapshot_mismatch, "snapshot_mismatch");
      }
      // The reason: one the page saved on this case as a review reason, not yet used, and never a digest this server made up.
      const saved = state.texts.find((text) => text.caseId === found.id && text.kind === "review_reason" && text.digest === params.reasonDigest && !text.used);
      if (!saved || state.forgedDigests.includes(params.reasonDigest)) {
        problem(`${what}: a review reason the page did not save on this case`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
      }
      // A review lifts what is still in force of the reviewed decision, and its answer says how much.
      // 3e: the strike is not lifted one by one: it is overruled with the whole finding, and only then.
      const inForce = reviewed.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null && action.kind !== "strike" && action.inForce).length;
      const lifted = params.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "overrule").length;
      if ((params.outcome === "kept" && lifted !== 0) || (params.outcome === "reversed" && lifted !== inForce) || (params.outcome === "partly_reversed" && (lifted === 0 || lifted >= inForce))) {
        problem(`${what}: an answer that its reversals do not bear out`);
        throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
      }
      const strikeIssue = strikeProblem(found, "review", params.outcome, null, null, params.actions, reviewed);
      if (strikeIssue !== null) {
        problem(`${what}: ${strikeIssue}`);
        throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
      }
      saved.used = true;
      state.reviews.push({ decisionId, params });
      applyReview(found, reviewed, params, saved.text, PERSON_HANDLE);
      return { status: 201, body: caseAnswer(found) };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/findings") {
      const finding = parse(FindingRequest, body, key);
      if (finding.target.kind === "link" && finding.target.url === DEAD_LINK) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      state.findings.push(finding);
      return { status: 201, body: { caseId: CASE_POST } };
    }
    if (image) {
      const found = state.cases.get(image[1]!);
      state.imageRequests.push(url.pathname);
      if (state.refuseNextImage) {
        state.refuseNextImage = false;
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.image_refused, "image_refused");
      }
      // As gate V and the image route answer: only an image of the case's own post, and none while it is frozen.
      const listed = found?.snapshots.some((snapshot) => !snapshot.withheld && snapshot.media?.some((media) => media.id === image[2]));
      if (!found || !found.imagesAllowed || !listed) {
        problem(`${key}: an image the console must not ask for`);
        throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.image_refused, "image_refused");
      }
      return { status: 200, raw: { type: "image/webp", bytes: FIXTURE_WEBP }, headers: { "cache-control": "private, no-store", "x-content-type-options": "nosniff" } };
    }
    if (ofCase) {
      const found = state.cases.get(ofCase[1]!);
      if (!found) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      if (ofCase[2] === undefined && req.method === "GET") {
        if (state.recuseNextCaseRead) {
          state.recuseNextCaseRead = false;
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.staff_recused, "staff_recused");
        }
        return { status: 200, body: caseAnswer(found) };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "snapshots" && req.method === "POST") {
        state.snapshotsTaken += 1;
        // The fresh snapshot holds the account's fields as they read now; the case then carries it first.
        const [newest] = found.snapshots;
        if (found.target.type === "account" && newest && !newest.withheld) {
          found.snapshots = [{ ...newest, id: randomUUID(), takenAt: iso(Date.now()), handle: found.target.handle, displayName: found.target.displayName, bio: found.target.bio }, ...found.snapshots];
        }
        return { status: 200, body: { id: found.snapshots[0]!.id, digest: found.snapshots[0]!.digest } };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "texts" && req.method === "GET") return { status: 200, body: { texts: [] } };
      if (ofCase[2] === "texts" && req.method === "POST") {
        const saved = parse(StaffTextSaveRequest, body, key);
        // No text is saved empty: the page's own buttons and its save never send one.
        if (saved.text.trim() === "") {
          problem(`${key}: an empty text`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
        // The server recomputes the digest: the console must have sent the digest of exactly the text it sent.
        if ((await textDigest(saved.salt, saved.text)) !== saved.digest) {
          problem(`${key}: a digest that is not the text's`);
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_invalid, "text_invalid");
        }
        if (state.refuseNextSave !== null) {
          const code = state.refuseNextSave;
          state.refuseNextSave = null;
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS[code], code);
        }
        const id = randomUUID();
        const stored = { id, caseId: found.id, kind: saved.kind, salt: saved.salt, createdAt: iso(Date.now()) };
        if (state.hostileNextSave) {
          state.hostileNextSave = false;
          // The forged case: a text of this server's own is stored in the person's name, and its digest answered. A
          // reveal confirmed under that digest would go through here, so only the page's own check stops it.
          const digest = await textDigest(saved.salt, FORGED_REASON);
          state.texts.push({ ...stored, text: FORGED_REASON, digest });
          state.forgedDigests.push(digest);
          return { status: 201, body: { id, digest } };
        }
        state.texts.push({ ...stored, text: saved.text, digest: saved.digest });
        // A note and a recorded choice not to seal are complete when saved, and listed on the case.
        if (saved.kind === "note") found.notes = [...found.notes, { id, staffHandle: PERSON_HANDLE, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), text: saved.text }];
        if (saved.kind === "seal_declined") found.sealsDeclined = [...found.sealsDeclined, { id, staffHandle: PERSON_HANDLE, createdAt: iso(Date.now()), text: saved.text }];
        return { status: 201, body: { id, digest: saved.digest } };
      }
      if (ofCase[2] === "decisions" && req.method === "POST") {
        const what = "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions";
        const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(CaseDecisionRequest, body, what);
        // The assertion: by the session's own key, over a challenge issued for exactly this decision on exactly this case.
        const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
        const hash = await stepUpActionHash({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: found.id }, params });
        if (issued.target !== found.id || issued.hash !== hash || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
          problem(`${what}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}, over ${issued.hash === hash ? "these" : "other"} params`);
          throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
        }
        const flags = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
        if (flags) throw refuse(flags === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : flags);
        if (params.stateVersion !== found.stateVersion) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.case_changed, "case_changed");
        // The snapshot: the case's newest, under the digest of what the page was shown, recomputed here from its members.
        const [newest] = found.snapshots;
        // 3f, Task 3: on a post preserved for an order every copy is withheld, and the decision signs the newest's stored digest.
        const shownDigest = !newest ? null : newest.withheld ? (found.preserved ? newest.digest : null) : await snapshotDigest({ ...newest });
        if (!newest || params.snapshotId !== newest.id || params.snapshotDigest !== shownDigest) {
          problem(`${what}: a snapshot that is not the case's newest as the page was shown it`);
          throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.snapshot_mismatch, "snapshot_mismatch");
        }
        // 3e: the strike and its overruling, as the database holds them to the case's answer and the corrected decision.
        const strikeIssue = strikeProblem(found, params.kind, params.outcome, params.ground, params.ruleId, params.actions, found.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === params.reviewsDecisionId));
        if (strikeIssue !== null) {
          problem(`${what}: ${strikeIssue}`);
          throw params.kind === "correction" ? new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision") : new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.strike_mismatch, "strike_mismatch");
        }
        // Each text the decision names: one the page saved on this case, of its kind, not yet used, and never a digest this server made up.
        const named = [
          ["facts", params.factsDigest],
          [params.kind === "correction" ? "review_reason" : "reason", params.reasonDigest],
          ["legal_reference", params.legalReferenceDigest],
        ] as const;
        const texts: (string | null)[] = [];
        for (const [kind, digest] of named) {
          const saved = digest === null ? undefined : state.texts.find((text) => text.caseId === found.id && text.kind === kind && text.digest === digest && !text.used);
          if (digest !== null && (!saved || state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) {
            problem(`${what}: a ${kind} text the page did not save on this case`);
            throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
          }

        const unmarkable = params.unfounded.filter((itemId) => !found.items.some((each) => each.id === itemId && each.markable && each.outcome === null && each.seq <= params.throughSeq));
        if (unmarkable.length > 0) {
          problem(`${what}: a mark on an item this decision does not answer or that cannot be marked`);
          throw new Refusal(422, "invalid_decision");
        }
        state.decisions.push({ caseId: found.id, params });
        applyDecision(found, params, { facts: texts[0] ?? null, reason: texts[1] ?? null, legalReference: texts[2] ?? null }, PERSON_HANDLE);
        return { status: 201, body: caseAnswer(found) };
      }
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    if (reveal) {
      const itemId = reveal[1]!;
      const input = parse(IdentityRevealRequest, body, "POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal");
      const issued = clientData(input.stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
      if (issued.target !== itemId || input.stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
        problem(`reveal ${itemId}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${input.stepUp.id}`);
        throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
      }
      const owner = [...state.cases.values()].find((view) => view.items.some((item) => item.id === itemId));
      // The reason must be one the page saved on the item's case, and used once.
      const reason = state.texts.find((text) => text.kind === "reveal_reason" && text.digest === input.reasonDigest && text.caseId === owner?.id);
      if (!owner || !reason || state.reveals.some((done) => done.reasonDigest === input.reasonDigest)) throw new Refusal(MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS.text_not_found, "text_not_found");
      state.reveals.push({ itemId, reasonDigest: input.reasonDigest });
      return { status: 200, body: { handle: REVEALED_HANDLE, name: null } };
    }

    if (key === "GET /api/staff/me") return { status: 200, body: me(session) };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/sessions") {
      const sessions: StaffSession[] = [...state.sessions.values()].map((s) => ({
        handle: s.handle,
        browser: s.browser,
        createdAt: iso(s.createdAt),
        lastUsedAt: iso(s.lastUsedAt),
        current: s === session,
      }));
      return { status: 200, body: { sessions } };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/keys") return { status: 200, body: { keys: state.keys.map((k): StaffKey => ({ id: k.id, name: k.name, createdAt: k.createdAt, lastUsedAt: k.lastUsedAt })) } };
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/audit") return { status: 200, body: auditPage(url.searchParams) };
    // 3f, Task 6 (7.16): the download, confirmed by the session's key for exactly these places; its mark, only for the
    // place the session's newest download released and the hash that place holds.
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/audit/export") {
      const input = parse(AuditExportRequest, body, key);
      if (input.stepUp === undefined) throw new Refusal(403, "staff_step_up_required");
      const params = { after: input.after, through: input.through };
      await confirmedOrder(input.stepUp, { action: "audit_exported", target: { type: "audit", id: String(params.through) }, params } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      state.exports.push(params);
      const cut = state.exportCut;
      state.exportCut = null;
      return { status: 200, raw: { type: "application/x-ndjson", bytes: exportBody(params.after, params.through, cut) } };
    }
    if (key === "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark") {
      const input = parse(AuditMarkRequest, body, key);
      const released = state.exports.at(-1);
      const row = state.audit.find((found) => found.seq === input.through);
      if (released === undefined || released.through !== input.through || row?.hash !== input.hash) throw new Refusal(409, "copy_mismatch");
      state.copyPlace = input.through;
      state.marks.push(input);
      return { status: 204 };
    }
    if (key === "GET /api/staff/restore") return { status: 200, body: state.restore };
    if (sealRelease) {
      // 3d Task 2: the release, as the API answers it: an admin's, under a key that confirmed exactly this seal, these
      // posts, the ground and the recorded leave with its reference as the case showed them; the case as it now stands.
      if (state.role !== "admin") throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
      const what = "POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release";
      const { stepUp, ...params } = parse(SealReleaseRequest, body, what);
      const actionId = sealRelease[1]!;
      await confirmedOrder(stepUp, { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: actionId }, params } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      const found = [...state.cases.entries()].find(([, view]) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === actionId)));
      if (found === undefined) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      const [caseId, view] = found;
      const sealing = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === actionId))!;
      const block = sealing.release;
      if (block === undefined || block.leave === null || block.leave.id !== params.leaveId || block.leave.reference !== params.theirReference || block.postIds.join(",") !== params.postIds.join(",")) {

      }
      const released = {
        ...block,
        postIds: [],
        remaining: 0,
        releasedAt: iso(Date.now()),
        basis: "leave" as const,
        backupsClearAt: iso(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * HOUR),
        noticeHeld: block.tellHeld,
        releasedPosts: block.releasedPosts + params.postIds.length,
        releasedImages: block.releasedImages + 2 * params.postIds.length,

      const custody = sealing.custody === undefined ? undefined : { ...sealing.custody, files: 0, moved: 0, movedAt: null, filesLeft: sealing.custody.moved };
      const answered = { ...view, decisions: view.decisions.map((decided) => (decided.id === sealing.id ? { ...decided, release: released, ...(custody === undefined ? {} : { custody }) } : decided)) };
      state.cases.set(caseId, answered);

    if (gapClose) {
      if (state.role !== "admin") throw new Refusal(403, "admin_required");
      const input = parse(GapCloseBody, body, "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close");
      const id = gapClose[1]!;
      await confirmedOrder(input.stepUp, { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id }, params: { disposition: "not_needed" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput, session);
      const gap = state.restore.gaps.find((found) => found.id === id && found.closedAt === null);
      if (gap === undefined) throw new Refusal(409, "gap_mismatch");
      state.restore = { ...state.restore, gaps: state.restore.gaps.map((found) => (found.id === id ? { ...found, closedAt: iso(Date.now()), disposition: "not_needed" } : found)) };

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/signout") {

    if (key === "POST /api/staff/step-up/options") {
      const action = parse(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, body, key);

        action.action === "identity_revealed"
          ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.items.some((item) => item.id === action.target.id))
          : action.action === "case_decided"
            ? state.cases.has(action.target.id)
            : action.action === "appeals_reviewed"
              ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.id === action.target.id))
              : action.action === "order_event_recorded" || action.action === "order_corrected" || action.action === "order_effected"
                ? state.orders.some((order) => order.id === action.target.id)
                : action.action === "audit_exported"
                  ? Number(action.target.id) <= Math.max(...state.audit.map((row) => row.seq))
                  : action.action === "gap_closed"
                    ? state.restore.gaps.some((gap) => gap.id === action.target.id)
                    : action.action === "seal_released"
                      ? [...state.cases.values()].some((view) => view.decisions.some((decided) => decided.actions.some((one) => one.id === action.target.id)))
                      : state.sessions.has(action.target.id);
      if (!known) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      // The page builds a reveal's or a decision's params from the digests it computed itself: one a save's answer carried never gets here.
      const decided = action.action === "case_decided" ? CaseDecidedParams.parse(action.params) : null;
      const underDigests = decided ? [decided.factsDigest, decided.reasonDigest, decided.legalReferenceDigest] : action.action === "identity_revealed" || action.action === "appeals_reviewed" ? [(action.params as { reasonDigest: string }).reasonDigest] : [];
      if (underDigests.some((digest) => typeof digest === "string" && state.forgedDigests.includes(digest))) problem(`${key}: an action under a digest the page did not compute`);
      state.stepUpOptionsServed += 1;
      // The mismatched case: an API that asks the key to confirm the revocation of this very session instead of the one
      // chosen; for a reveal, the reveal of another item than the one chosen; for a decision, the same decision on the
      // case's next version, which the page never saw.
      let bound: StaffStepUpActionInput = action;
      if (state.mismatchNextStepUp) {
        if (decided) bound = { action: "case_decided", target: action.target, params: { ...decided, stateVersion: decided.stateVersion + 1 } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        else if (action.action === "order_effected") {
          // 3f, Task 3: the effect of the same order with one more of its items than the page ticked.
          const params = action.params as { items: { itemId: string; postId: string }[] };
          const order = state.orders.find((found) => found.id === action.target.id);
          const extra = order?.items.find((item) => item.postId !== null && !params.items.some((one) => one.itemId === item.id));
          const items = extra ? [...params.items, { itemId: extra.id, postId: extra.postId! }].sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : a.postId > b.postId ? 1 : 0)) : params.items;
          bound = { ...action, params: { ...params, items } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;
        } else if (action.action === "seal_released") {

          bound = { ...action, params: { ...(action.params as object), theirReference: "OTHER 9/99" } } as StaffStepUpActionInput;

      }
      state.mismatchNextStepUp = false;
      const challenge = await stepUpChallenge(session.handle, bound);
      state.challenges.set(challenge, { purpose: "step_up", target: bound.target.id, hash: await stepUpActionHash(bound) });
      const allow = session.credentialId === null ? [] : [{ id: session.credentialId, type: "public-key", transports: ["usb"] }];
      return { status: 200, body: { options: { challenge, rpId: "localhost", timeout: 300_000, userVerification: "required", allowCredentials: allow } } };
    }

    // DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle, confirmed by the session's own key for exactly this session.
    const handle = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice("/api/staff/sessions/".length));
    const { stepUp } = parse(StaffSessionRevokeRequest, body, "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle");
    const issued = clientData(stepUp.response.clientDataJSON, "webauthn.get", "step_up", "staff_step_up_invalid");
    if (issued.target !== handle || stepUp.id !== session.credentialId) {
      problem(`DELETE ${handle}: an assertion for ${String(issued.target)} from ${stepUp.id}`);
      throw refuse("staff_step_up_invalid");
    }
    const refusal = flagRefusal(flagsOf(Buffer.from(stepUp.response.authenticatorData, "base64url")));
    if (refusal) throw refuse(refusal === "staff_key_refused" ? "staff_step_up_invalid" : refusal);
    if (!state.sessions.delete(handle)) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    state.revoked.push(handle);
    return { status: 204 };
  }

  /** The staff gate: the console's Host, an Origin on every write and never another, and same-origin fetch metadata. */
  function gate(req: IncomingMessage) {
    if (req.headers.host !== new URL(state.origin).host) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Host ${String(req.headers.host)}`);
      throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
    }
    const site = req.headers["sec-fetch-site"];
    if (site !== undefined && site !== "same-origin") {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Sec-Fetch-Site ${site}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
    const origin = req.headers.origin;
    if ((origin !== undefined || (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD")) && origin !== state.origin) {
      problem(`${req.method} ${req.url}: Origin ${String(origin)}`);
      throw new Refusal(403, "csrf_failed");
    }
  }

  /** Answers one request under /api/staff, as the API behind Caddy's console site would. */
  async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL, raw: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    let answer: Answer;
    try {
      if (state.off) throw new Refusal(404, "not_found");
      gate(req);
      let body: unknown;
      if (raw.length > 0) {
        try {
          body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8"));
        } catch {
          problem(`${req.method} ${url.pathname}: a body that is not JSON`);
          throw new Refusal(400, "invalid_request");
        }
      }
      answer = await route(req, url, body);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof Refusal)) throw err;
      answer = { status: err.status, body: { error: { code: err.code, message: "the fixture's own words" } }, headers: err.headers };
    }
    state.requests.push({ method: req.method ?? "", path: `${url.pathname}${url.search}`, status: answer.status, activity: req.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1" });
    const headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = { "cache-control": "no-store", ...answer.headers };
    if (answer.raw) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": answer.raw.type, "content-length": String(answer.raw.bytes.length) });
      res.end(answer.raw.bytes);
      return;
    }
    if (answer.body === undefined) {
      res.writeHead(answer.status, headers);
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(answer.status, { ...headers, "content-type": "application/json" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(answer.body));
  }

  return {
    state,
    handle,
    /** Every staff session ends behind the page's back, as a revocation from the command line ends them. */
    endEverySession() {
      state.sessions.clear();
    },
    /**
     * Another staff member decides the case behind the page: a withhold of the post taken while deciding, under rule R6,
     * on the case as it stands. The post is then withheld and the case's version moves on, so a decision the page built
     * on the version it read is answered case_changed.
     */
    decideBehindThePage(caseId: string): void {
      const found = state.cases.get(caseId);
      const [newest] = found?.snapshots ?? [];
      if (!found || !newest) throw new Error("the fixtures hold no such case, or it has no snapshot");
      const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse({
        kind: "interim",
        stateVersion: found.stateVersion,
        throughSeq: 0,
        reviewsDecisionId: null,
        snapshotId: newest.id,
        snapshotDigest: hex64(),
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R6",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        redressVersion: 1,
        category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6,
        categoryKeyword: null,
        actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }],
        factsDigest: hex64(),
        reasonDigest: hex64(),
        legalReferenceDigest: null,
        // 3e: every decision's params carry the marks and the withdrawal; this one sets neither.
        unfounded: [],
        replaced: false,
      });
      applyDecision(found, params, { facts: "The post repeats one link in every reply.", reason: "That is spam, which rule R6 names.", legalReference: null }, OTHER_STAFF);
      if (found.target.type === "post") found.target = { ...found.target, state: "withheld", level: "withheld" };
    },
    /** A new enrolment link, as `staff.js enroll` prints one for the person's next key; its token. */
    issueEnrolment(): string {
      state.enrolmentToken = b64url(32);
      state.enrolmentUsed = false;
      return state.enrolmentToken;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
export const CASE_APPEALED = "e4c7d6c9-38f5-47c9-80d5-14b302f7e6df";

/**
 * An account's case that holds an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material and reaches images that are still
 * served: the seal and "Do not seal now" are offered on it. Its newest snapshot holds the account's fields as they read
 * now, so nothing asks for a fresh one.
 */
export function sealableCase(id: string, accountId: string): CaseView {
  const fields = { handle: "an_account", displayName: HOSTILE.quote, bio: LOOKALIKE.label };
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id,
    target: { type: "account", id: accountId, ...fields, deleted: false },
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 2, images: 3, sealed: 0, served: 3, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "5a5a5a5a"), targetId: accountId, authorHandle: fields.handle, ...fields }],
    // An item of its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
    items: base.items.map((each) => ({ ...each, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "6b6b6b6b") })),
    history: [],
  });
}

/**
 * A post's case as an admin meets it: a rule report, then a report of child sexual abuse material that nobody has
 * answered, then a second rule report. Its two images are still served and cannot be opened, and nothing was done while
 * deciding. Its items are its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
 */
export function adminCase(): CaseView {
  return frozenCase({
    id: CASE_ADMIN,
    intakeSeq: 3,
    decisions: [],
    sealsDeclined: [],
    history: [],
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 2, sealed: 0, served: 2, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    items: [

      item({ id: "e4c7d6c9-38f5-47c9-80d5-14b302f7e6d3", seq: 3, ruleId: "R6", lane: 2, explanation: null }),

}

/** A post's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report and nothing else: no decision, no note, an item of its own. */
export function plainCase(id: string, itemId: string): CaseView {
  return postCase({ id, stateVersion: 1, intakeSeq: 1, items: [item({ id: itemId })], decisions: [], notes: [], history: [] });
}

/**
 * A closed case about a post whose final removal, by another staff member, its author appealed: the appeal waits, and
 * the reading person may review it. The appellant's statement is a string no page may run.
 */
export function appealedCase(): CaseView {
  const removal = decision({ id: DECISION_APPEALED, kind: "final", staffHandle: "mod_anna", throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, facts: "The post offers followers for money.", reason: "That is spam.", actions: [{ ...decision().actions[0]!, id: "17fa09fc-6b28-4afc-b308-47e635ca1912", kind: "remove" }] });
  return postCase({
    id: CASE_APPEALED,
    answeredSeq: 2,
    closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    target: { type: "post", id: POST_ID, link: `http://localhost:8081/post/${POST_ID}`, authorHandle: HOSTILE.bidi, state: "removed", level: "removed" },
    items: [item({ outcome: "restricted_rule", answeredBy: DECISION_APPEALED })],

/** 3e: an account case's standing with nothing on the record: no strike, nothing live, and the snapshot's handle not retired. */
export const NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING: CaseStanding = {
  activeStrikes: 0,
  strikes: [],
  ladderRule: null,

  maxDays: null,

  // 3e Task 5: no report sent, no mark, no warning.

/**
 * 3e: an account's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report under R4 about its handle, unanswered, with a snapshot
 * whose handle is the one the profile holds now unless told otherwise, and the account's standing. `live` is the handle
 * the profile holds now; `snapped` the one the newest snapshot copied.
 */
export function retireCase(live = "Ada_L", snapped = "Ada_L", standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_RETIRE,
    lane: 2,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: live, displayName: "Ada", bio: "", deleted: false },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, authorHandle: snapped, handle: snapped, displayName: "Ada", bio: "" }],
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_RETIRE, ruleId: "R4", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada_l" })],
    history: [],
    standing: { ...NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING, ...standing },
  });
}

/**
 * 3e Task 3: an account's case that holds an admin's own finding under R5, unanswered (no report waits, so a measure that
 * answers findings only is open), with the account's standing: the grounds of a suspension at once that the database
 * would accept now (`atOnce`), and the decisions each would rest on. A test passes what differs.
 */
export function atOnceCase(standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}, rule: "R2" | "R5" | "R6" = "R5"): CaseView {
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_AT_ONCE,
    lane: 1,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: rule === "R2" ? accountCase().suspicion : null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: "flood_er", displayName: "Flooder", bio: "", deleted: false },
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_AT_ONCE, ruleId: rule, suspect: rule === "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/flood_er", explanation: null, source: SOURCES.staff })],
    history: [],

}

/** An announced suspension of 3 days, as a decision's row on the case page holds it, with where its period stands and its reply. */
function announcedSuspension(id: string, period: NonNullable<CaseDecisionAction["period"]>, reply: CaseDecisionAction["reply"]): CaseDecisionAction {
  return {
    id,
    kind: "suspend",
    mediaId: null,
    noEffect: null,
    inForce: true,
    reversesActionId: null,
    liftedBy: null,
    sealed: null,
    ...NO_STANDING,
    days: 3,
    announced: true,
    basis: "strikes",
    restsOn: THREE_STRIKES.map((strike) => strike.decisionId),
    earliestStart: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z",
    period,
    reply,
  };
}

/**
 * 3e Task 5: a post's case whose reporter's item can be marked, beside a notice of illegality that cannot: a final "No
 * breach" decision offers the mark on the first only, and says once why not on the second.
 */
export function markCase(id: string = CASE_MARK): CaseView {
  const base = postCase();
  return postCase({ id, items: base.items.map((each) => (each.id === ITEM_REPORTER ? { ...each, markable: true } : each)), decisions: [], history: [], strikeDue: { due: false, why: "due" } });
}

  return postCase({
    id: CASE_MARKED,
    stateVersion: 4,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    answeredSeq: 1,
    closedAt: "2026-10-05T09:00:00.000Z",
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_MARKED, outcome: "no_violation", answeredBy: DECISION_MARKED, markable: true, unfounded: !withdrawn, markWithdrawn: withdrawn })],
    decisions: [decision({ id: DECISION_MARKED, kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 3, redressVersion: 2, throughSeq: 1, answersFromSeq: 1, decidedAt: "2026-10-05T09:00:00.000Z", facts: null, reason: null, actions: [] })],

}
```

```tsx
const SEAL_DECISION = "f2031425-3647-495a-8bc6-e1f203142536";

/** The frozen case with a seal for good, in force or lifted, whose custody is as given. */
function sealedCase(custody: CaseDecision["custody"], inForce = true): CaseView {
  const view = frozenCase();
  return {
    ...view,
    decisions: [
      ...view.decisions,
      decision({
        id: SEAL_DECISION,
        kind: "final",
        ruleId: "R2",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        suspect: true,
        needsAdmin: true,
        actions: [{ id: SEAL_ACTION, kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
        ...(custody === undefined ? {} : { custody }),
      }),
    ],
  };
}

    expect(html(<CustodyLines overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 0, oldest: null })} now={NOW} />)).toBe("");
    // 3d Task 2: released files to destroy have a line of their own, [home.undestroyed], whatever else is due.
    expect(text(html(<CustodyLines overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 4, oldest: null })} now={NOW} />))).toBe(`${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeTitle}${RELEASE_WORDS.homeUndestroyed(4)}`);

    // Two moved and two lost: every file is accounted for, so nothing is said of the store.

    expect(liftedLost).toContain("Files lost: 2. Their images cannot be shown again; their author was told so.");
```

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_RULES, ORDER_RULES, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RETENTION, STANDING_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK, RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK } from "../src/screens/Home";

/**
 * The README's moderation runbook and the console's home screen say the same thing (3c design, section 13, Task 12).
 * When decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes, or an erasure is more than a day late, the
 * home screen shows the count with the runbook's sentence for it, and each sentence is a constant of the screen. This
 * test reads README.md from the repository's root and holds the runbook to the same two constants, word for word, so
 * that what staff are told on the screen is what the operator reads in the runbook: whoever changes one changes both.
 */
const README = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "..", "README.md");

/** Markdown's code mark. The README sets a log line or a setting in code marks; the console shows the same words as plain text. */
const CODE_MARK = "`";

/** A text as its reader sees it: without the code marks. Nothing else is changed, so every word and every sign must agree. */
const withoutCodeMarks = (text: string): string => text.split(CODE_MARK).join("");

/** The README's lines, as written. */
function readmeLines(): string[] {
  return readFileSync(README, "utf8").split("\n");
}

/** The lines of the README's section "Moderation": from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function moderationSection(): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf("## Moderation");
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}

/** The section's runbook as its reader sees it: every line after "The runbook:", without the code marks. */
function moderationRunbook(): string {
  const section = moderationSection();
  const start = section.indexOf("The runbook:");
  return start === -1 ? "" : withoutCodeMarks(section.slice(start + 1).join("\n"));
}

/** How often `part` stands in `text`. */
const count = (text: string, part: string): number => text.split(part).length - 1;

describe("the README's moderation runbook says what the home screen says", () => {
  const sentences: [string, string][] = [
    ["decisions not released", RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK],
    ["late erasures", ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK],
  ];

  test("the README has a section Moderation, and the section has a runbook", () => {
    expect(readmeLines()).toContain("## Moderation");
    expect(moderationSection()).toContain("The runbook:");
    expect(moderationRunbook().trim()).not.toBe("");
  });

  test("neither constant holds a code mark or a line break, so reading the README without its code marks hides no difference", () => {
    for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain(CODE_MARK);
      expect(sentence, name).not.toContain("\n");
      // A whole sentence: it opens with "A count of" and ends in a full stop, as the runbook's bullet writes it.
      expect(sentence.startsWith("A count of "), name).toBe(true);
      expect(sentence.endsWith("."), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  for (const [name, sentence] of sentences) {
    test(`the runbook holds the home screen's sentence for ${name}, word for word`, () => {
      expect(moderationRunbook()).toContain(sentence);
    });

    test(`the sentence for ${name} stands once in the README, in that runbook: no second copy can drift from it`, () => {
      expect(count(withoutCodeMarks(readmeLines().join("\n")), sentence)).toBe(1);
      expect(count(moderationRunbook(), sentence)).toBe(1);
    });
  }

  test("both sentences stand in one bullet of the runbook, the release's first, as the home screen orders its two lines", () => {
    const bullets = moderationRunbook()
      .split("\n")
      .filter((line) => line.includes(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK) || line.includes(ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK));
    expect(bullets).toHaveLength(1);
    const bullet = bullets[0] ?? "";
    expect(bullet.startsWith("- ")).toBe(true);
    expect(bullet.indexOf(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK)).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(bullet.indexOf(ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK)).toBeGreaterThan(bullet.indexOf(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK));
  });
});

/**
 * The README's account sanctions (3e design, section 13, Task 7) and the constants they print. The section Moderation
 * describes 3e in a paragraph that opens with ACCOUNT_SANCTIONS_LEAD and a bullet for each title below, and its runbook
 * gains the bullets of section 13's (a) to (h). Every number in that text is a number of STANDING_RULES or

];

describe("the README's account sanctions say what the constants say (3e design, section 13, Task 7)", () => {
  test("Moderation opens 3e's part with its paragraph, and each of its bullets stands there once", () => {

/**
 * The README's authorities' orders (3f design, section 13, Task 7; W.9 and W.10) and the constants they print. 3f's text
 * is the section "Authorities' orders", Upgrading from its 3f paragraph on (Task 1), Restoring's block "Restoring with
 * the keeper's copy" (Task 6) and Before going public's owner's list. Every number in it is a number of ORDER_RULES or
 * ALERT_RULES: a table holds each in its sentence, and every other run of digits is refused but for what names a
 * reference (an article, a research finding, a row of the design's section 2, a check P1 to P8, a list's numbering, a
 * path, a date), so the README cannot keep a number the constants changed. A setting is written as the operator sets it
 * in infra/.env, an API setting with the prefix Compose maps. A section added to 3f's text joins its list here.
 */
const FENCE = "```";

/** The lines of a "## " section of the README, from its heading to the next heading of the same level. */
function sectionLines(heading: string): string[] {
  const lines = readmeLines();
  const start = lines.indexOf(heading);
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith("## "));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** A section's lines from the first that begins with these words to the section's end, or to the first that begins with `until`. */
function linesFrom(lines: string[], lead: string, until?: string): string[] {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(lead));
  if (start === -1) return [];
  const rest = lines.slice(start);
  const end = until === undefined ? -1 : rest.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(until));
  return end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
}
/** Lines without their fenced code: a command's own numbers and words are not the runbook's. */
function withoutFences(lines: string[]): string[] {
  let inside = false;
  return lines.filter((line) => {
    if (line.startsWith(FENCE)) {
      inside = !inside;
      return false;
    }
    return !inside;
  });
}

const ORDERS_HEADING = "## Authorities' orders";
const ORDERS_TITLES = [
  "The contact point.",
  "On call.",
  "A removal order, step by step",
  "Other messages and orders.",
  "When nobody can act within the hour.",
  "Notifications and hand-overs.",
  "A person asks about a missing post.",
  "An author writes about an order's notice.",
  "The daily copy.",
  "A key in someone else's hands.",
  "The yearly counts.",
] as const;
const OWNERS_LEAD = "**The owner's list (sub-project 3f).**";
const OWNERS_TITLES = [
  "The Member State.",
  "The mailbox.",
  "The people's own access to the mailbox.",
  "Registering.",
  "The push hostname and ntfy's users.",
  "The phones.",
  "The keys.",
  "The papers, and counsel.",
  "The contact address.",
  "The page for the yearly report.",
  "The keeper, and the two places files rest.",
  "Decide",
  "Counsel",
] as const;

/** 3f's text, part by part, without code marks and fenced code. */
function ordersParts(): Record<"orders" | "upgrading" | "restoring" | "owners", string> {
  const read = (lines: string[]) => withoutCodeMarks(withoutFences(lines).join("\n"));
  return {
    orders: read(sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)),
    upgrading: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel (sub-project 3f)")),
    restoring: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")),
    owners: read(linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in")),
  };
}
const ordersText = (): string => Object.values(ordersParts()).join("\n");

/** A number in a sentence as the README writes it, and the constant it is. */
const O = ORDER_RULES;
const A = ALERT_RULES;
const ORDER_NUMBERS: { constant: string; part: keyof ReturnType<typeof ordersParts>; phrase: string }[] = [
  { constant: "ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds", part: "orders", phrase: `reads the inbox and the junk folder every ${A.pollSeconds} seconds` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes", part: "orders", phrase: `it rings every staff phone ${O.escalateMinutes} minutes after its arrival` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction", part: "orders", phrase: `one key touch for up to ${O.itemsPerAction} posts` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays", part: "orders", phrase: `alerted daily in the last ${O.holdWarningDays} days before any release` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "orders", phrase: `the address is kept for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays", part: "upgrading", phrase: `keeps its address, and nothing else, for at most ${O.reportHoldDays} days` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.copyOverdueHours", part: "orders", phrase: `once the newest copy is more than ${O.copyOverdueHours} hours old` },
  { constant: "ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes", part: "owners", phrase: `bounded only by the quiet period of ${O.quietMinutes} minutes` },
];

/** What names a reference and is no number of the runbook's, taken out before the digits are counted; only the second keeps a group, the character before the name. */
const REFERENCES: RegExp[] = [
  // A path, a file or a regulation's number: whatever holds a slash.
  /[A-Za-z0-9_.()-]*[/][A-Za-z0-9_./-]+/g,
  // A sub-project's name (3f, 3d, 1b) and a phone check (P1 to P8).
  /(^|[^0-9A-Za-z])([0-9][a-f]|P[1-8])(?=[^0-9A-Za-z]|$)/gm,
  // A list's numbering.
  /^[0-9]+[.] /gm,
  // An article of an act, with its paragraphs.
  /Art(?:icle|[.]) [0-9]+(?:[(][0-9a-z]+[)])*/g,
  // A finding of the research, with its questions; a row of the design's section 2, and the section itself.
  /(?:OL|AU) E[0-9]+[.][0-9]+(?: questions [0-9]+ to [0-9]+)?/g,
  /[(]rows? [0-9]+(?: and [0-9]+)?[)]/g,
  /section [0-9]+/g,
  // A step of a list named in a sentence.
  /steps? [0-9]+/g,
  // An instant as an example of the form, a date of the year, the hand-over's user, a hash's name, a status's code.
  /[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:]+Z/g,
  /[0-9]+ March/g,
  /uid [0-9]+/g,
  /sha256/g,
  /answers 503/g,
];

describe("the README's authorities' orders say what the constants say (3f design, section 13, Task 7; W.9 and W.10)", () => {
  test("the README has the section Authorities' orders after Moderation, and each of its parts stands there once, in W.9's order", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    expect(lines.indexOf(ORDERS_HEADING)).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Moderation"));
    const section = sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING).map(withoutCodeMarks);
    const at = ORDERS_TITLES.map((title) => section.findIndex((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)));
    for (const title of ORDERS_TITLES) expect(section.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`**${title}`)), title).toHaveLength(1);
    expect([...at].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(at);
  });

  test("Before going public holds the owner's list of thirteen, each line by its title, in W.10's order", () => {
    const owners = linesFrom(sectionLines("## Before going public"), OWNERS_LEAD, "Set these in").filter((line) => /^[0-9]+[.] /.test(line));
    expect(owners.map((line) => line.slice(0, line.indexOf(" ")))).toEqual(OWNERS_TITLES.map((_, n) => `${n + 1}.`));
    for (const [n, title] of OWNERS_TITLES.entries()) expect(owners[n]!.startsWith(`${n + 1}. **${title}`), title).toBe(true);
  });

  test("every number of 3f's text stands in its sentence with the constant's value", () => {
    const parts = ordersParts();
    for (const row of ORDER_NUMBERS) expect(parts[row.part], `${row.constant}: ${row.phrase}`).toContain(row.phrase);
  });

  test("and no other number: every run of digits in it is a constant's, outside what names a reference", () => {
    const values = new Set<string>([...Object.values(O), ...Object.values(A)].filter((value) => typeof value === "number").map(String));
    const outside = REFERENCES.reduce((text, pattern) => text.replace(pattern, (_match: string, lead: unknown) => (typeof lead === "string" ? `${lead} ` : " ")), ordersText());
    expect((outside.match(/[0-9]+/g) ?? []).filter((digits) => !values.has(digits))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a setting is written as the operator sets it in infra/.env: an API setting with its prefix", () => {
    const withMarks = [sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Upgrading"), "Authorities' orders and the alert channel"), linesFrom(sectionLines("## Restoring"), "**Restoring with the keeper's copy**")]
      .flatMap((lines) => withoutFences(lines))
      .join("\n");
    for (const name of ["NOTIFY", "REPORT_HOLD", "MODERATION_RETENTION", "HOME_STATE", "CONTACT_POINT", "PUSH_ORIGIN", "APP_ORIGIN"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(`${CODE_MARK}${name}`), name).toBe(false);
    }
    for (const name of ["API_CONTACT_POINT", "API_HOME_STATE", "API_REPORT_HOLD", "API_MODERATION_RETENTION", "APP_SITE", "COMPOSE_PROFILES", "WEB_CONTACT_POINT", "WEB_HOME_STATE"]) {
      expect(withMarks.includes(name) || ordersText().includes(name), name).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  test("the hand-over's and the yearly counts' commands stand in the runbook as the operator types them", () => {
    const orders = ordersParts().orders;
    for (const words of [
      "docker compose --profile handover run --rm -T -v <directory>:/handover handover < list > digests",
      "handover-list",
      "handover-record",
      "handover-destroyed",
      "staff.js tco-counts <last year>",
      "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js address-check --handle <handle> < address",
    ]) {
      expect(orders, words).toContain(words);
    }
    expect(readmeLines().join("\n")).toContain("docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm migrate node dist/staff.js tco-counts <year>");
  });

  test("3f's review: a sentence of Restoring or of the orders' runbook that sets APP_SITE recreates Caddy alone, and one that sets an API switch names the start that reads it", () => {
    // Caddy reads APP_SITE only when its container is created, and the API reads its switches only at its start: a
    // setting in infra/.env alone changes nothing. Without --no-deps Compose would start the API with Caddy.
    const sentences = [...sectionLines("## Restoring"), ...sectionLines(ORDERS_HEADING)].flatMap((line) => line.split(/(?<=[.;])\s+(?=[A-Z`(])/));
    const site = sentences.filter((sentence) => sentence.includes("`APP_SITE="));
    const api = sentences.filter((sentence) => /`API_[A-Z_]+=/.test(sentence));
    expect(site.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(api.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    for (const sentence of site) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d --no-deps caddy");
    for (const sentence of api) expect(sentence, sentence).toContain("up -d api");
    // operations5: a message moved between the two folders is a second row; the runbook says not to, and what then.
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("Never move a message between the inbox and the junk folder");
    expect(ordersParts().orders).toContain("close the second row on Contact point with the first row's word");
  });

  test("the lines 3f made false are gone, and the hard gate reads as W.10 words it", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join("\n");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Until sub-project 3f's off-server copy of decisions");
    expect(all).not.toContain("take the app's public hostname off the tunnel and leave the console's on");
    expect(all).not.toContain("staff.js account-facts");
    expect(all).not.toContain("account-facts <handle>");
    expect(all).not.toContain("Authorities' orders before 3f.");
    expect(all).not.toContain("in their own records until sub-project 3f");
    expect(all).not.toContain("With sub-project 3f the authorities' contact address is published as well");
    // 3d Task 2 (W.11): the gate's first line reads 3d's quarantine and release.
    expect(all).toContain("until sub-project 3f's order path and sub-project 3d's quarantine and release have shipped and the list below is done");
  });
});

/**
 * 3d Task 1 (design, W.11): the README's sections Quarantine and Backups. Quarantine stands after Authorities' orders
 * with its six steps in W.11's order, each command as the operator types it; Backups before Restoring, with the days of
 * RETENTION.backupDays and the quarantine that is never backed up.
 */
describe("the README's Quarantine and Backups (3d design, W.11)", () => {
  const QUARANTINE_STEPS = [
    "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js quarantine-list > list",
    "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml --profile quarantine run --rm -T quarantine < list > receipt",
    "docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js quarantine-record < receipt",
    "Nobody opens a file of the quarantine",
    "**A file in neither place**",
    "**A file without a record**",
  ];

  test("Quarantine stands after Authorities' orders, with its six steps in their order, each command as the operator types it", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    expect(lines.indexOf("## Quarantine")).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Authorities' orders"));
    const steps = sectionLines("## Quarantine").filter((line) => /^[0-9][.] /.test(line));
    expect(steps.map((line) => line.slice(0, 2))).toEqual(["1.", "2.", "3.", "4.", "5.", "6."]);
    for (const [n, lead] of QUARANTINE_STEPS.entries()) expect(withoutCodeMarks(steps[n]!).includes(withoutCodeMarks(lead)), lead).toBe(true);
    const text = sectionLines("## Quarantine").join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain("--inventory > have");
    expect(text).toContain("with `--lost` appended");
    expect(text).toContain("(uid 1000, mode 0700)");
  });

  test("Backups stands before Restoring and says the backup's days from RETENTION.backupDays and that the quarantine is never backed up", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    expect(lines.indexOf("## Backups")).toBeLessThan(lines.indexOf("## Restoring"));
    const text = sectionLines("## Backups").join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain(`is deleted ${RETENTION.backupDays} days after it was taken`);
    expect(text).toContain("`media-quarantine` is never backed up");
  });
});

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2, 7.3 and W.11): the release's runbook, "A release" under Quarantine, and the steps of
 * Restoring that replay releases. An assessment releases nothing; the leave is recorded with release-leave, withdrawn
 * at once when it was a mistake; release-show prints the record; the backups' day comes from RETENTION.backupDays. After
 * a restore, release-replay, the inventory, the lost leave and the lost withdrawal, and the site that opens only when no
 * gap is left. No line of the README says the software cannot release, and the R2 bullet no longer destroys by hand.
 */
describe("the README's release (3d design, W.11)", () => {
  test("A release stands under Quarantine: an assessment releases nothing, the leave is a fact of its own, a mistaken one is withdrawn, release-show prints the record", () => {
    const lines = readmeLines();
    const at = lines.indexOf("### A release");
    expect(at).toBeGreaterThan(lines.indexOf("## Quarantine"));
    const text = sectionLines("## Quarantine").slice(sectionLines("## Quarantine").indexOf("### A release")).join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain("An authority's assessment is not leave to destroy.");
    expect(text).toContain("staff.js release-leave <seal> --by <authority|court> --reference <text> --day <yyyy-mm-dd> --operator <name>");
    expect(text).toContain("`release-leave --end-untold <leave>`");
    expect(text).toContain("`release-leave --withdraw <leave> --operator <name>`");
    expect(text).toContain("a leave that a release already rests on cannot be withdrawn");
    expect(text).toContain("staff.js release-show <release>");
    expect(text).toContain("korbat promises nobody a destruction");
  });

  test("Restoring replays the releases: release-replay, the inventory first, the lost leave and withdrawal, and the site opens only with no gap left", () => {
    const text = sectionLines("## Restoring").join(" ");
    expect(text).toContain("**Restoring the releases** (sub-project 3d)");
    expect(text).toContain("cat <the keeper's files> | docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js release-replay");
    expect(text).toContain("beginning with step 6 (the inventory)");
    expect(text).toContain("`release-leave <seal> ... --gap <gap>`");
    expect(text).toContain("`release-leave --withdraw <leave> --operator <name> --gap <gap>`");
    expect(text).toContain('the class "Releases and held uploads to replay" included');
  });

  test("the lines 3d's release made false are gone", () => {
    const all = readmeLines().join(" ");
    expect(all).not.toContain("but nothing releases or erases them before 3d");
    expect(all).not.toContain("its software has no function yet to hand them over or to erase them");
    expect(all).not.toContain("before sub-project 3d, the operator copies out or destroys the files");
  });
});

```tsx
  expect(out).toContain(`<bdi>${HOSTILE.bidi}</bdi>`);
```

```ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

/**
 * What the console's source must never hold (3a design, sections 3 and 9, and console-lab.md section 8). The page runs
 * under require-trusted-types-for 'script' with trusted-types 'none', so each of these sinks would throw at run time and
 * take its screen down; this scan finds them first. Every user-written string is a text node, and no link is built from
 * data.
 */
const ROOT = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const SRC = path.join(ROOT, "src");

/**
 * Every line of the page's source (src/, which the bundle is built from) matching `pattern`, as `file:line`. The build
 * and development scripts run in Node, never in the page, so they are not scanned: the page they write needs its one
 * script element.
 */
function findInSource(pattern: RegExp): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  const files = readdirSync(SRC, { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" }).map((file) => path.join("src", file));
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!/\.(ts|tsx|css)$/.test(file)) continue;
    const lines = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), "utf8").split("\n");
    lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (pattern.test(line)) found.push(`${file.split(path.sep).join("/")}:${index + 1}`);
    });
  }
  return found.sort();
}

    ["createContextualFragment", /createContextualFragment/],

    ["a string as a timer's code", /setTimeout\(\s*["'`]|setInterval\(\s*["'`]/],
    ["a rendered script or style element", /<script|<style|createElement\(\s*["'`](script|style)/i],
    ["React's preinit and preload", /\bpre(init|initModule|load|loadModule)\b/],
    ["a style attribute set as text", /setAttribute\(\s*["'`]style/],
    ["setAttribute at all: React sets every attribute", /\.setAttribute\(/],
    ["a Trusted Types policy", /trustedTypes|createPolicy/],
    ["DOMParser", /DOMParser/],

    // A table of words by code or by outcome is an object whose keys are the contracts' names: none is written outside
    // the one file, where a second copy could drift from the first. A key opens a line or follows a brace or a comma.
    const keyed = /(^|[{,])\s*(rate_limited|not_found|invalid_request|staff_recused|text_invalid|restricted_rule|restricted_legal|no_violation|not_evident|not_available|partly_reversed|interim|correction)\s*:/;
    expect([...new Set(findInSource(keyed).map((found) => found.split(":")[0]))]).toEqual(["src/messages.ts"]);
    const messages = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "messages.ts"), "utf8").split("\n");
    for (const table of ["CASE_WORDS", "REVEAL_WORDS", "NOTE_WORDS", "FINDING_WORDS", "OUTCOME_WORDS", "DECISION_KINDS", "DECISION_OUTCOMES", "PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS", "COMPOSER_KINDS", "COMPOSER_OUTCOMES", "COMPOSER_WORDS"]) {
      expect(messages.filter((line) => line.startsWith(`export const ${table}:`) || line.startsWith(`export const ${table} =`)), table).toHaveLength(1);
      // Declared nowhere else: the name follows `const` in that one file only.
      expect(findInSource(new RegExp(`const ${table}[^A-Za-z0-9_]`)).map((found) => found.split(":")[0]), table).toEqual(["src/messages.ts"]);
    }
  });

  test("no link into the app: no source line writes the address of a post or a profile", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/["'`]\/(post|u)\//)).toEqual([]);
    expect(findInSource(/APP_ORIGIN|appOrigin/)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("never a passkey_* code or text: the console has its own words", () => {
    expect(findInSource(/passkey_/)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("the key is asked only after the console checked what it is asked to sign", () => {
  test("a confirmation asks the key in one function, which every confirmed action goes through", () => {
    const stepUp = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, "step-up.ts"), "utf8");
    expect(stepUp.match(/credentials\.get\(/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stepUp).toMatch(/export async function confirmWithKey</);
    // The revocation of a session, the reveal, the decision and the review are callers of it; none asks the key itself.
    // 3f: and an order's event, an admin's correction of an order, and giving effect to an order (Task 3); Task 6: the
    // audit log's download and a gap closed as not needed; 3d Task 2: the release of a seal for good.
    expect(stepUp.split("confirmWithKey(deps, action,").length - 1).toBe(10);
  });

  test("navigator.credentials is called only by the three ceremonies, each of which checks its challenge first", () => {
    // A fourth call site would need a check of its own (3a design, section 9): this list makes adding one a decision.
    expect(findInSource(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/).map((found) => found.split(":")[0])).toEqual(["src/enroll.ts", "src/sign-in.ts", "src/step-up.ts"]);
    const checks: [string, RegExp][] = [
      ["enroll.ts", /checkRegisterChallenge\(/],
      ["sign-in.ts", /checkSignInChallenge\(/],
      ["step-up.ts", /checkStepUpOptions\(/],
    ];
    for (const [file, check] of checks) {
      const source = readFileSync(path.join(SRC, file), "utf8");
      const call = source.search(/credentials\.(get|create)\(/);
      // The check is called in the function that makes the call, before it, as it runs before it. Only that function's
      // text up to the call is searched: a check declared in the same file (step-up.ts declares checkStepUpOptions) is
      // another top-level function, so its name there never stands in for the call.
      const declarations = [...source.matchAll(/^(export )?(async )?function \w+/gm)].map((found) => found.index ?? -1);
      const enclosing = Math.max(...declarations.filter((at) => at < call));
      expect(call, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(enclosing, file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(source.slice(enclosing, call).search(check), file).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    }
  });
});
```
