describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.
    const held = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true", heldUntil: "2026-04-11", holdFinal: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)[3]).toBe(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-04-11"));
    expect(paragraphs(held.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_USER);
  });
});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

  test("each is the kind's title after korbat:, then its sentence and its line of what to do from ALERT_TEXTS, and the staff mails' last sentence", () => {
    const cases: [TemplateName, AlertKind, Record<string, string>][] = [
      ["contact_mail", "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["contact_mail_escalated", "contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_due", "order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "15" }],
      ["mailbox_unreachable", "mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }],
      ["alert_channel_down", "alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }],
      // Task 2: an order opened (with a deadline, and without a time of receipt), a record corrected, the daily unverified.
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {
    expect([...TICK_MAILED_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "2"]));
      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);
      expect(r.subject, kind).toBe(`korbat: ${renderAlert(kind, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([n, v]) => [n, isTimeFact(n) ? v : Number(v)])), new Date(NOW)).title}`);
      linkless(r);
    }
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});

describe("3d Task 2: the release's two staff mails and the author's notice (W.6, W.7, W.8)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z";

  test("seal_released and release_undestroyed are their pushes' sentences with the line of what to do, counts and times only", () => {
    const released = renderTemplate("seal_released", { at: "2026-10-18T11:40:00.000Z", posts: "2", uploads: "0", now: NOW });
    expect(released.subject).toBe("korbat: An admin released sealed images");

      "An admin released sealed images at 11:40 UTC: 2 posts, 0 held uploads. The files are to be destroyed.",
      "This cannot be taken back. Every staff account gets this mail, the admin who did it too. If you did not expect it, look at the case now and tell the operator: until the files are destroyed and the backups have aged out, a release that should not have happened can still be met by keeping them.",
    ]);

  });

  test("release_notice: RELEASE_NOTICE's paragraphs by the same function as the app's screen, where to read it and the user mail's last sentence; no link, no authority, no reference, no assessment", () => {
    const data = { basis: "leave", releasedAt: "2026-10-18T10:05:00.000Z", backupsClearAt: "2026-11-17T10:05:00.000Z", upload: "no", postCount: "1", images: "2", createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" };

   * decision answered the case's suspect items that stood when a seal was taken while deciding, which says whether that

describe("a post's chip in its view", () => {
  const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
  const ME = id(900);
  const OTHER = id(901);
  const row = (n: number, authorId: string, state: PostRow["state"], extra: Partial<PostRow> = {}): PostRow => ({
    id: id(n),
    authorId,
    body: `post ${n}`,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    state,
    likeCount: 0,
    repostCount: 0,
    replyCount: 0,
    quoteCount: 0,
    createdAt: new Date("2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z"),
    deletedAt: null,
    author: { id: authorId, handle: authorId === ME ? "me" : "other", displayName: "A", verified: false },
    replyToHandle: null,
    replyToAuthorId: null,
    replyToState: null,
    ...extra,
  });

  /** The social module's view source over rows held in memory, with a record of what the moderation module was asked. */
  function source(rows: PostRow[], facts: Record<string, PostModeration>) {
    const asked: { viewer: string; postIds: string[] }[] = [];
    const moderation: ModerationForSocial = {
      authorFacts: async (viewer, postIds) => {
        asked.push({ viewer, postIds: [...postIds] });
        return new Map(Object.entries(facts));
      },
    };
    const repo = {
      findPosts: async (ids: string[]) => new Map(rows.filter((r) => ids.includes(r.id)).map((r) => [r.id, r])),
      blockedEitherWay: async () => new Set<string>(),
      viewerPostStates: async (_viewer: string, ids: string[]) => new Map(ids.map((postId) => [postId, { liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false }])),
      listedInExplore: async () => new Set<string>(),
    } as unknown as SocialDeps["repo"];
    const media = { forPosts: async () => new Map() } as unknown as SocialDeps["media"];
    return { asked, view: { repo, media, moderation } };
  }

  test("the viewer's own withheld and removed posts carry the decision the moderation module names, asked once for the page", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, ME, "withheld"), row(2, ME, "removed"), row(3, ME, "visible"), row(4, OTHER, "visible")];
    const chips = { [id(1)]: { decisionId: id(51), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null }, [id(2)]: { decisionId: id(52), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } };
    const s = source(rows, chips);
    const views = await loadPostViews(s.view, ME, rows.map((r) => r.id));
    expect(s.asked).toEqual([{ viewer: ME, postIds: [id(1), id(2)] }]);
    const moderationOf = (n: number) => {
      const view = views.get(id(n))!;
      return isTombstone(view) ? "tombstone" : view.moderation;
    };
    expect(moderationOf(1)).toEqual(chips[id(1)]);
    expect(moderationOf(2)).toEqual(chips[id(2)]);
    expect(moderationOf(3)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(moderationOf(4)).toBeUndefined();
    const visible = views.get(id(3))!;
    expect("moderation" in visible).toBe(false);
  });

  test("nothing is asked for a signed-out reader, for a page of other people's posts, or for a page of the viewer's visible posts", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, OTHER, "visible"), row(2, ME, "visible")];
    for (const viewer of [null, ME, OTHER]) {
      const s = source(rows, {});
      await loadPostViews(s.view, viewer, rows.map((r) => r.id));
      expect(s.asked, String(viewer)).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  test("a restricted post the module names no decision for carries no chip, and a quoted embed never carries one", async () => {
    const rows = [row(1, ME, "removed"), row(2, ME, "visible", { quoteOfId: id(3) }), row(3, ME, "withheld")];
    const s = source(rows, { [id(3)]: { decisionId: id(53), ruleId: "R1", legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } });
    const views = await loadPostViews(s.view, ME, [id(1), id(2)]);
    const first = views.get(id(1))!;
    const second = views.get(id(2))!;
    if (isTombstone(first) || isTombstone(second)) throw new Error("the author sees their own posts");
    expect("moderation" in first).toBe(false);
    // The quoted post is the viewer's own and withheld: its embed shows it, without a chip of its own.
    expect(second.quoteOf).toMatchObject({ id: id(3), state: "withheld" });
    expect("moderation" in (second.quoteOf as object)).toBe(false);
    // Only the posts of the page itself are asked about.
    expect(s.asked).toEqual([{ viewer: ME, postIds: [id(1)] }]);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ModerationErrorCode } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, moderationErrorMessage } from "../src/moderation/context";

describe("the moderation module's refusals", () => {
  test("each of the fifty-one codes this module raises answers with the status the design gives it (3c design, section 10; 3e design, section 10; 3f design, section 10.6; 3d design, section 10.7)", () => {
    const statuses = {
      notice_link_invalid: 422,
      notice_link_offsite: 422,
      human_check_failed: 403,
      staff_cannot_report: 403,
      notice_not_found: 404,
      already_reported: 409,
      appeal_not_open: 422,
      appeal_exists: 409,
      reexamination_not_open: 422,
      reexamination_exists: 409,
      case_changed: 409,
      case_closed: 409,
      staff_recused: 403,
      staff_target: 403,
      admin_required: 403,
      reviewer_conflict: 403,
      decision_cap: 429,
      profile_changed: 409,
      snapshot_mismatch: 409,
      snapshot_erased: 409,
      text_not_found: 409,
      invalid_decision: 422,
      text_invalid: 422,
      text_quotes_user: 422,
      image_refused: 404,
      reveal_refused: 422,
      // 3e (design, section 10.5).
      reporting_restricted: 403,
      reply_not_open: 422,
      strike_mismatch: 409,
      standing_conflict: 409,
      ground_not_established: 422,
      // 3f: a message at the contact point that already has its disposition; Task 2's order records (section 10.6).
      message_handled: 409,
      order_needs_message: 422,
      order_exists: 409,
      order_closed: 409,
      order_event_refused: 422,
      already_released: 409,
      // Task 3: giving effect, and korbat's appeal of an order's decision.
      order_changed: 409,
      order_not_verified: 422,
      order_cap: 429,
      not_appealable: 422,
      // Task 6: recovery.
      gap_mismatch: 409,
      copy_mismatch: 409,
      // 3d Task 2 (section 10.7): the release, in the order seal_release checks, and its check at commit.
      release_not_open: 409,
      release_not_reported: 422,
      release_not_quarantined: 422,
      release_preserved: 422,
      release_no_leave: 422,
      release_period_unset: 422,
      release_period_running: 422,
      release_mismatch: 409,
    } as const;
    // The table above is the whole of the contracts' list, so a code added there fails here until its status is pinned.
    expect(Object.keys(statuses).sort()).toEqual([...ModerationErrorCode.options].sort());
    for (const [code, status] of Object.entries(statuses) as [keyof typeof statuses, number][]) {
      const err = new ModerationError(code);
      expect([err.name, err.code, err.status], code).toEqual(["ModerationError", code, status]);
      expect(err.message, code).toBe(moderationErrorMessage(code));
      expect(err.message.length, code).toBeGreaterThan(10);
      expect(isModerationErrorCode(code), code).toBe(true);
    }
    // What the audit function raises is an answer of the decision, never one of these codes.
    expect(isModerationErrorCode("staff_confirmation_ended")).toBe(false);
    expect(isModerationErrorCode("staff_confirmation_late")).toBe(false);
    // The module's own answers beside them.
    expect([new ModerationError("not_found").status, new ModerationError("invalid_request").status]).toEqual([404, 400]);
    // A session that has not finished onboarding is refused as requireSession refuses it, in the same words.
    // 3f: order_exists carries the order that stands, the one refusal with a member.
    expect(new ModerationError("order_exists", undefined, undefined, undefined, { orderId: "x" }).details).toEqual({ orderId: "x" });
    expect(new ModerationError("onboarding_required")).toMatchObject({ status: 403, message: "Choose a handle to finish setting up your account." });
    expect([new ModerationError("rate_limited").status, new ModerationError("service_unavailable").status]).toEqual([429, 503]);
  });

  test("the console's refusals say nothing about who reported: a recusal reads the same whoever the conflict concerns, and an image that is not shown gives no reason", () => {
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("staff_recused")).not.toMatch(/report/i);
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("image_refused")).toBe("That image is not shown.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("reveal_refused")).not.toMatch(/@|https?:/);
  });

  test("the words of an appeal and of a re-examination are written for the person asking, and give one answer for every reason it is not open", () => {
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("appeal_not_open")).toBe("This decision cannot be appealed now.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("appeal_exists")).toBe("You have already appealed this decision.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("reexamination_not_open")).toBe("A re-examination cannot be asked for this item now.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("reexamination_exists")).toBe("A re-examination of this item has already been asked for.");
    // The reviewer's own refusal names their part in the case, never anyone else's.
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("reviewer_conflict")).toBe("You cannot review this appeal: you took part in its case.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("reviewer_conflict")).not.toMatch(/report/i);
  });

  test("the words of the notice routes are written for the person reporting, and the human check names no address", () => {
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("human_check_failed")).toBe("We could not verify that you are human. Try again.");
    expect(moderationErrorMessage("already_reported")).toBe("You already reported this; it is being looked at.");
    for (const code of ["notice_link_invalid", "notice_link_offsite", "human_check_failed", "staff_cannot_report", "notice_not_found"] as const) {
      expect(moderationErrorMessage(code), code).not.toMatch(/@|https?:/);
    }
  });
});

    logger,
  });
  const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: media.forCases, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
  // The staff module gets the auth module's two guards with a mark on each, so the table can be read for which route
  // stands behind which: the session guard, and the step-up of one action.
  const guards = new Map<unknown, string>();
  const marked = <T>(guard: T, mark: string): T => {
    guards.set(guard, mark);
    return guard;
  };
  // The session guard also counts its runs, so a test can tell a request that reached it from one answered before it.
  const runs = { session: 0 };
  const countedRequireStaff: AuthForStaff["requireStaff"] = async (c, next) => {
    runs.session++;
    return auth.forStaff.requireStaff(c, next);
  };
  const forStaff: AuthForStaff = {
    ...auth.forStaff,
    requireStaff: marked(countedRequireStaff, "session"),
    requireStaffStepUp: (action, target) => marked(auth.forStaff.requireStaffStepUp(action, target), `step-up:${action}`),
  };
  const staff = createStaff({ apiDb, auth: forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff });
  const app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, media, account, staff, moderation });
  // What the staff module mounts at /api/staff, as createApp mounts it.
  const mounted = staff.routes(CONSOLE_ORIGIN).routes;
  const staffOwn = mounted.map((r) => ({ method: r.method, path: `/api/staff${r.path}` }));
  // Each staff route with the guards in its chain: Hono lists a route once for every handler it chains.
  const guarded = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const r of mounted) {
    const route = `${r.method} /api/staff${r.path}`;
    const mark = guards.get(r.handler);
    guarded.set(route, [...(guarded.get(route) ?? []), ...(mark === undefined ? [] : [mark])]);
  }
  return { app, staffOwn, guarded, runs };
}

const isStaffPath = (p: string) => p === "/api/staff" || p.startsWith("/api/staff/");
const keyOf = (r: RouteEntry) => `${r.method} ${r.path}`;

/** Each method and path once, sorted: Hono lists a route once for every handler it chains. */
const distinct = (routes: RouteEntry[]) => [...new Set(routes.map(keyOf))].sort();

/**
 * A Hono path as a pattern: a parameter matches one segment, and a final wildcard the path itself and anything below it.
 * The app's paths hold only letters, digits, dashes, underscores and dots, so nothing else needs escaping.
 */
function patternOf(routePath: string): RegExp {
  const segments = routePath.split("/").map((segment) => {
    if (segment === "*") return ".*";
    if (segment.startsWith(":")) return "[^/]+";
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$/.test(segment)) throw new Error(`a path segment this check cannot read: ${segment}`);
    return segment.replaceAll(".", "[.]");
  });
  const last = segments.length - 1;
  // "/x/*" matches /x itself too, as Hono routes it.
  const body = segments[last] === ".*" ? `${segments.slice(0, last).join("/")}(/.*)?` : segments.join("/");
  return new RegExp(`^${body}$`);
}

/** A lower-case uuid, as a staff path's parameter (a session's handle, a case's id) takes one. */
const SAMPLE_PARAMETER = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

/**
 * Paths under /api/staff a route of another module could answer, built from the staff module's own route table: each of
 * its paths with every parameter filled in, and each path that leads to one (/api/staff/signin for /signin/verify), so a
 * staff route added later is probed too; then the prefix itself, with a final slash, and a path the module does not have.
 * A foreign route that reaches one of them answers there for any method the staff module does not define, behind the gate
 * but with no app session, since createApp skips resolveSession on staff paths.
 */
function staffProbes(staffOwn: RouteEntry[]): string[] {
  const probes = new Set(["/api/staff", "/api/staff/", "/api/staff/x/y"]);
  for (const route of staffOwn) {
    if (!isStaffPath(route.path) || route.path.includes("*")) continue;
    const segments = route.path.split("/").map((segment) => (segment.startsWith(":") ? SAMPLE_PARAMETER : segment));
    for (let end = 3; end <= segments.length; end++) probes.add(segments.slice(0, end).join("/"));
  }
  return [...probes];
}

/**
 * The routes of the app that answer under /api/staff without being the staff module's own: every route not among those
 * the staff module mounts there (as many times as it mounts each) whose path lies under /api/staff or whose pattern
 * reaches a path there (staffProbes). The app's own chain,
 * registered on every path ("ALL /*"), is the one exception: request id, access log, client identity, headers and limits
 * apply to staff paths too (3a design, section 5).
 */
function foreignStaffRoutes(appRoutes: RouteEntry[], staffOwn: RouteEntry[]): string[] {
  const own = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const route of staffOwn) own.set(keyOf(route), (own.get(keyOf(route)) ?? 0) + 1);
  const probes = staffProbes(staffOwn);
  const foreign: string[] = [];
  for (const route of appRoutes) {
    const k = keyOf(route);
    if (k === "ALL /*") continue;
    const left = own.get(k) ?? 0;
    if (left > 0) {
      own.set(k, left - 1);
      continue;
    }
    const pattern = patternOf(route.path);
    if (isStaffPath(route.path) || probes.some((probe) => pattern.test(probe))) foreign.push(k);
  }
  return foreign;
}

/** A route path naming a role, a grant or a promotion: what a route that changes a role would be called. */
const ROLE_PATH = new RegExp("(^|/)(roles?|grants?|grant-role|promote|demote|make-staff|staff-role)(/|$)", "i");

const SRC_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../src", import.meta.url));
function sources(): { path: string; source: string }[] {
  const walk = (dir: string): string[] =>
    readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
      const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) return walk(full);
      return entry.name.endsWith(".ts") ? [full] : [];
    });
  return walk(SRC_ROOT).map((full) => ({ path: path.relative(SRC_ROOT, full).split(path.sep).join("/"), source: readFileSync(full, "utf8") }));
}

/**
 * Where an account's role may be changed: the repository's statements (changeRole for grant-role, setRole for the tests)
 * are reached only through grant-role's grantRole, which only the auth index (for the command line) and grant-role's own
 * command name. A route that changed a role would have to name one of them.
 */
const ROLE_WRITERS = /\b(changeRole|setRole|grantRole)\b/;
const ROLE_WRITER_FILES = new Set(["auth/repo.ts", "auth/admin.ts", "auth/index.ts", "cli/grant-role.ts"]);
const roleWriterViolations = (files: { path: string; source: string }[]) => files.filter((f) => !ROLE_WRITER_FILES.has(f.path) && ROLE_WRITERS.test(f.source)).map((f) => f.path);

/** A member of a staff answer that would name a person beyond their public handle: an address, a device, a phone or an account. */
const PERSONAL = /email|^ip|ipHash|address|device|phone|userId|accountId|actorId|userAgent|webauthn/i;

/** What memberNames writes in place of the members of a schema whose kind it cannot read. */
const UNREAD = "a member of a kind this check cannot read";

/**
 * Every member of an answer's schema by its path, through objects, lists, unions and nullable or optional members, so a
 * member inside a case's items or a seal's list is read as one at the top is. A kind of schema this walk does not know
 * is listed as such (UNREAD), and the test below refuses any: whatever such a member holds would otherwise go unread.
 *
 * The walk reads the contracts, not the answers. That an answer holds nothing but what its contract names is held by the
 * HTTP suites, which compare each raw answer with what its schema reads from it (http-staff-cases.test.ts).
 */
function memberNames(schema: unknown, path = ""): string[] {
  const def = (schema as { _zod: { def: Record<string, unknown> } })._zod.def;
  switch (def.type) {
    case "object":
      return Object.entries(def.shape as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([key, member]) => {
        const name = path === "" ? key : `${path}.${key}`;
        return [name, ...memberNames(member, name)];
      });
    case "array":
      return memberNames(def.element, path);
    case "union":
      return [...new Set((def.options as unknown[]).flatMap((option) => memberNames(option, path)))];
    case "nullable":
    case "optional":
      return memberNames(def.innerType, path);
    case "string":
    case "number":
    case "boolean":
    case "enum":
    case "literal":
      return [];
    default:
      return [`${path}: ${UNREAD} (${String(def.type)})`];
  }
}

describe("the staff routes in the route table (3a design, section 11)", () => {
  test("are exactly the staff module's: the gate, sign-in, enrolment, the person's own reads, sign-out, step-up, the confirmed revocation, the confirmed decision and review, and the console's reads and writes on cases and appeals", () => {
    const { app } = build();
    expect(distinct(app.routes.filter((r) => isStaffPath(r.path)))).toEqual(
      [
        "ALL /api/staff/*",
        "POST /api/staff/enroll/options",
        "POST /api/staff/enroll/verify",
        "POST /api/staff/signin/options",
        "POST /api/staff/signin/verify",
        "GET /api/staff/me",
        "GET /api/staff/sessions",
        "GET /api/staff/keys",
        "GET /api/staff/audit",
        "POST /api/staff/signout",
        "POST /api/staff/step-up/options",
        "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle",
        "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions",
        "GET /api/staff/appeals",
        "POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review",
        "GET /api/staff/overview",
        "GET /api/staff/queue",
        "GET /api/staff/standing",
        "GET /api/staff/cases/:case",
        "GET /api/staff/cases/:case/media/:media/:size",
        "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/snapshots",
        "POST /api/staff/findings",
        "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/texts",
        "GET /api/staff/cases/:case/texts",
        "POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal",
        // 3f: the authorities' contact point.
        "GET /api/staff/contact",
        "POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close",
        // 3f, Task 2: order records.
        "GET /api/staff/orders",
        "GET /api/staff/orders/:order",
        "POST /api/staff/orders",
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items",
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/events",
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/correct",
        // Task 3: giving effect.
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/effect",
        // Task 6: recovery: the keeper's download and its mark, what a restore lost and a gap closed as not needed.
        "POST /api/staff/audit/export",
        "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark",
        "GET /api/staff/restore",
        "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close",
        // 3d Task 2: an admin's release of a seal for good.
        "POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release",
      ].sort(),
    );
  });

  test("every staff route that changes something asks for the key, but the named exceptions: enrolment, sign-in, the step-up's own options, sign-out, and saving a text, taking a snapshot and opening a finding", () => {
    const { guarded } = build();
    const changing = [...guarded].filter(([route]) => !route.startsWith("GET ") && !route.startsWith("ALL "));
    const stepUps = Object.fromEntries(changing.flatMap(([route, marks]) => marks.filter((mark) => mark.startsWith("step-up:")).map((mark) => [route, mark.slice("step-up:".length)])));
    // Each confirmed route, with the one action its key confirms.
    expect(stepUps).toEqual({
      "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle": "staff_session_revoked",
      "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions": "case_decided",
      "POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review": "appeals_reviewed",
      "POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal": "identity_revealed",
      // 3f, Task 2: an order's clock event, closing, reopening or extension.
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/events": "order_event_recorded",
      // Task 3: "Disable for an order".
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/effect": "order_effected",
      // Task 6: the audit log's download, and a gap closed as not needed.
      "POST /api/staff/audit/export": "audit_exported",
      "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close": "gap_closed",
      // 3d Task 2: the release of a seal for good.
      "POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release": "seal_released",
    });
    // The changing routes without a step-up, by method and path: 3a's four kinds, and the three of moderation cases,
    // none of which changes anything a user sees (3c design, section 2, Free text under the step-up).
    const unconfirmed = changing.filter(([route]) => !(route in stepUps)).map(([route]) => route);
    expect(unconfirmed.sort()).toEqual(
      [
        "POST /api/staff/enroll/options",
        "POST /api/staff/enroll/verify",
        "POST /api/staff/signin/options",
        "POST /api/staff/signin/verify",
        "POST /api/staff/step-up/options",
        "POST /api/staff/signout",
        "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/texts",
        "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/snapshots",
        "POST /api/staff/findings",
        // 3f: closing a message at the contact point restricts nothing and tells nobody (design, section 7.3).
        "POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close",
        // 3f, Task 2: opening an order and adding its links restrict nothing, copy nothing and tell nobody (section 7.4). A
        // correction asks for the key only under the rule admin, which the database decides after effect: the route takes
        // the step-up of order_corrected when the body carries one, and answers staff_step_up_required under that rule
        // without one (http-staff-orders proves both), so its chain holds no step-up of its own.
        "POST /api/staff/orders",
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items",
        "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/correct",
        // Task 6: the mark shows nothing, and can only say "I hold it" of a file a key released (section 7.16).
        "POST /api/staff/audit/export/mark",
      ].sort(),
    );
    // Every route stands behind the staff session but enrolment and sign-in, whose credential is the link or the key.
    const open = [...guarded].filter(([route, marks]) => !route.startsWith("ALL ") && !marks.includes("session")).map(([route]) => route);
    expect(open.sort()).toEqual(["POST /api/staff/enroll/options", "POST /api/staff/enroll/verify", "POST /api/staff/signin/options", "POST /api/staff/signin/verify"]);
    // And a step-up always follows the session guard, once.
    for (const [route, marks] of guarded) if (route in stepUps) expect(marks, route).toEqual(["session", `step-up:${stepUps[route]}`]);
  });

  test("no staff route answers HEAD: on every path of the staff module a HEAD from the console's own host is the unknown route, with no body, and no session guard runs for it", async () => {
    const { app, staffOwn, runs } = build();
    const host = new URL(CONSOLE_ORIGIN).host;
    // Every GET route of the module with its parameters filled in: an id, and for the image route a size it takes.
    const fill = (routePath: string) => routePath.split("/").map((segment) => (segment === ":size" ? "small" : segment.startsWith(":") ? SAMPLE_PARAMETER : segment)).join("/");
    const reads = [...new Set(staffOwn.filter((r) => r.method === "GET").map((r) => fill(r.path)))];
    expect(reads).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["/api/staff/me", "/api/staff/sessions", "/api/staff/audit", "/api/staff/overview", "/api/staff/queue", `/api/staff/cases/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}`, `/api/staff/cases/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}/media/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}/small`]));
    // Hono would answer a HEAD with the GET route's handlers and drop the body: none of them may run.
    const others = ["/api/staff", "/api/staff/signout", "/api/staff/findings", `/api/staff/cases/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}/snapshots`, "/api/staff/no/such/path"];
    for (const p of [...reads, ...others]) {
      const res = await app.request(`${CONSOLE_ORIGIN}${p}`, { method: "HEAD", headers: { host } });
      expect(res.status, p).toBe(404);
      expect(await res.text(), p).toBe("");
    }
    expect(runs.session).toBe(0);
    // The same paths with GET do reach the session guard, which refuses a request that carries no staff cookie.
    for (const p of reads) {
      const res = await app.request(`${CONSOLE_ORIGIN}${p}`, { headers: { host } });
      expect(res.status, p).toBe(401);
    }
    expect(runs.session).toBe(reads.length);
    // A HEAD that fails the gate gets the gate's own answer, as every method does: the gate still stands first.
    expect((await app.request(`${CONSOLE_ORIGIN}/api/staff/overview`, { method: "HEAD", headers: { host: "localhost:8081" } })).status).toBe(404);
    expect((await app.request(`${CONSOLE_ORIGIN}/api/staff/overview`, { method: "HEAD", headers: { host, origin: "http://localhost:8081" } })).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await app.request(`${CONSOLE_ORIGIN}/api/staff/overview`, { method: "HEAD", headers: { host, "sec-fetch-site": "cross-site" } })).status).toBe(403);
    expect(runs.session).toBe(reads.length);
  });

  test("hold no route of another module under /api/staff", () => {
    const { app, staffOwn } = build();
    expect(staffOwn.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Every staff path is probed, the ones the old fixed list left out among them.
    const probes = staffProbes(staffOwn);
    for (const p of [
      "/api/staff/audit",
      "/api/staff/keys",
      "/api/staff/signout",
      "/api/staff/signin/options",
      "/api/staff/signin/verify",
      "/api/staff/enroll/options",

      `/api/staff/cases/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}/media/${SAMPLE_PARAMETER}`,

      "/api/staff/items",

  test("the check catches another module's route under /api/staff, a pattern that reaches it, and a second copy of a staff route", () => {
    const staffSub = new Hono();
    staffSub.use("*", async (_c, next) => next());
    staffSub.get("/me", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.get("/audit", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.get("/keys", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.post("/signout", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.post("/signin/verify", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.post("/enroll/options", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    staffSub.delete("/sessions/:handle", (c) => c.text("staff"));
    const app = new Hono();
    app.use(async (_c, next) => next());
    app.route("/api/staff", staffSub);
    // As the social module is mounted at /api: a route of its own under /api/staff, ones whose parameter reaches a staff
    // path (with a method the staff module does not answer there, which would fall through to it), and a copy of a staff
    // route.
    const other = new Hono();
    other.get("/staff/extra", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/me", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.post("/:section/audit", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.put("/:section/keys", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/signout", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/signin/verify", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/enroll/:step", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/sessions/:id", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/staff/me", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/profiles/:handle", (c) => c.text("other"));
    other.get("/:section/feed", (c) => c.text("other"));
    app.route("/api", other);
    const staffOwn = staffSub.routes.map((r) => ({ method: r.method, path: `/api/staff${r.path}` }));
    expect(foreignStaffRoutes(app.routes, staffOwn)).toEqual([
      "GET /api/staff/extra",
      "GET /api/:section/me",
      "POST /api/:section/audit",
      "PUT /api/:section/keys",
      "GET /api/:section/signout",
      "GET /api/:section/signin/verify",
      "GET /api/:section/enroll/:step",
      "GET /api/:section/sessions/:id",
      "GET /api/staff/me",
    ]);
  });

  test("no route changes a role: no path names one, and only grant-role's command line reaches the statements that do", () => {
    const { app } = build();
    expect(app.routes.filter((r) => ROLE_PATH.test(r.path)).map(keyOf)).toEqual([]);
    expect(roleWriterViolations(sources())).toEqual([]);
    // The rules catch a deliberate violation.
    expect(ROLE_PATH.test("/api/staff/users/:id/role")).toBe(true);
    expect(ROLE_PATH.test("/api/admin/grant")).toBe(true);
    expect(ROLE_PATH.test("/api/profiles/:handle")).toBe(false);
    expect(
      roleWriterViolations([
        { path: "staff/routes.ts", source: "routes.post('/x', (c) => auth.grantRole(email, 'admin'))" },
        { path: "auth/flows/x.ts", source: "await deps.repo.setRole(userId, 'admin');" },
        { path: "cli/grant-role.ts", source: "await grantRole(deps, email, role);" },
      ]),
    ).toEqual(["staff/routes.ts", "auth/flows/x.ts"]);
  });

  test("no route acts as another user or reads another user's sessions, email, IP, device or phone: no staff path names an account, and no staff answer has a member that would", () => {
    const { app } = build();
    // The path parameters under /api/staff are a staff session's handle, which the revocation takes only from the
    // person's own sessions (the step-up suites show another account's is not found), a case's id, an image's id with its
    // size, an item's id and a decision's id: a case, an image of its post, an item of a notice and the decision an appeal
    // is about, never an account.
    const parameters = distinct(app.routes.filter((r) => isStaffPath(r.path) && r.path.includes(":")));
    expect(parameters).toEqual([
      "DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle",
      "GET /api/staff/cases/:case",
      "GET /api/staff/cases/:case/media/:media/:size",
      "GET /api/staff/cases/:case/texts",
      // 3f: an order (Task 2).
      "GET /api/staff/orders/:order",
      "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions",
      "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/snapshots",
      "POST /api/staff/cases/:case/texts",
      // 3f: a message at the contact point.
      "POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close",
      "POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review",
      "POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal",
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/correct",
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/effect",
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/events",
      "POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items",
      // 3f Task 6: a restore gap.
      "POST /api/staff/restore/gaps/:gap/close",
      // 3d Task 2: a seal, by its ledger row.
      "POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release",
    ]);
    const answers = {
      StaffMe,
      StaffSession,
      StaffKey,
      AuditEntry,
      StaffSessionsResponse,
      StaffKeysResponse,
      AuditPage,
      StaffEnrollVerifyResponse,
      StaffOverview,
      QueuePage,
      CaseView,
      StaffTextSaved,
      StaffTextsResponse,
      StaffSnapshotTaken,
      FindingResponse,
      RevealResponse,
      AppealsPage,
      StandingLists,
      ContactPage,
      OrdersPage,
      OrderView,
      // 3f Task 6.
      RestoreView,
    };
    const members = Object.entries(answers).flatMap(([name, schema]) => memberNames(schema).map((member) => `${name}.${member}`));
    // The walk read every member of every answer: none is of a kind it has not been taught, behind which a name could hide.
    expect(members.filter((member) => member.includes(UNREAD))).toEqual([]);
    expect(members.filter((member) => PERSONAL.test(member.split(".").at(-1)!))).toEqual([]);
    // Both checks catch a deliberate violation: a member of an unread kind is listed as one, at the top or inside a list,
    // and a personal member inside one is then not seen, which is why none may be left.

    expect(memberNames(z.object({ list: z.array(z.object({ inner: z.object({ email: z.string() }).nullable() })) }))).toEqual(["list", "list.inner", "list.inner.email"]);
    // The browser's coarse label and the actor's public handle are what the console shows of a session and a row.
    expect(members).toContain("StaffSession.browser");
