    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.profile);
    // What was done, in the measures' own labels.
    for (const label of ["Remove", "Seal the images this case reaches", "Withhold the post", "Reset bio", "Lift the restriction of the post"]) expect(text, label).toContain(label);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.rule("R3"));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.law);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.ended);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.correction);
    expect(count(text, "You can appeal until")).toBe(1);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute("2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noDecisions);
  });

  test("the answer to an appeal that kept the decision reads as a kept decision, never as No action; a reversal by what it lifted", () => {
    const kept = row({ id: id(8), kind: "review", outcome: "kept", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const reversed = row({ id: id(9), kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const text = textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[kept, reversed, row()]} />));
    expect(CASES_WORDS.keptDecision).toBe("korbat kept its decision");
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.keptDecision)).toBe(1);
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
    expect(text).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    // A final decision without a measure that ended nothing still reads No action.
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row({ id: id(10), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null })]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
  });

  const reports = (extra: Partial<ReportsPage> = {}): ReportsPage => ({
    reports: [
      { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ link: `${APP}/u/old_handle`, scope: "account", outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(21), unfounded: false }, { ...waiting, position: 2, id: id(22), unfounded: false }] },
      { ref: "N-BCDEFGH234", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ outcome: "not_evident", unseen: true, reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(23), unfounded: false }] },
    ],
    nextCursor: null,
    reportMailStopped: false,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("Your reports lists each report with its items as the status page words them: the account under the handle the report named, the outcome once released, and whether it can still be examined again", () => {
    const answer = reports();
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={answer} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/u/old_handle`);
    expect(text).toContain(itemOutcomeWords(answer.reports[0]!.items[0]!)!);
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.waiting);
    expect(text).toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
    // Without a stop there is no notice and no button.
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(textOf(html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reports: [] })} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noReports);
  });

  test("when the account's address stopped korbat's report mails, the tab says so above the list, with the button that resumes them and what that also allows", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reportMailStopped: true })} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([CASES_WORDS.resume]);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.resumeHint);
    expect(text.indexOf(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("N-ABCDEFGH23"));
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('resumeReportMail: () => api("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" })');
  });
});

describe("a decision's screen", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final" as const,
    outcome: "restricted" as const,
    ground: "incompatible" as const,
    ruleId: "R3" as const,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
    reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
    source: "report" as const,
    decidedAt: TIME,
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
    measures: [{ kind: "remove" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };
  const image = (n: number) => ({ id: id(n), alt: `picture ${n}`, width: 800, height: 600, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const view = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}): DecisionView => ({
    id: id(3),
    ...statement,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image(7)], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null },
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    standing: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const screen = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}) => html(<DecisionDetail view={view(extra)} />);

  test("a final restriction: the statement as the mail rendered it, the post's time, the content it was made on, and Appeal with its deadline", () => {
    const out = screen();
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(view())) expect(text).toContain(paragraph);
    expect(text).toContain(`"${getRule("R3", 2)!.title}"`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
    expect(text).toContain("the words that were judged");
    // The image comes from the app's own image route, with its description.
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining(`/api/media/${id(7)}/small.webp`)]);
    expect(out).toContain('alt="picture 7"');
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appeal);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil("2027-04-04 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a decision taken while korbat decides: the interim redress, and no Appeal", () => {
    const interim = { kind: "interim" as const, measures: [{ kind: "withhold" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }], appealUntil: null };
    const text = textOf(screen(interim));
    expect(text).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.interim);
    // Neither the section nor its sentence: the interim redress never says the word.
    expect(text).not.toContain("Appeal");
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a restriction reversed in full says on which day, in place of Appeal", () => {
    const text = textOf(screen({ appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }));
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text: each sealed image is drawn as its placeholder, and nothing is loaded for it", () => {
    const sealed = {
      kind: "interim" as const,
      ruleId: "R2" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }],
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "post" as const, body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" as const },
    };
    const out = screen(sealed);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("text beside the images");
    expect(count(text, SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealPost("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC", 2));
  });

  test("a post its author deleted: korbat's copy of the text under its own heading, and its images kept and not shown", () => {
    const out = screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deleted);
    expect(text.indexOf(DECISION_WORDS.deleted)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("deleted since"));
    expect(count(text, DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages)).toBe(1);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    // A deleted post without images says nothing of images.
    expect(textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } }))).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages);
  });

  test("content korbat no longer holds: erased under the retention rules on its day, with the profile sentence only for a post its author kept; or erased by the R4 decision", () => {
    const kept = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: true } }));
    expect(kept).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06")} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}`);
    const gone = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: false } }));
    expect(gone).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06"));
    expect(gone).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.postKept);
    const redacted = textOf(screen({ ruleId: "R4", content: { kind: "r4_redacted" } }));
    expect(redacted).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted);
    expect(redacted).not.toContain("was erased on");
    // The post's time stays on the screen whatever became of the content.
    for (const text of [kept, gone, redacted]) expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, and links the decision that reset a field while its value is still kept", () => {
    const reset = {
      post: null,
      ruleId: "R6" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const text = textOf(screen(reset));
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.bio} what the bio said`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.displayName} Ada`);
    expect(text).not.toContain("Your post of");
    // A later decision that lifts the reset: its statement says where the old value can be read, and the screen links there.
    const lifted = {
      kind: "correction" as const,
      outcome: "reversed" as const,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      facts: null,
      post: null,
      measures: [],
      reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio" as const, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: id(3), oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" as const }],
      reviewed: { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: TIME },
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const out = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    // Once the old value is gone, nothing links there.
    const erased = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted, reversals: [{ ...lifted.reversals[0]!, oldValueKept: false }] });
    expect(hrefs(erased)).not.toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
  });

  test("the screen asks for the decision by the id in its address and says when there is none for this account", () => {
    const source = read("app", "settings", "cases", "[id].tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("moderation.decision(id)");
    expect(source).toContain("DECISION_WORDS.notFound");
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain("decision: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: DecisionView })");
  });
});

describe("the chips and the labels", () => {
  const post = (extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(1),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: "my own post",
    createdAt: TIME,
    state: "removed",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada" } } });
  const image = (n: number, moderation?: MediaView["moderation"]): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp`, ...(moderation ? { moderation } : {}) });

  test("the chip's four texts: under review or removed, under a rule or as illegal content", () => {
    expect(CHIP_WORDS).toEqual({ underReview: "Under review", removed: "Removed", illegal: "illegal content" });
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe("Under review: R4");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true })).toBe("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: "R3", interim: false })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false })).toBe("Removed: illegal content");
  });

  test("3e: a removed post's chip names its strike while the strike stands and counts, with the day it stops counting", () => {
    const until = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3" as const, legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: until };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe(`Removed: R3, strike until ${standingDay(until)}`);
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, strikeUntil: null })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = textOf(html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: decision })} />));
    expect(removed).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.chip("Removed: R3", until));
  });

  test("the author's own withheld or removed post shows the chip as a link to the decision's statement, amber while korbat decides and red once removed", () => {
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(removed)).toContain("Removed: R3");
    expect(hrefs(removed)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    const held = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: id(4), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(held)).toContain("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(hrefs(held)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(4)}`);
    // The colours are class names, which a render without the style compiler does not carry: they are read from the source.
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain('const amber = decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld";');
    expect(card).toContain('const surface = `self-start rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 ${amber ? "bg-amber-500/15" : "bg-red-500/15"}`;');
    // Without the decision's facts the chip still says the state, and links nowhere.
    const bare = html(<PostCard post={post()} />);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain("Removed");
    expect(hrefs(bare).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    // A post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place, without a chip: the post itself is visible.
    const sealedMedia: HiddenMedia[] = [{ id: id(21), hidden: true, sealed: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true, sealed: true }];
    const sealed = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: sealedMedia })} />);
    expect(textOf(sealed)).toContain("my own post");
    expect(count(textOf(sealed), SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(hrefs(sealed).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    // Anyone else reads the placeholder of a hidden image for each of them.
    const others = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: [{ id: id(21), hidden: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true }] })} />);
    expect(count(textOf(others), HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(others)).not.toContain(SEALED_IMAGE);
  });

  test("the author's own withheld image says Under review on itself and a removed one Removed, in the post and in the viewer; anyone else gets one placeholder for both", () => {
    const own = html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1, "withheld"), image(2, "removed"), image(3)]} postId={id(1)} own />);
    const text = textOf(own);
    expect(count(text, "Under review")).toBe(1);
    expect(count(text, "Removed")).toBe(1);
    // The author still sees their own images.
    expect(loaded(own)).toHaveLength(3);
    const noop = () => undefined;
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(1, "withheld")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Under review");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(2, "removed")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Removed");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(3)]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
    // For anyone else the API sends the same hidden image for a withheld and a removed one: one placeholder, which does not say which.
    const hidden: HiddenMedia = { id: id(1), hidden: true };
    const others = textOf(html(<MediaGrid media={[hidden, { ...hidden, id: id(2) }]} postId={id(1)} />));
    expect(count(others, HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(others).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
  });
});

describe("3e: strikes on Cases and on the decision's screen (design, sections 9.2 and 9.4)", () => {
  const COUNTS = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-12",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove", "strike"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: null,
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: null },
    ...extra,
  });
  const list = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow>, now = new Date("2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z")) => textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row(extra)]} now={now} />));

  test("the numbers of the sentences are STANDING_RULES', and a time names the device's minute and the UTC one", () => {
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2)).toBe("Active strikes: 2 of 3. At 3, a moderator may announce a suspension; you would be told first and could reply.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none).toBe("You have no active strikes.");
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").endsWith("(14:05 UTC)")).toBe(true);
    expect(standingTime("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z").startsWith(standingDay("2026-10-16T14:05:00.000Z"))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("Your standing stands above About you: the active strikes and what that many leads to, or that there are none", () => {
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={0} />))).toBe(`${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title} ${STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none}`);
    expect(textOf(html(<StandingBlock activeStrikes={2} />))).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(2));
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain("setActiveStrikes(page.activeStrikes)");
    expect(screen.indexOf("<StandingBlock")).toBeLessThan(screen.indexOf("<DecisionsList"));
  });

  test("a row names the strike after the post measure, with where it stands, and an overruling in its own words", () => {
    expect(list({})).toContain(`Remove, ${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.counts(COUNTS)})`);
    expect(list({}, new Date("2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z"))).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.expired})`);
    expect(list({ strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, overruledAt: "2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z" } })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overruled})`);
    expect(list({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["overrule", "restore"], strike: null })).toContain(`${CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule}, ${MEASURES.restore.label}`);
  });

  test("the decision's screen says where its strike stands now, below the statement", () => {
    const view: DecisionView = {
      id: id(3),
      kind: "final",
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      ruleId: "R3",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 2,
      legalReference: null,
      facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
      reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
      source: "report",
      decidedAt: TIME,
      post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
      measures: [
        { kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null },
        { kind: "strike", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, endsAt: COUNTS, activeThen: 1 },
      ],
      reversals: [],
      endedMeasures: [],
      reviewed: null,
      appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
      reversedOn: null,
      content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: null },
      appeal: null,
      strike: { countsUntil: COUNTS, state: "counts", overruledAt: null },
      standing: null,
    };
    const screen = (strike: DecisionView["strike"]) => textOf(html(<DecisionDetail view={{ ...view, strike }} />));
    const counting = screen(view.strike);
    expect(counting).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.strike.counts(COUNTS));
    expect(counting).toContain("This decision gives your account a strike.");
    expect(counting.indexOf("This decision gives your account a strike.")).toBeLessThan(counting.indexOf(STANDING_TEXTS.strike.counts(COUNTS)));
    expect(screen({ countsUntil: COUNTS, state: "expired", overruledAt: null })).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.strike.expired(COUNTS));
    expect(screen({ countsUntil: COUNTS, state: "overruled", overruledAt: "2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z" })).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.strike.overruled("2026-10-20T08:00:00.000Z"));
    expect(screen(null)).not.toContain("Strike:");
  });
});

describe("3e: a retired handle in the app (design, sections 9.4, 9.5 and 9.8)", () => {
  const PLACEHOLDER = "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f";
  const me = (handle: string, handleChangedAt: string | null = null): MeResponse => ({
    user: { id: id(1), email: "ada@example.com", role: "user", onboarded: true, mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, passkeys: 0 },
    profile: { id: id(1), handle, displayName: "Ada", handleChangedAt, verified: false, showInExplore: true },
    standing: null,
  });
  const section = (handle: string, handleChangedAt: string | null = null) => textOf(html(<HandleSection me={me(handle, handleChangedAt)} run={async () => undefined} refresh={async () => undefined} />));

  test("the words are the design's: the retired handle's sentence, the standing sentence, and the refusal", () => {
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.handle.retired).toBe("korbat retired your handle; the decision is under Settings, Cases. Choose a new one: the 30-day wait does not apply this time.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.handle.standing("ada_l")).toBe("Your handle is @ada_l. You can change it once every 30 days. Handles you used before stay yours, except one that korbat retired.");

/**
 * The shapes of appeals and re-examination (3c design, sections 7.2, 7.7 and 10): what the author and whoever reported
 * may send, what the console lists of the appeals that wait, and the marks by which the console says who may review one.
 */
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const TIME = "2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z";
const TOKEN = "t".repeat(43);

describe("an appeal's and a re-examination's request", () => {
  test("the statement is optional and free of form, under the rules of every free text, and at most 2000 characters", () => {
    expect(STATEMENT_MAX).toBe(2000);
    expect(DAILY_LIMITS).toEqual({ appeals: 5, reexaminations: 5 });
    for (const schema of [AppealRequest, ReexamineRequest]) {
      expect(schema.parse({})).toEqual({});
      expect(schema.parse({ statement: "Line one.\nLine two." })).toEqual({ statement: "Line one.\nLine two." });
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x".repeat(STATEMENT_MAX) }).success).toBe(true);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x".repeat(STATEMENT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(false);
      // Nothing is trimmed, changed or dropped: an empty text, a control character and an unknown member are refused.
      for (const statement of ["", "   ", `a${String.fromCharCode(0)}b`, `a${String.fromCharCode(0x202e)}b`]) expect(schema.safeParse({ statement }).success, JSON.stringify(statement)).toBe(false);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x", decisionId: id(1) }).success).toBe(false);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a notifier names the notice by its reference with a token, and the item by its position on the status page, 1 to 20", () => {
    const request = { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", token: TOKEN, position: 1 };
    expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.parse(request)).toEqual(request);
    expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.parse({ ...request, position: 20, statement: "Look again." })).toEqual({ ...request, position: 20, statement: "Look again." });
    for (const position of [0, 21, 1.5, "1"]) expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.safeParse({ ...request, position }).success, String(position)).toBe(false);
    for (const broken of [{ ...request, ref: "nope" }, { ...request, token: undefined }, { ...request, itemId: id(1) }, { ref: request.ref, position: 1 }]) {
      expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.safeParse(broken).success, JSON.stringify(broken)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("the answer names the positions that are examined again: one, or two with the item korbat added for a quoted post", () => {
    expect(ReexamineResponse.parse({ positions: [1] })).toEqual({ positions: [1] });
    expect(ReexamineResponse.parse({ positions: [1, 11] })).toEqual({ positions: [1, 11] });
    for (const positions of [[], [1, 11, 2], [0], [21]]) expect(ReexamineResponse.safeParse({ positions }).success, JSON.stringify(positions)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the review's request", () => {
  const params = {
    stateVersion: 2,
    appealId: id(1),
    snapshotId: id(2),
    snapshotDigest: "a".repeat(64),
    outcome: "partly_reversed",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
    actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }],

  };

  test("is the action's params with the key's assertion beside them, and keeps the params' own rules", () => {

    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse({ ...params, stepUp }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse(params).success).toBe(false);
    // A review lifts and never restricts, with or without the assertion beside it.
    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse({ ...params, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }], stepUp }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse({ ...params, outcome: "restricted", stepUp }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse({ ...params, reasonDigest: null, stepUp }).success).toBe(false);

describe("laneFor", () => {
  const TC: TdbCategory = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";

  test("a rule report takes its rule's lane: R2 and R5 are urgent, R3 and R4 next, R1 and R6 last", () => {
    const lanes = RULE_IDS.map((ruleId) => laneFor({ ruleId, allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category: TC }));
    expect(lanes).toEqual([2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2]);
  });

  test("the CSAM path is lane 0 whatever else the intake says", () => {
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: false, csam: true, category: TC })).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a notice of illegality takes its category's lane, for every category", () => {
    const urgent = ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM"];
    const next = [
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
    ];
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      const expected = urgent.includes(category) ? 0 : next.includes(category) ? 1 : 2;
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(expected);
    }
  });

  test("a notice of illegality that also cites a rule takes the more severe of the two lanes", () => {
    // Fraud (lane 2) under R5 (lane 0), and violence (lane 0) under R1 (lane 2): both are urgent.
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R5", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(1);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R6", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE" })).toBe(2);
  });

  test("where nothing is alleged to be illegal, the category is korbat's own classification and moves no lane", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(2);
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(1);
    }
  });
});

    expect(DAILY_LIMITS).toEqual({ appeals: 5, reexaminations: 5 });
  });

  test("the retention periods of the design's table", () => {
    expect(RETENTION).toEqual({
      r4FinalMonths: 6,
      intakeDays: 30,
      resetValueDays: 30,
      evidenceHours: 24,
      statementMonths: 12,
      accessLogMonths: 12,
      contactMonths: 6,
      contactMaxMonths: 13,
      confirmationDays: 30,
      backupDays: 30,
      draftHours: 24,
      mailGiveUpDays: 5,
      // 3e (design, sections 6.7 and 10.1, W.7): a reply's text, the reporting counts and the record of standing measures.
      replyText: "until korbat has answered it and its decision can no longer be appealed",
      reportCountDays: 90,
      standingRecord: { strikeDays: 90, ladderMemoryDays: 365, warningDays: 90 },
      // 3f (design, sections 6.8 and 10.1, W.6): a handled message, what a removal order disabled, an order's and an
      // authority's records, and a restore gap closed as not needed or imported.
      contactMessageDays: 30,
      orderPreserveMonths: 6,
      orderRecordYears: 3,
      restoreGapMonths: 12,
    });
    // Content restricted under R4 goes when its restriction is final: the appeal's window.
    expect(RETENTION.r4FinalMonths).toBe(APPEAL_MONTHS);
    // 3e's periods are the standing rules' own numbers, read from STANDING_RULES and never typed twice.
    expect(RETENTION.reportCountDays).toBe(STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays);
    expect(RETENTION.standingRecord).toEqual({ strikeDays: STANDING_RULES.strikeDays, ladderMemoryDays: STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays, warningDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays });
    // 3f's are order_rules()' own numbers, read from ORDER_RULES, which mirrors the function, and never typed twice.
    expect([RETENTION.contactMessageDays, RETENTION.orderPreserveMonths, RETENTION.orderRecordYears, RETENTION.restoreGapMonths]).toEqual([
      ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays,
      ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths,
      ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears,
      ORDER_RULES.gapKeepMonths,
    ]);
  });
});

describe("the measures", () => {
  const kinds = Object.keys(MEASURES) as ActionKind[];
  const measures = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
  const reversals = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts !== null);

  test("every action kind has an entry: 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals, then 3f's measure and its reversal", () => {
    expect(kinds).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
      "disable_by_order",
      "reinstate_by_order",
    ]);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toEqual(kinds);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toHaveLength(24);
    expect(measures).toEqual([...kinds.slice(0, 7), ...kinds.slice(12, 18), "disable_by_order"]);
    expect(reversals).toEqual([...kinds.slice(7, 12), ...kinds.slice(18, 22), "reinstate_by_order"]);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toEqual(measures);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toHaveLength(14);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toEqual(reversals);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toHaveLength(10);
  });

  test("a post or one image is withheld only while deciding and removed only when the case is decided; a seal and a reset are either; 3e's measures only when it is decided", () => {
    const when = (kind: ActionKind) => [MEASURES[kind].interim, MEASURES[kind].final];
    expect(when("withhold")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("withhold_media")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("remove")).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(when("remove_media")).toEqual([false, true]);
    for (const kind of ["seal_media", "reset_display_name", "reset_bio"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([true, true]);
    for (const kind of ["strike", "suspend", "terminate", "retire_handle", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, true]);
    // A reversal is neither: which decision may hold one is the reversed measure's matter.
    for (const kind of reversals) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, false]);
  });

  test("each measure has its target, and each reversal lifts the measures of its own target", () => {
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].target]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "post",
      remove: "post",
      seal_media: "images",
      withhold_media: "image",
      remove_media: "image",
      reset_display_name: "display_name",
      reset_bio: "bio",
      restore: "post",
      unseal_media: "images",
      restore_media: "image",
      restore_display_name: "display_name",
      restore_bio: "bio",
      strike: "account",
      suspend: "account",
      terminate: "account",
      retire_handle: "handle",
      warn_reporting: "reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "reporting",
      overrule: "account",
      lift_suspension: "account",
      unretire_handle: "handle",
      lift_reporting: "reporting",
      disable_by_order: "post",
      reinstate_by_order: "post",
    });
    expect(Object.fromEntries(reversals.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].lifts]))).toEqual({
      restore: ["withhold", "remove"],
      unseal_media: ["seal_media"],
      restore_media: ["withhold_media", "remove_media"],
      restore_display_name: ["reset_display_name"],
      restore_bio: ["reset_bio"],
      overrule: ["strike"],
      lift_suspension: ["suspend", "terminate"],
      unretire_handle: ["retire_handle"],
      lift_reporting: ["warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"],
      reinstate_by_order: ["disable_by_order"],
    });
    // Every measure can be lifted, by exactly one kind of reversal, of the measure's own target.
    for (const measure of measures) expect(reversals.filter((kind) => (MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]).includes(measure)), measure).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const kind of reversals) for (const lifted of MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]) expect(MEASURES[lifted].target, kind).toBe(MEASURES[kind].target);
    // Only the three timed kinds sign their days and whether they are announced.
    expect(TIMED_KINDS).toEqual(["suspend", "terminate", "restrict_reporting"]);
  });

  test("each has a label of its own: the composer's words where the composer names the measure", () => {
    // The first seven and "Lift the seal" are the words of the decision composer; the composer, the statement and the
    // terms all take them from here. 3e's are W.1's.
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].label]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "Withhold the post",
      remove: "Remove",
      seal_media: "Seal the images this case reaches",
      withhold_media: "Withhold one image",
      remove_media: "Remove one image",
      reset_display_name: "Reset display name",
      reset_bio: "Reset bio",
      restore: "Lift the restriction of the post",
      unseal_media: "Lift the seal",
      restore_media: "Lift the restriction of one image",
      restore_display_name: "Lift the reset of the display name",
      restore_bio: "Lift the reset of the bio",
      strike: "Strike",
      suspend: "Suspend the account",
      terminate: "Terminate the account",
      retire_handle: "Retire the handle",
      warn_reporting: "Warn about reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "Restrict reporting",
      overrule: "Overrule the strike",
      lift_suspension: "Lift the suspension",
      unretire_handle: "Give the handle back",
      lift_reporting: "Lift the reporting measure",
      // 3f (W.1).
      disable_by_order: "Disabled for an order",
      reinstate_by_order: "Reinstate after an order",
    });
    const labels = kinds.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label);
    expect(new Set(labels).size).toBe(labels.length);
  });
});

describe("the order of a decision's actions", () => {
  const a = "1a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const b = "2a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

  test("by kind as a string, then by image as a string, an action without an image first", () => {
    const sorted: DecisionActionParams[] = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: a },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: b },
      { kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: a },
    ];
    for (const shuffled of [[...sorted].reverse(), [sorted[3]!, sorted[0]!, sorted[5]!, sorted[2]!, sorted[1]!, sorted[4]!]]) {
      expect([...shuffled].sort(compareDecisionActions)).toEqual(sorted);
    }
    expect(compareDecisionActions(sorted[1]!, sorted[1]!)).toBe(0);
    expect(compareDecisionActions({ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: a })).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});

describe("textDigest", () => {
  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(TEXT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.text.v1");
  });

  test.each(TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => [vector.name, vector] as const))("%s: the sha256 of the tag, a line feed, the salt's bytes and the text's UTF-8 bytes", async (_name, vector) => {
    expect(await textDigest(vector.salt, vector.text)).toBe(vector.digest);
  });

  test("the longest vector is 5000 UTF-16 units, and the vectors hold a line feed, a character outside ASCII and one outside the basic plane", () => {
    expect(Math.max(...TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text.length))).toBe(5000);
    const all = TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text).join("");
    expect(all).toContain(LF);
    expect(all).toContain(E_ACUTE);
    expect(all).toContain(GRINNING);
  });

  test("another salt or another text gives another digest", async () => {
    const digests = await Promise.all([textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a2".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one "), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "One")]);
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a salt that is not 32 bytes of lower-case hex is refused, never padded or folded", async () => {
    for (const salt of ["", "a1".repeat(31), "a1".repeat(33), "A1".repeat(32), "g1".repeat(32), ` ${"a1".repeat(32)}`]) {
      await expect(textDigest(salt, "text"), JSON.stringify(salt)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("a text with a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 bytes, is refused rather than hashed as something else", async () => {
    const high = String.fromCharCode(0xd83d);
    const low = String.fromCharCode(0xde00);
    for (const text of [high, low, `a${high}b`, `${low}${high}`]) await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), text)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    // The pair itself is a character.
    await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), `${high}${low}`)).resolves.toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  });
});

describe("snapshotText and snapshotDigest", () => {
  const post: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "ab".repeat(32),
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z",
    authorHandle: "ada",
    postState: "visible",
    postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z",
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36",
    body: `Line one${LF}caf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}`,
    media: [
      { id: "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555", alt: "A cat", width: 1200, height: 800 },
      { id: "66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa", alt: null, width: 640, height: 480 },
    ],
    displayName: null,
    bio: null,
    handle: null,
  };
  const account: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "cd".repeat(32),
    targetType: "account",
    targetId: "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z",
    authorHandle: "bob",
    postState: null,
    postCreatedAt: null,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    body: null,
    media: null,
    displayName: `Bob ${GRINNING}`,
    bio: "",
    handle: "bob",
  };
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  // The texts and the digests below were computed with Python's json and hashlib when they were written.
  const POST_TEXT =
    `{"authorHandle":"ada","bio":null,"body":"Line one${BS}ncaf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}","displayName":null,"handle":null,` +
    `"media":[{"alt":"A cat","height":800,"id":"11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","width":1200},{"alt":null,"height":480,"id":"66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa","width":640}],` +
    `"postCreatedAt":"2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z","postState":"visible","quoteOfId":"7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36","replyToId":null,` +
    `"salt":"${"ab".repeat(32)}","takenAt":"2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z","targetId":"3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a","targetType":"post","v":1}`;
  const POST_DIGEST = "cb995d11ed14e3c4e555c187d319a86506b263e98f924f59f2f7d5231a3bc6e6";
  const ACCOUNT_DIGEST = "41019b2a47d4ebad37cc8c5ad25f8d79a7232c4e3e705231f9e9ba1e02fb1f26";

  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.snapshot.v1");
  });

  test("the text is the sorted JSON of version 1 and the snapshot's fifteen members", () => {
    expect(snapshotText(post)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(snapshotText(account)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.keys(parsed)).toEqual(["authorHandle", "bio", "body", "displayName", "handle", "media", "postCreatedAt", "postState", "quoteOfId", "replyToId", "salt", "takenAt", "targetId", "targetType", "v"]);
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ v: 1, ...account });
  });

  test("the digest is the sha256 of the tag, a line feed and that text", async () => {
    expect(await snapshotDigest(post)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(account)).toBe(ACCOUNT_DIGEST);
  });

  test("it round-trips the snapshot answer's JSON, whatever order and whatever else the answer carries", async () => {
    // As the console receives it: parsed from JSON, with members the digest does not cover, in another order.
    const sent = {
      id: "9d0f5e3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      digest: POST_DIGEST,
      withheld: false,
      erasedAt: null,
      ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(post).reverse()),
      media: post.media!.map((image) => ({ height: image.height, width: image.width, note: "never part of a snapshot", alt: image.alt, id: image.id })),
    };
    const answer = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sent)) as SnapshotDigestInput;
    expect(snapshotText(answer)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(answer)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
  });

  test("any member that changes gives another digest", async () => {
    const changed: SnapshotDigestInput[] = [
      { ...post, salt: "ac".repeat(32) },
      { ...post, takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.124Z" },
      { ...post, body: `${post.body} ` },
      { ...post, postState: "withheld" },
      { ...post, quoteOfId: null },
      { ...post, media: [post.media![1]!, post.media![0]!] },
      { ...post, media: [{ ...post.media![0]!, alt: "A dog" }, post.media![1]!] },
      { ...post, authorHandle: "adb" },
    ];
    const digests = await Promise.all([post, ...changed].map(snapshotDigest));
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(changed.length + 1);
  });

  test("a time that is not the UTC string toISOString writes, to the millisecond, is refused", () => {
    for (const takenAt of ["2026-10-03T10:00:00Z", "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123456Z", "2026-10-03T12:00:00.123+02:00", "2026-10-03 10:00:00.123Z", ""]) {
      expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt }), takenAt).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
    expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00Z" })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 3, 10, 0, 0, 123)).toISOString() })).toBe(POST_TEXT);
  });
});

describe("appealDeadline", () => {
  const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
  const deadline = (iso: string) => appealDeadline(at(iso)).toISOString();

  test("six calendar months later, at the same UTC time", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-10-03T10:15:30.250Z")).toBe("2027-04-03T10:15:30.250Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-07-15T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-07-01T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-01-01T23:59:59.999Z");
  });

  test("a day the sixth month lacks becomes that month's last day", () => {
    // 31 August plus six months is the end of February: the 28th, or the 29th in a leap year.
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-30T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-29T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-03-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-09-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-05-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-11-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-10-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-04-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-12-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-06-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    // A leap day itself moves to 29 August: August has the day.
    expect(deadline("2028-02-29T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-08-29T08:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it is computed in UTC: the last instants of a UTC month stay on that month's side", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T23:59:59.999Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it leaves its argument as it was", () => {
    const informed = at("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
    appealDeadline(informed);
    expect(informed.toISOString()).toBe("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
  });
});

  NOTIFY_ERRORS,
  ORDER_RULES,
  QUARANTINE_RULES,
  StaffOverview,
  alertPlaceholders,
  alertTime,
  isTimeFact,
  renderAlert,
  type AlertFacts,
  type AlertKind,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * Authorities' orders and the alert channel (3f design, sections 6.1, 10.1, 10.2 and 18, W.4): the numbers the database
 * reads, the closed lists, the alert kinds with their legs, and the fixed texts of a push and of 3f's staff mails, which
 * carry counts and UTC times only (invariant 15).
 */

describe("ORDER_RULES and ALERT_RULES", () => {
  test("ORDER_RULES holds every number of order_rules(), each the column's name in camel case, with the design's values", () => {
    expect(ORDER_RULES).toEqual({
      hourMinutes: 60,
      targetMinutes: 55,
      itemsPerAction: 10,
      decisionsPerDay: 50,
      recordsPerDay: 20,
      holdDays: 43,
      holdExtensionDays: 42,
      holdWarningDays: 7,
      unconfirmedHoldHours: null,
      preserveMonths: 6,
      preserveMarginDays: 1,
      reportHoldDays: 7,
      reportAlertHours: 24,
      staleHours: 2,
      quietMinutes: 15,
      escalateMinutes: 15,
      remindMinutes: 45,
      channelDownMinutes: 3,
      pushOwedMinutes: 60,
      copyOverdueHours: 48,
      handoverAlertDays: 7,
      messageKeepDays: 30,
      recordKeepYears: 3,
      gapKeepMonths: 12,
    });
  });

  test("a hold with its one extension ends before the preservation does: hold_days + hold_extension_days days are fewer than preserve_months months", () => {
    // The shortest run of preserve_months calendar months has this many days (February in a common year among them).
    const shortestMonths = 30 * ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths - 3;
    expect(ORDER_RULES.holdDays + ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays).toBeLessThan(shortestMonths);
  });

  test("ALERT_RULES holds only what the database never reads, and no name is in both tables", () => {
    expect(ALERT_RULES).toEqual({ pollSeconds: 20, tickSeconds: 30, mailRetryHours: 24 });
    for (const name of Object.keys(ALERT_RULES)) expect(Object.keys(ORDER_RULES), name).not.toContain(name);
  });
});

describe("the closed lists", () => {
  test("a message's dispositions, of which the close route takes all but order, and its two folders", () => {
    expect(CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS).toEqual(["order", "referral", "first_order_notice", "preservation_request", "scrutiny_decision", "clarification", "not_an_order"]);
    expect(CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS).toEqual(CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS.filter((d) => d !== "order"));
    expect(CONTACT_FOLDERS).toEqual(["inbox", "junk"]);
    expect(CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
  });

  test("the watcher's eight error words, and the channel's four states", () => {
    expect(NOTIFY_ERRORS).toEqual(["imap_connect", "imap_timeout", "imap_tls", "imap_login", "imap_folder", "imap_protocol", "push_connect", "push_refused"]);
    expect(ALERT_CHANNEL_STATES).toEqual(["ok", "down", "mailbox", "off"]);
  });

  test("each disposition has its label (W.1): the six of the Contact point screen and An order", () => {
    expect(DISPOSITION_LABELS).toEqual({
      order: "An order",
      referral: "Referral",
      first_order_notice: "Notice before a first order",
      preservation_request: "Request to preserve longer",
      scrutiny_decision: "Scrutiny decision",
      clarification: "About an order korbat holds",

    });
  });

  test("message_handled is a moderation code", () => {

  });
});

describe("the contact point's requests and answers", () => {
  const message = {
    id: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    folder: "junk",
    receivedAt: "2026-10-12T22:01:02.003Z",
    seenAt: "2026-10-12T22:01:20.000Z",
    stale: false,
    disposition: null,
    handledAt: null,
    handledBy: null,
    orders: [],
  };

  test("ContactPage: messages without a sender or a subject, each strict, at most a page of them", () => {
    expect(ContactPage.parse({ items: [message], nextCursor: null })).toEqual({ items: [message], nextCursor: null });
    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: [{ ...message, subject: "x" }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: [{ ...message, folder: "spam" }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: Array.from({ length: CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 1 }, () => message), nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    const handled = { ...message, disposition: "not_an_order", handledAt: "2026-10-12T22:05:00.000Z", handledBy: "mod_anna" };
    expect(ContactPage.parse({ items: [handled], nextCursor: "abc" }).items[0]!.handledBy).toBe("mod_anna");
  });

  test("ContactQuery takes a cursor and open=1 only; ContactCloseRequest a disposition other than order", () => {
    expect(ContactQuery.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(ContactQuery.parse({ open: "1", cursor: "abc" })).toEqual({ open: "1", cursor: "abc" });
    expect(ContactQuery.safeParse({ open: "0" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactQuery.safeParse({ other: "1" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const disposition of CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS) expect(ContactCloseRequest.parse({ disposition })).toEqual({ disposition });
    expect(ContactCloseRequest.safeParse({ disposition: "order" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactCloseRequest.safeParse({ disposition: "referral", note: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("StaffOverview carries the contact point's counts and the channel's state", () => {
    const shape = StaffOverview.shape;
    expect(shape.contact.parse({ open: 2, oldestAt: message.receivedAt, dueAt: message.receivedAt })).toEqual({ open: 2, oldestAt: message.receivedAt, dueAt: message.receivedAt });
    expect(shape.alerts.parse({ channel: "off", since: null })).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    expect(shape.alerts.safeParse({ channel: "broken", since: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("ALERT_KINDS (10.1): the closed list of alerts with each kind's priority, scope, legs, mail and facts", () => {
  test("the 24 kinds, 3f's sixteen, then 3c's and 3e's six, then 3d's, in the order of the CHECK", () => {
    expect([...ALERT_KIND_LIST]).toEqual([
      "contact_mail",
      "contact_mail_escalated",
      "order_due",

  });

  test("each kind's priority, scope, legs and mail are the table's", () => {
    const row = (kind: AlertKind) => {
      const k = ALERT_KINDS[kind];
      return [k.priority, k.scope, k.legs.join("+"), k.mail];
    };
    const table: Record<AlertKind, unknown[]> = {

      contact_mail_escalated: [5, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      order_due: [5, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],

      hold_ending: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      handover_undestroyed: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      copy_overdue: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      alert_test: [3, "all", "push", null],
      order_opened: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      order_corrected: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      order_effected: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      order_reinstated: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      copy_taken: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      mailbox_unreachable: [5, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],

      moderation_urgent: [5, "on_call", "push+mail", "own"],
      moderation_waiting: [3, "all", "push+mail", "own"],
      moderation_burst: [3, "all", "push+mail", "own"],
      moderation_reads: [3, "all", "push+mail", "own"],
      moderation_reveal: [3, "all", "push+mail", "own"],
      moderation_csam_lifted: [3, "all", "push+mail", "own"],
      quarantine_due: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      quarantine_lost: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      release_undestroyed: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
      seal_released: [3, "all", "push+mail", "sentence"],
    };
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) expect(row(kind), kind).toEqual(table[kind]);
  });

  test("each kind's facts are the design's names, at most six, each a count or a time", () => {
    const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KIND_LIST.map((kind) => [kind, [...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts]]));
    expect(facts).toEqual({
      contact_mail: ["receivedAt", "dueAt"],
      contact_mail_escalated: ["receivedAt", "dueAt"],
      order_due: ["dueAt", "minutesLeft", "itemsOpen"],
      order_opened: ["items", "dueAt", "unknown"],
      order_corrected: ["count", "at"],
      order_effected: ["items", "at", "itemsOpen", "urgent"],
      order_reinstated: ["at"],
      order_unverified: ["count", "textsMissing", "holdsOpen", "oldestAt"],
      hold_ending: ["count", "at"],
      report_owed: ["count", "oldestAt"],
      handover_undestroyed: ["count"],
      copy_overdue: ["hours"],
      copy_taken: ["at", "rows"],
      alert_channel_down: ["since"],
      mailbox_unreachable: ["since"],
      alert_test: ["at"],
      moderation_urgent: ["count", "oldestAt"],

    expect(["count", "items", "minutesLeft", "hours", "rows", "limit", "urgent"].some(isTimeFact)).toBe(false);

  test("every kind says whether its mail is its sentence, its own, or none; a kind is mailed exactly when it has a mail leg", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {

      expect(k.legs.includes("mail"), kind).toBe(k.mail !== null);
      expect(["sentence", "own", null], kind).toContain(k.mail);
      // A kind of 3f has a line of what to do exactly when its mail is its sentence; 3c's and 3e's keep their own mails.
      expect(ALERT_TEXTS[kind].todo !== null, kind).toBe(k.mail === "sentence");
    }
    expect(ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail === "own")).toEqual(["moderation_urgent", "moderation_waiting", "moderation_burst", "moderation_reads", "moderation_reveal", "moderation_csam_lifted"]);

describe("ALERT_TEXTS (W.4): one text serves both legs, and it carries counts and times only (invariant 15)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
  /** One set of facts for a kind: every count is `n`, every time the given instant. */
  const factsOf = (kind: AlertKind, n: number, time: string, over: Partial<Record<string, number | string | undefined>> = {}): AlertFacts => {
    const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = isTimeFact(name) ? time : n;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
      if (!ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.includes(name)) continue;
      if (value === undefined) delete facts[name];
      else facts[name] = value;
    }
    return facts;
  };
  const DIGITS = /[0-9]/g;
  const all = (kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts) => {
    const r = renderAlert(kind, facts, now);
    return [r.title, r.sentence, r.todo ?? ""].join(" | ");
  };

  test("rendered with two sets of facts, every kind's title, sentence and line differ only in their digits", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      // The flags of order_effected and order_opened chose a variant: both sets hold the same flags.
      const flags = { urgent: 0, unknown: 0 };
      const first = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 3, "2026-10-16T07:05:00.000Z", flags));
      const second = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 1234, "2026-10-16T22:49:59.999Z", flags));
      expect(first.replace(DIGITS, ""), kind).toBe(second.replace(DIGITS, ""));
      expect(first, kind).not.toBe(second);
    }
  });

  test("no entry holds an @, a link or a placeholder that is neither a fact of its kind nor a number of ORDER_RULES or QUARANTINE_RULES", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
      const words = [text.title, ...text.sentence.map((part) => part.text), text.todo ?? ""].join(" ");
      expect(words, kind).not.toContain("@");
      expect(words.toLowerCase(), kind).not.toContain("http");
      for (const name of alertPlaceholders(kind)) {
        expect([...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts, ...Object.keys(ORDER_RULES), ...Object.keys(QUARANTINE_RULES)], `${kind}: {${name}}`).toContain(name);
      }
      // Every number a sentence of 3f prints comes from the facts or from ORDER_RULES: no digit is typed. 3c's burst
      // window is 3c's own number, which its push names as its mail does.
      if (ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail !== "own") expect(words.replace(/[{][a-zA-Z]+[}]/g, ""), kind).not.toMatch(DIGITS);
    }
  });

  test("a time prints as 14:05 UTC, with the day when it is not the day of the alert", () => {
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-16T14:05:59.000Z", now)).toBe("14:05 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-15T23:59:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-15 23:59 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-17 00:00 UTC");
  });

  test("the words of the kinds Task 1 sends, as W.4 has them", () => {
    const mail = renderAlert("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now);
    expect(mail).toEqual({
      title: "Mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: `Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.`,
    });
    // A restart of an order's clock has no time of receipt.
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("A removal order's hour has started again: due 09:05 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
    });
    const due = renderAlert("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: 15 }, now);
    expect(due.title).toBe("15 minutes left");
    expect(due.sentence).toBe("A removal order, or mail that may be one, is due 09:05 UTC: 15 minutes are left and it is not carried out in full.");
    expect(due.todo).toBe(
      "Give effect now, to every post the order names. Only if the order has a manifest error, or lacks what you need to find the content, send Annex III and record it: that is no way to stop this alarm. If nobody can act in time: the README, When nobody can act within the hour.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "The contact point cannot be read",
      sentence: "korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since 2026-10-15 23:00 UTC.",
      todo: `Mail that arrives there raises no alert now. Check the mailbox in the mail host's app until this is repaired; an order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator checks the password and the mail host.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Phone alerts are down",
      sentence: "Phone alerts are down since 08:57 UTC: korbat's watcher or its push server does not answer.",
      todo: `Until it is repaired, korbat wakes nobody: the mail host's own app on the on-call phone, signed in to the contact-point mailbox and allowed to ring at night, is the only thing that does. Check now that it is. An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator restarts the notify and ntfy services.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Daily test", sentence: "Daily test, 08:00 UTC. If you read this on your phone, alerts reach it. Nothing to do.", todo: null });
  });

  test("the pushes of 3c's and 3e's kinds name nobody", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_urgent", { count: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:30:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Urgent lane", sentence: "2 cases wait in the urgent lane, the oldest since 08:30 UTC.", todo: null });
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }, now).sentence).toBe("4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_burst", { count: 20 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account confirmed 20 decisions in 15 minutes. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reads", { limit: 200 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account opened 200 different cases today. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reveal", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account revealed who sent a report, at 08:59 UTC. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_csam_lifted", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Reported images are no longer protected",
      sentence: "A decision at 08:59 UTC ended the protection of reported images. Read the staff mail.",
      todo: null,
    });
  });

  test("the variants a fact chooses: an order given effect as urgent, with items still open; the counts of what an order misses", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 3, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 0, urgent: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was given effect at 08:59 UTC: 3 posts disabled.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 2, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 1, urgent: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "An order that is not verified was given effect as urgent at 08:59 UTC: 2 posts disabled. 1 items of the order are still open.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 2, dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:30:00.000Z", unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 2 items. Due 09:30 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. No deadline runs.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. Its deadline is unknown: act now.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_unverified", { count: 1, textsMissing: 0, holdsOpen: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "1 orders are given effect and not verified, or hold a post added after their check, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC. 2 hold a notice with no end recorded.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("hold_ending", { count: 2, at: "2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(`2 held notices are released within ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays} days, the first on 2026-10-20 00:00 UTC.`);
    expect(renderAlert("report_owed", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(
      `1 reports to the authorities have been owed for more than ${ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours} hours, the oldest since 2026-10-14 08:00 UTC.`,
    );
  });

  test("a fact that is missing, of another kind, or a string that is no time is refused", () => {
    expect(() => renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 1, handle: 7 }, now)).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "mod_anna" }, now)).toThrow(/at/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: "4" }, now)).toThrow(/count/);
  });
});

describe("the outcome phrases", () => {

      not_evident:
        "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules, and whether it is illegal cannot be seen without a detailed legal examination; a court or an authority can order its removal",
      not_available: "no action: the link names nothing korbat can show (checked automatically)",
      partly_reversed: "korbat reversed part of its decision to restrict it",
      reversed: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it",

  test("the sentences that follow an outcome, and the phrases of the path for child sexual abuse material, word for word", () => {

    expect(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE).toBe(
