    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns the account's display name and bio and, taken together, the images on its posts. korbat decides about single posts of the account, and about what its posts say, in cases of their own and does not report those here.",
    );
    expect(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({
      sealed: "access restricted: korbat sealed its images without opening them. They are shown to nobody, their author included, and are kept for the authorities.",
      no_action:
        "no action: korbat's staff do not open images reported this way. An admin found in the report, and in what korbat can read and still holds of it, no sufficient ground to seal images or to restrict anything else.",
    });
    expect(SUSPECT_NO_SEAL).toBe("No image was sealed; korbat's staff do not open images reported this way.");
    expect(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION).toBe(
      "no action for now: when korbat decided, its staff could not open this post's images, because a report of another kind about them was waiting or they were sealed. If your report is about an image, ask for a re-examination.",
    );
  });
});

describe("outcomeWords: one item's outcome as its sender reads it", () => {
  test("an ordinary item reads its outcome's phrase, a rule's with its id and title, and ends in one full stop", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule")).toBe("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).");
    expect(words("restricted_legal")).toBe("access restricted: korbat found it illegal.");
    expect(words("no_violation")).toBe("no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.");
    expect(words("not_evident")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}.`);
    expect(words("not_available")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
    // A phrase that fills nothing in never keeps a placeholder, and no outcome ends in two full stops.
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      for (const facts of [{}, { suspect: true }, { sealed: true }, { unseen: true }, { noEffect: true }, { scope: "account" as const }, { scope: "quote" as const }, { scope: "account_suspect" as const }]) {
        const text = words(outcome, facts);
        expect(text, `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).not.toMatch(/[{}]|[.][.]|[.] [.]/);
        expect(text.endsWith("."), `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });

  test("a restriction under a rule that is not named is refused: the phrase would keep its placeholder", () => {
    expect(() => outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null })).toThrow(/rule/);
  });

  test("ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN follows a restricting outcome whose measures all changed nothing, a seal's included, and no other outcome", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { noEffect: true }), outcome).not.toContain(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are not suspect and whose decision sealed nothing", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      const text = words(outcome, { scope: "account" });
      expect(text.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      expect(text, outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
      for (const scope of [null, "quote", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    // After the already-not-shown sentence when both apply.
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about a post that quotes another, after ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN when both apply", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "quote" }).endsWith(` ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are suspect or that a sealing decision answered, a rule report merged into a sealed account case among them", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "account_suspect", suspect: true }).endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "quote"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
    }
    // A rule report about an account that an answer with a seal answered: the sealed phrase, then the scope.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("a suspect item is worded from SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, never from the four words for a finding alone", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("not_evident", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    // Answered by a measure on the post's text without a seal: the phrase of that finding, then that no image was sealed.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "restricted_rule", "restricted_legal"] as const) {
      for (const sealed of [false, true]) {
        const text = words(outcome, { suspect: true, sealed });
        expect(text === `${OUTCOME_PHRASES[outcome]}.` || text === "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).", `${outcome} ${sealed}`).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    // The other three outcomes are worded as for any item.
    expect(words("not_available", { suspect: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
  });

  test("the sealed phrase stands for every item a sealing decision answered, suspect or not, in place of both restricting phrases", () => {
    for (const suspect of [false, true]) {
      expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
      expect(words("restricted_legal", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    }
  });

  test("an item on another ground about a post, answered without action while nobody could open its images, reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, and no other item does", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    // A restriction, a reversal and a link that named nothing keep their own words, and a suspect item its own phrase.
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { unseen: true }), outcome).not.toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    // An item about an account is never worded this way, whatever its decision's mark: it keeps the ordinary phrase with its scope.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // On a post that quotes another the scope follows it as it follows any outcome.
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });
});

describe("the console's fixed drafts for a seal", () => {
  test("SEAL_DRAFTS holds its eight texts, word for word", () => {
    expect(SEAL_DRAFTS).toEqual({
      facts: {
        notice_post: "korbat received a notice that reports images of this post as child sexual abuse material.",
        notice_account: "korbat received a notice that reports this account for child sexual abuse material. It does not say which images, so korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        notice_added: "korbat received a notice about content on korbat that shows this post's images and reports them as child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_post: "A moderator reported images of this post as possible child sexual abuse material.",
        finding_account: "A moderator reported images on this account's posts as possible child sexual abuse material. korbat sealed every image on the account's posts.",
        finding_added: "A moderator reported content on korbat that shows this post's images as possible child sexual abuse material.",
      },
      reason: {
        deciding: "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. It hides them from everyone, you included, until an admin has answered the report.",
        final:
          "korbat's staff do not open images reported this way, so korbat has not assessed them. An admin found the report credible enough to keep the images sealed and to report them to the police, who can assess them.",
      },
    });
    expect(Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts).length + Object.keys(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason).length).toBe(8);
  });

  test("none says that korbat found the images to be such material, and each reason says that staff do not open them", () => {
    for (const text of [...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts), ...Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)]) {
      expect(text).not.toMatch(/korbat found|is child sexual abuse material|are child sexual abuse material/);
    }
    for (const text of Object.values(SEAL_DRAFTS.reason)) expect(text).toContain("korbat's staff do not open images reported this way");
    // The two drafts for an added item never say that this post was reported, and name no other post.
    for (const text of [SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added, SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added]) expect(text).not.toMatch(/of this post as|this post was|quot/);
  });

  test("the facts draft follows the suspect items the decision considers: a notice when any came from a user, the added form when every one was added by korbat, else by the case's target", () => {
    const item = (source: "user" | "finding", added = false) => ({ source, added });
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_account);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_account);
    // A notice among findings makes it a notice's draft.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding"), item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    // Every item added for a quoted post (or a re-examination of one): the added form; one named item among them: the post's.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("user", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(() => sealFactsDraft("post", [])).toThrow(/suspect item/);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { DecisionStatement, GAP_CLASSES, GAP_DISPOSITIONS, GAP_MEASURE_CLASSES, GAP_SITE_CLASSES, RESTORE_GAPS_MAX, RestoreView, type RestoreGap } from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3f Task 6 (design, sections 6.6, 7.17, 10.1, 10.2 and 10.4): the closed lists of recovery, each the one spelling of its
 * CHECK (a database test holds the two equal), what the console reads after a restore, and the day a decision taken again
 * names.
 */
describe("recovery", () => {
  const ID = "6f1c1e8a-2b3c-4d5e-8f90-123456789abc";
  const AT = "2026-10-10T01:00:00.000Z";

  test("the classes in the order a person takes them again, the measures among them, and those that keep the app's site closed", () => {
    // 3d Task 2: the class release, after seal_interim, for a lost release, leave or withdrawal of a leave.
    expect(GAP_CLASSES).toEqual(["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "release", "standing", "restriction", "reversal", "no_measure", "record"]);
    expect(GAP_DISPOSITIONS).toEqual(["reapplied", "not_needed", "imported"]);
    expect(GAP_MEASURE_CLASSES).toEqual(["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "standing", "restriction"]);
    expect(GAP_SITE_CLASSES).toEqual(["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "release"]);
  });

  test("RestoreView holds a gap's members and nothing more, and the held notices' ends as imported", () => {
    const gap: RestoreGap = {
      id: ID,
      class: "order_effect",
      actedAt: AT,
      action: "order_effected",
      caseId: null,
      orderId: ID,
      itemId: ID,
      kinds: ["disable_by_order"],
      closedAt: null,
      disposition: null,
      closedByDecisionId: null,
    };
    const view = { importedAt: AT, mayOpen: false, retentionMay: false, gaps: [gap], holds: [{ orderId: ID, holdUntil: AT }] };
    expect(RestoreView.parse(view)).toEqual(view);
    expect(RestoreView.parse({ importedAt: null, mayOpen: true, retentionMay: true, gaps: [], holds: [] }).gaps).toEqual([]);
    // No metadata beyond the members: a stripped extra member, never carried.
    expect((RestoreView.parse({ ...view, gaps: [{ ...gap, metadata: { authority: "x" } }] }).gaps[0] as Record<string, unknown>).metadata).toBeUndefined();
    for (const bad of [{ ...gap, class: "measure" }, { ...gap, disposition: "done" }, { ...gap, kinds: ["delete_everything"] }]) {
      expect(RestoreView.safeParse({ ...view, gaps: [bad] }).success, JSON.stringify(bad)).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(RestoreView.safeParse({ ...view, gaps: Array.from({ length: RESTORE_GAPS_MAX + 1 }, () => gap) }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision taken again names the lost decision's UTC day; every other decision names none", () => {
    const statement = {
      kind: "final",
      outcome: "restricted",
      ground: "incompatible",
      ruleId: "R5",
      rulesVersion: 1,
      redressVersion: 3,
      legalReference: null,
      facts: "f",
      reason: "r",
      source: "notice",
      decidedAt: AT,
      post: { id: ID, createdAt: AT },
      measures: [],
      reversals: [],
      endedMeasures: [],
      reviewed: null,
    };
    expect(DecisionStatement.parse({ ...statement, reapplied: { lostOn: "2026-10-09" } }).reapplied).toEqual({ lostOn: "2026-10-09" });
    expect(DecisionStatement.parse(statement).reapplied).toBeUndefined();
    expect(DecisionStatement.safeParse({ ...statement, reapplied: { lostOn: AT } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

describe("the reveal", () => {
  test("its request is the confirmed params with the key's assertion, and nothing else", () => {
    const stepUp = { id: "Y3JlZA", rawId: "Y3JlZA", type: "public-key", response: { clientDataJSON: "e30", authenticatorData: "AAAA", signature: "AAAA" }, clientExtensionResults: {} };
    const params = { reasonCategory: "impersonation_claim", reasonDigest: HEX };
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, stepUp }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse(params).success).toBe(false);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, stepUp, reason: "free text" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, reasonCategory: "curiosity", stepUp }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its answer is a reporter's handle or a notifier's given name, or neither when the name was forgotten in between; never an address", () => {
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: "some_one", name: null })).toEqual({ handle: "some_one", name: null });
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: "Ada" })).toEqual({ handle: null, name: "Ada" });
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: null })).toEqual({ handle: null, name: null });
    expect(Object.keys(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: "Ada", email: "ada@example.org" }))).toEqual(["handle", "name"]);
  });
});

describe("a source's summary", () => {
  const reporter = { kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", accountAge: "1_to_12_months", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "under_half", answeredUnseen: "none", named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };

  test("names nobody: a letter given per case, bands instead of counts, and for a notifier what was given, never what", () => {
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse(reporter).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "notifier", label: SOURCE_LABELS.notifier, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["anonymous", "staff", "unlinked"] as const) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind, label: SOURCE_LABELS[kind], accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    }
    // Bands only: an exact count is no value of any of them.
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, itemsFiled: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, actedOn: "0.4" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, answeredUnseen: "3" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, accountAge: "3_days" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its label is one of the console's own: a reporter's letter or the fixed words of its kind, never a text an answer could choose", () => {
    expect(reporterLabel(0)).toBe("Reporter A");
    expect(reporterLabel(1)).toBe("Reporter B");
    expect(reporterLabel(25)).toBe("Reporter Z");
    expect(reporterLabel(26)).toBe("Reporter AA");
    expect(reporterLabel(27)).toBe("Reporter AB");
    expect(reporterLabel(26 + 26 * 26)).toBe("Reporter AAA");
    for (const label of ["korbat: verified notice from police", "Reporter a", "Reporter", "Reporter A ", "<b>Reporter A</b>", SOURCE_LABELS.staff]) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, label }).success, label).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "staff", label: "Reporter A" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the case answer", () => {
  const summary = { kind: "anonymous", label: SOURCE_LABELS.anonymous, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };

      },

    drafts: [{ id: OTHER, kind: "reason", text: "a draft", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME }],

      { at: TIME, event: "decision", refId: OTHER, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", staffHandle: "mod_anna", result: null },

  };

  test("parses a case with its target, suspicion, snapshots, items, decisions, appeals, texts and history", () => {
    const parsed = CaseView.parse(view);
    expect(parsed.snapshots).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(parsed.items[0]!.source.kind).toBe("anonymous");
    expect(parsed.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!.sealed?.list).toEqual([{ postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 }]);
    // An account's case: its live fields, no suspicion, and never an image.
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [] };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(account).success).toBe(true);
    // A target whose row is gone is still an answer: staff see what is.
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });


  test("3e: a post case carries whether a strike is due and the author's standing in bands; an account case the account's standing", () => {
    for (const why of ["due", "already_struck", "before_last_strike"] as const) expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: why === "due", why } }).success, why).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: true, why: "maybe" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3", suspensionsInYear: "0", now: "none" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3_or_more", suspensionsInYear: "2_or_more", now: "terminated" } }).success).toBe(true);
    const standing = {
      activeStrikes: 3,
      strikes: [{ decisionId: OTHER, caseId: CASE, ruleId: "R3", decidedAt: TIME, countsUntil: TIME }],
      ladderRule: "R3",
      suspensionsInYear: 0,
      lastSuspendedOn: null,
      maxDays: 3,
      mayTerminate: false,
      live: false,
      openReports: true,
      atOnce: ["threat"],
      flood: { posts: 2, from: TIME, to: TIME },
      seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-01" },
      snapshotHandleRetired: false,
      // 3e Task 3: the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, by its time.
      basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME, terrorist: null, protective: TIME },
      // 3e Task 5: the account's record of reporting, in reports.
      reporting: { reports: 0, unfounded: 0, warnedOn: null, warnedAt: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null, marked: [] },
    };
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [], strikeDue: null, authorStanding: null, standing };
    expect(CaseView.parse(account).standing).toEqual(standing);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, maxDays: 31 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, atOnce: ["ladder"] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
    // A decision says which standing measures rest on it, when any does; older answers carry no such member.
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) {
      expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }]);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "spam" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    }
    // Each member is always there: on the other kind of case it is null.
    const { standing: _standing, ...without } = account;
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e: a ledger row carries its days, whether it is announced, its basis, what it rests on, its earliest start, its end of counting and its period", () => {
    const action = view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const strike = { ...action, kind: "strike", sealed: null, countsUntil: TIME };
    const suspend = { ...action, kind: "suspend", sealed: null, days: 3, announced: true, basis: "strikes", restsOn: [OTHER], earliestStart: TIME, period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" } };
    for (const row of [strike, suspend]) expect(CaseDecisionAction.parse(row)).toEqual(row);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, basis: "ladder" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, period: { ...suspend.period, state: "paused" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, days: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    const { period: _period, ...withoutPeriod } = suspend;
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse(withoutPeriod).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e Task 5: each item says whether it can be marked and whether its mark counts or was withdrawn; an account case carries its record of reporting in reports, by reference and never by person", () => {
    const item = view.items[0]!;
    for (const member of ["markable", "unfounded", "markWithdrawn"] as const) {
      const { [member]: _gone, ...without } = item;
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [without] }).success, member).toBe(false);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, [member]: null }] }).success, member).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, markable: true, unfounded: true }] }).items[0]).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
    const reporting = {
      reports: 8,
      unfounded: 5,
      warnedOn: "2026-09-01",
      warnedAt: TIME,
      marksSince: 2,
      mayWarn: false,
      mayRestrict: false,
      restrictedUntil: null,
      marked: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-08-30", markedOn: "2026-08-31", sinceWarning: false }],
    };
    const parsed = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting.parse(reporting);
    expect(parsed).toEqual(reporting);
    const Reporting = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting;
    // A marked report is named by its reference and the item's place in it, never by who sent it.
    expect(Object.keys(Reporting.shape.marked.element.shape).sort()).toEqual(["markedOn", "position", "ref", "sentOn", "sinceWarning"]);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, marked: [{ ...reporting.marked[0], ref: "someone" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, unfounded: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-01" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A restriction of reporting rests on its warning: the warning's decision says so, for [review.warning].
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(501)).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {
    const bad = { ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: TIME, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } } };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the queue and the overview", () => {
  const row = { id: CASE, lane: 0, targetType: "post", openedAt: TIME, oldestOpenAt: TIME, openItems: 2, rules: ["R5"], categories: ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE"], allegesIllegal: true, suspect: false, reexamination: false, deferred: false };

  test("a page of the queue holds at most 50 cases and the cursor of the next", () => {
    expect(QUEUE_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [row], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => row), nextCursor: "abc_-123", replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 51 }, () => row), nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [{ ...row, lane: 3 }], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the queue's cursor is an opaque word: letters, digits, dashes and underscores", () => {
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "eyJhIjoxfQ_-" }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const cursor of ["", "a b", "a/b", "a=b", "x".repeat(401)]) expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor }).success, cursor).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the overview holds counts, times, staff handles and cases", () => {
    const overview = {
      lanes: [
        { lane: 0, open: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
        { lane: 1, open: 0, oldestAt: null },
        { lane: 2, open: 5, oldestAt: TIME },
      ],

      findingsToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 1 }],
      mailsWaiting: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 1, outcomes: 0 },
      mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 2 },
      releaseOverdue: 0,
      erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 0, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 0 },
      deferUnproven: false,
      protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, kind: "dismissed" }] },
      sealsDeclined: { total: 0, items: [] },
      interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, posts: 2, images: 5 }] },
      repliesWaiting: { count: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
      strikeAccounts: 1,
      // 3f: the contact point and the alert channel.
      contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: TIME, dueAt: TIME },
      alerts: { channel: "down", since: TIME },
      ordersUnverified: { total: 1, items: [{ orderId: POST, effectAt: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 5: a report owed for a case, from reports_owed(): a case, a kind and a time.
      reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "sealed_images" as const, since: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 6: the newest copy mark and whether the copy is overdue; the open gaps after a restore, the measures among
      // them, and when the newest import ran.
      copy: { newestAt: TIME, overdue: true },
      restore: { open: 3, measures: 2, importedAt: TIME },
      quarantine: { dueIn: 1, dueOut: 2, undestroyed: 0, oldest: TIME },
      destructive: [],
    };
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, copy: { newestAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, restore: { open: -1, measures: 0, importedAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "an authority", since: TIME }] } }).success).toBe(false);

    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});

    for (const params of [interim, final, noAction, legal, correction]) expect(decided.parse(params), params.kind).toEqual(params);
    everyFieldRequired(decided, interim);
    // A final decision that finds no breach may still name the rule it examined, and may lift the case's interim withholds.
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R5", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }).ruleId).toBe("R5");
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, outcome: "not_evident" }).outcome).toBe("not_evident");
    expect(decided.parse({ ...legal, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" }).categoryKeyword).toBe("KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT");
  });

    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, note: "x" })).toBe(true);

    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, ground: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, text: "why" })).toBe(true);

    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, snapshotId: uuid.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, snapshotDigest: hex.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, factsDigest: ` ${hex}` })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image.toUpperCase() }] })).toBe(true);
    // Numbers are whole and in range.
    for (const stateVersion of [-1, 1.5, "0", 2_147_483_648]) expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, stateVersion }), String(stateVersion)).toBe(true);
    for (const rulesVersion of [0, 1.5, 32_768]) expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, rulesVersion }), String(rulesVersion)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PORNOGRAPHY_OR_SEXUALIZED_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, kind: "review" })).toBe(true);

  test("the outcome goes with the kind: an interim decision restricts, a final one restricts or finds no breach, a correction reverses", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, outcome: "no_violation" })).toBe(true);

    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, throughSeq: 1 }).throughSeq).toBe(1);

    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ground: null, ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, factsDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, legalReferenceDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, ruleId: "R3" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a keyword goes only with the ground of the law", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a correction names the decision it corrects, states no ground of its own, and holds reversals only; no other kind names a decision", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, reviewsDecisionId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, ruleId: "R1" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, factsDigest: hex })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, legalReferenceDigest: hex })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }, { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, reviewsDecisionId: uuid })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, reviewsDecisionId: uuid })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the actions are sorted by kind and then by image, without repeats, at most eight, with at most one post measure and one seal", () => {
    const sorted = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: image },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: otherImage },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
    ];
    const sealing = { ...final, ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", actions: sorted };
    expect(decided.parse(sealing).actions).toEqual(sorted);
    // Any other order of the same actions, and any repeat, is refused: the same decision always has the same hash.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[1], sorted[0], sorted[2], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[2], sorted[1], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[1], sorted[1], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[3], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    // Two post measures in one decision.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    // Nine actions.
    const nine = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ kind: "remove_media", mediaId: `${i}a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a` }));
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: nine })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, actions: nine.slice(0, 8) }).actions).toHaveLength(8);
  });

  test("an image measure names its image, and no other kind names one", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image }] }).actions[0]).toEqual({ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image });
  });

  test("appeals_reviewed takes the appeal, the snapshot, the outcome and reversals only, sorted like a decision's", () => {
    expect(reviewed.parse(review)).toEqual(review);
    everyFieldRequired(reviewed, review);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: otherImage }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, appealId: uuid.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: image }, { kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e (design, section 10.4)
  const accountFinal = { ...final, ruleId: "R1" };
  const suspendAction = (days: number | null, announced: boolean) => ({ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days, announced });

  test("3e: an action entry is one of two strict shapes, and the three timed kinds sign their days and whether they are announced", () => {
    const announced = { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true)] };
    expect(decided.parse(announced)).toEqual(announced);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: false }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...accountFinal, ruleId: "R6", actions: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 30, announced: false }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    // A timed kind in the plain shape, and a plain kind in the timed one, are refused.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    // days is a whole number from 1 to 30, null only on a termination; a restriction of reporting is never announced.
    for (const days of [0, 31, 1.5]) expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(days, true)] }), String(days)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(null, true)] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, ruleId: "R6", actions: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: image, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    // At most one suspension or termination.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true), { kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("3e: the six measures only in a final restriction, a strike only on a korbat rule other than R2, an overruling only with a full reversal", () => {
    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, actions: [{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    const overruling = { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] };
    expect(decided.parse(overruling).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...overruling, outcome: "partly_reversed" })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, actions: overruling.actions }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: overruling.actions })).toBe(true);
    // A review and a correction hold the four new reversals, never a new measure.
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("3e: a correction may keep the decision with no action; unfounded only on a final no-breach decision, sorted; replaced only with a lift", () => {
    const kept = { ...correction, outcome: "kept", actions: [] };
    expect(decided.parse(kept).outcome).toBe("kept");
    expect(refused(decided, { ...kept, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, outcome: "kept" })).toBe(true);
    const [first, second] = [uuid, "6f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a"].sort();
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, unfounded: [first, second] }).unfounded).toEqual([first, second]);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [second, first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [first, first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [first!.toUpperCase()] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, unfounded: [first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => `${String(i).padStart(8, "0")}-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a`) })).toBe(true);
    const withdrawn = { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: true };
    expect(decided.parse(withdrawn).replaced).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, replaced: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true)], replaced: true })).toBe(true);
    // Both members are always present: a decision without them is refused.
    const { unfounded: _u, ...withoutMarks } = interim;
    const { replaced: _r, ...withoutReplaced } = interim;
    expect(refused(decided, withoutMarks)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, withoutReplaced)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("identity_revealed takes a reason category and the digest of the saved reason, never the reason", () => {
    expect(revealed.parse(reveal)).toEqual(reveal);
    everyFieldRequired(revealed, reveal);
    for (const reasonCategory of ["impersonation_claim", "abuse_of_reporting", "legal_requirement", "other"]) expect(revealed.parse({ ...reveal, reasonCategory }).reasonCategory).toBe(reasonCategory);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, reasonCategory: "curiosity" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, reasonDigest: "because" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the cross-field rules survive the route's extension with the assertion, since its key does not overlap", () => {
    const extended = decided.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON.optional() });
    expect(extended.parse({ ...interim, stepUp: assertion })).toEqual({ ...interim, stepUp: assertion });
    expect(extended.parse(interim)).toEqual(interim);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, outcome: "no_violation", stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, throughSeq: 2, stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, other: 1, stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    const extendedReview = reviewed.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON.optional() });
    expect(refused(extendedReview, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }], stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(extendedReview.parse({ ...review, stepUp: assertion }).stepUp).toEqual(assertion);
  });

  test("the options request takes each of the three with its own target and params", () => {
    const requests = [
      { action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: uuid }, params: interim },
      { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: uuid }, params: review },
      { action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: uuid }, params: reveal },
    ];
    for (const request of requests) expect(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse(request), request.action).toEqual(request);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], target: { type: "decision", id: uuid } })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], params: review })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], params: { ...interim, outcome: "kept" } })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[2], params: {} })).toBe(true);
  });

  /**
   * Every string a params schema lets through, by its path: the walk goes through objects, arrays and nullable members.
   * A string is described by its format (a uuid) and the patterns it is held to; enums and literals are closed lists and
   * numbers are not strings, so neither is listed.
   */
  function strings(schema: unknown, path = "$"): { path: string; format: string | undefined; patterns: string[] }[] {
    const def = (schema as { _zod: { def: Record<string, unknown> } })._zod.def;
    switch (def.type) {
      case "object":
        return Object.entries(def.shape as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([key, member]) => strings(member, `${path}.${key}`));
      case "array":
        return strings(def.element, `${path}[]`);
      case "nullable":
      case "optional":
        return strings(def.innerType, path);
      // 3e: an action entry is one of two shapes, each walked; a boolean and a null carry no text.
      case "union":
        return (def.options as unknown[]).flatMap((option) => strings(option, path));
      case "string": {
        const checks = ((def.checks as { _zod: { def: { format?: string; pattern?: RegExp } } }[] | undefined) ?? []).map((check) => check._zod.def);
        return [{ path, format: def.format as string | undefined, patterns: checks.filter((check) => check.format === "regex").map((check) => String(check.pattern)) }];
      }
      case "enum":
      case "literal":
      case "number":
      case "boolean":
      case "null":
        return [];
      default:
        // A kind of member this walk does not know could carry free text: it fails the test until it is listed above.
        return [{ path, format: `unknown member type ${String(def.type)}`, patterns: [] }];
    }
  }
  const LOWER_UUID = "/^[0-9a-f-]+$/";
  const HEX_DIGEST = "/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/";
  const free = (schema: unknown) => strings(schema).filter((s) => !((s.format === "uuid" && s.patterns.includes(LOWER_UUID)) || (s.format === undefined && s.patterns.includes(HEX_DIGEST))));

  test("no params schema of any action lets a free string through: every string is a lower-case uuid or a hex digest", () => {
    // 3f (design, section 10.3): the one named exception, an authority's name and its file number in a correction's facts.
    // They are no words about a person, are bound one line of 1 to 200 characters, and are compared with the order's row.
    // 3d Task 2 (section 10.4): the release's reference, the file number under which an authority or a court gave its
    // leave, bound as 3f binds one and compared with the leave's record at commit by releases_confirmed.
    const named: Record<string, string[]> = { order_corrected: ["$.facts.authority", "$.facts.reference"], order_effected: ["$.authority", "$.reference"], seal_released: ["$.theirReference"] };
    // 3f Task 6: the audit download's target is a place, as decimal digits: no text at all.
    const PLACE = "/^[1-9][0-9]{0,14}$/";
    const place = (action: string) => (s: { format: string | undefined; patterns: string[] }) => action === "audit_exported" && s.format === undefined && s.patterns.length === 1 && s.patterns[0] === PLACE;
    for (const [action, spec] of Object.entries(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS)) {
      expect(free(spec.params).map((s) => s.path), action).toEqual(named[action] ?? []);
      expect(free(spec.targetId).filter((s) => !place(action)(s)), action).toEqual([]);
    }
    // What the walk finds in the decision's params: ids and digests, nothing else.
    expect(strings(decided).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.reviewsDecisionId", "$.snapshotId", "$.snapshotDigest", "$.actions[].mediaId", "$.factsDigest", "$.reasonDigest", "$.legalReferenceDigest", "$.unfounded[]"]);
    expect(strings(revealed).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.reasonDigest"]);
  });

  test("the walk catches a free string, a uuid in any case, a transform and a member it cannot read", () => {
    const loose = z.strictObject({
      note: z.string().max(10),
      id: z.uuid(),
      short: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/),
      list: z.array(z.strictObject({ label: z.string().nullable() })),
      trimmed: z.string().trim().pipe(z.uuid()),
      ok: z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/),
      digest: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).nullable(),
    });
    expect(free(loose).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.note", "$.id", "$.short", "$.list[].label", "$.trimmed"]);
  });
});

describe("the step-up action's hash and binding", () => {
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const revoke = { action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: uuid }, params: {} };
  // The 3a action's sorted JSON, and the sha256 values below, were checked with Python's hashlib when they were written.
  const REVOKE_TEXT = `{"action":"staff_session_revoked","params":{},"target":{"id":"${uuid}","type":"staff_session"}}`;
  const REVOKE_HASH = "dad06ce5248ff75b3aa9b1faec9bab38bfa70f6dd2568d231b02e282207385c5";
  const SESSION = "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666";
  const BINDING = "9b70fa1ab475e7958d1265150cd04c7953483fe6145f52b12b2fd89d0c598dca";
  const hexOf = (bytes: Uint8Array) => Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

  test("the action's text is the sorted JSON of its action, target and params: object keys sorted, no whitespace", () => {
    expect(stepUpActionText(revoke)).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
    // The order the members were written in changes nothing.
    expect(stepUpActionText({ params: {}, target: { id: uuid, type: "staff_session" }, action: "staff_session_revoked" })).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
    // The options request is hashed as it was sent: its schemas change nothing in it.
    expect(stepUpActionText(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse(revoke))).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
  });

  test("params are sorted at every depth, arrays keep their order, and strings and numbers are written as JSON.stringify writes them", () => {
    const params = { b: [3, { z: 1, a: null }, "x"], a: `q"${BS}`, c: true, d: 0.5, e: -0, "": -1, B: { y: [], x: {} } };
    expect(stepUpActionText({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "post", id: "p1" }, params })).toBe(
      `{"action":"case_decided","params":{"":-1,"B":{"x":{},"y":[]},"a":"q${BS}"${BS}${BS}","b":[3,{"a":null,"z":1},"x"],"c":true,"d":0.5,"e":0},"target":{"id":"p1","type":"post"}}`,
    );
  });

  test("keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units, as Array.prototype.sort sorts them in the API, audit-verify and the console alike", () => {
    const eAcute = String.fromCharCode(0xe9);
    const fullwidthA = String.fromCharCode(0xff21);
    // An astral character's first code unit (0xd83d) sorts before 0xff21, though its code point (0x1f600) is higher.
    const grinning = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    const params = { [fullwidthA]: 1, [grinning]: 2, [eAcute]: 3, z: 4 };
    expect(stepUpActionText({ action: "a", target: { type: "t", id: "i" }, params })).toBe(
      `{"action":"a","params":{"z":4,"${eAcute}":3,"${grinning}":2,"${fullwidthA}":1},"target":{"id":"i","type":"t"}}`,
    );
  });

  test("a value that is not JSON is refused rather than hashed", () => {
    for (const value of [undefined, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, () => 1, BigInt(1), new Date(0), [undefined], Symbol("x")]) {
      expect(() => stepUpActionText({ action: "a", target: { type: "t", id: "i" }, params: { value } }), String(typeof value)).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("the action's hash is the lower-case hex sha256 of the text's UTF-8 bytes", async () => {
    expect(await stepUpActionHash(revoke)).toBe(REVOKE_HASH);
    const reason = String.fromCharCode(0xe9, 0x4e2d) + String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(await stepUpActionHash({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "post", id: "p1" }, params: { reason } })).toBe(
      "8f41483850c87296607ff1c3fd5e501574bcc3f564a09d935a7063efab414720",
    );
  });

  test("another action, target or params gives another hash: params are bound too, though 3a's one action has none", async () => {
    const hashes = await Promise.all([
      stepUpActionHash(revoke),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, action: "staff_key_revoked" }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, target: { type: "staff_session", id: "4f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a" } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, target: { type: "staff_key", id: uuid } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { all: true } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { all: false } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { items: [1, 2] } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { items: [2, 1] } }),
    ]);
    expect(new Set(hashes).size).toBe(hashes.length);
  });

  test("the binding is the full 32-byte sha256 of the session's handle, a newline and the action's hash", async () => {
    expect(stepUpBindingText(SESSION, REVOKE_HASH)).toBe(`${SESSION}${LF}${REVOKE_HASH}`);
    const binding = await stepUpBinding(SESSION, REVOKE_HASH);
    expect(binding).toBeInstanceOf(Uint8Array);
    expect(binding).toHaveLength(32);
    expect(hexOf(binding)).toBe(BINDING);
    // Another session, or another action, binds something else.
    expect(hexOf(await stepUpBinding("7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", REVOKE_HASH))).not.toBe(BINDING);
    expect(hexOf(await stepUpBinding(SESSION, "0".repeat(64)))).not.toBe(BINDING);
  });

  test("the step-up challenge's layout: 74 bytes of version, purpose, expiry, nonce, the full binding and the seal", () => {
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE).toEqual({
      bytes: 74,
      encodedLength: 99,
      version: 1,
      purpose: 6,
      versionAt: 0,
      purposeAt: 1,
      expiryAt: 2,
      expiryBytes: 8,
      nonceAt: 10,
      nonceBytes: 16,
      bindingAt: 26,
      bindingBytes: 32,
      sealAt: 58,
      sealBytes: 16,
    });
    // The fields follow one another with no gap, and the encoded length is the bytes' unpadded base64url length.
    const c = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
    expect([c.purposeAt + 1, c.expiryAt + c.expiryBytes, c.nonceAt + c.nonceBytes, c.bindingAt + c.bindingBytes, c.sealAt + c.sealBytes]).toEqual([
      c.expiryAt,
      c.nonceAt,
      c.bindingAt,
      c.sealAt,
      c.bytes,
    ]);
    expect(c.encodedLength).toBe(Math.ceil((c.bytes * 8) / 6));
  });

  test("the other ceremonies' layout: 58 bytes of version, purpose, expiry, nonce, a 16-byte binding and the seal", () => {
    expect(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE).toEqual({
      bytes: 58,
      encodedLength: 78,
      version: 1,
      versionAt: 0,
      purposeAt: 1,
      expiryAt: 2,
      expiryBytes: 8,
      nonceAt: 10,
      nonceBytes: 16,
      bindingAt: 26,
      bindingBytes: 16,
      sealAt: 42,
      sealBytes: 16,
    });
    const c = CEREMONY_CHALLENGE;
    expect([c.purposeAt + 1, c.expiryAt + c.expiryBytes, c.nonceAt + c.nonceBytes, c.bindingAt + c.bindingBytes, c.sealAt + c.sealBytes]).toEqual([
      c.expiryAt,
      c.nonceAt,
      c.bindingAt,
      c.sealAt,
      c.bytes,
    ]);
    expect(c.encodedLength).toBe(Math.ceil((c.bytes * 8) / 6));
    // The two layouts share their first fields, and their lengths keep either from being read as the other.
    expect([c.versionAt, c.purposeAt, c.expiryAt, c.nonceAt, c.bindingAt, c.version]).toEqual([
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.versionAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.purposeAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.expiryAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.nonceAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.bindingAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.version,
    ]);
    expect(c.bytes).not.toBe(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.bytes);
  });

  test("each ceremony's purpose code, the step-up's among them, and no two alike", () => {
    expect(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES).toEqual({ signin: 1, register: 2, reauth: 3, staff_signin: 4, staff_register: 5, staff_step_up: 6 });
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.purpose).toBe(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES.staff_step_up);
    expect(new Set(Object.values(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES)).size).toBe(Object.keys(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES).length);
  });
});

describe("the audit log", () => {
  const entry = {
    seq: 42,
    hash: hex,
    createdAt: at,
    actorHandle: "mod_ada",
    action: "staff_session_revoked",
    targetType: "staff_session",
    targetId: uuid,
    actionHash: "cd".repeat(32),
    keyId: uuid,
  };

  test("an entry carries its place and hash, time, actor handle, action, target, the action's hash and (3f Task 6) the key that confirmed it", () => {
    expect(AuditEntry.parse(entry)).toEqual(entry);
    // The system actor has no handle; most rows have no step-up, some no target.
    const bare = { ...entry, actorHandle: null, targetType: null, targetId: null, actionHash: null, keyId: null };
    expect(AuditEntry.parse(bare)).toEqual(bare);
    everyFieldRequired(AuditEntry, entry);
  });

  test("an entry never carries metadata, and its place and hashes have their exact forms", () => {
    expect(AuditEntry.parse({ ...entry, metadata: { email: "a@b.c" } })).toEqual(entry);
    for (const seq of [0, -1, 1.5, "42"]) expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, seq }).success, String(seq)).toBe(false);
    for (const hash of ["AB".repeat(32), "ab".repeat(31), `${"ab".repeat(31)}zz`]) {
      expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, hash }).success, hash).toBe(false);
      expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, actionHash: hash }).success, hash).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a page holds at most 50 entries and the cursor of the next one, null at the end", () => {
    expect(STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
    const copy = { lastPlace: 40 };
    expect(AuditPage.parse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 42, copy })).toEqual({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 42, copy });
    expect(AuditPage.parse({ entries: [], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: null } })).toEqual({ entries: [], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: null } });
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: Array(51).fill(entry), nextCursor: null, copy }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: Array(50).fill(entry), nextCursor: 1, copy }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry], copy }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 0, copy }).success).toBe(false);
    // 3f Task 6: the caller's own newest copied place is always there, null before the first copy.
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: null, copy: { lastPlace: 0 } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3f Task 6: a page of one key's confirmed rows is asked with the key's id and a period, either end open", () => {
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ key: uuid })).toEqual({ key: uuid });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ key: uuid, from: at, to: at })).toEqual({ key: uuid, from: at, to: at });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ key: uuid.toUpperCase() }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ key: "abc" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A period alone filters nothing a key confirmed, and one that ends before it begins names no rows.
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ from: at }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ key: uuid, from: "2026-10-10T02:00:00.000Z", to: "2026-10-10T01:00:00.000Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ key: uuid, from: "yesterday" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3f Task 6: the download's params release the places after `after` up to `through`, at most AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX of them", () => {
    expect(AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX).toBe(50_000);
    expect(AuditExportedParams.parse({ after: 0, through: 7 })).toEqual({ after: 0, through: 7 });
    expect(AuditExportedParams.safeParse({ after: 0, through: AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX }).success).toBe(true);
    const refused = [{ after: 7, through: 7 }, { after: 8, through: 7 }, { after: 0, through: AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX + 1 }, { after: -1, through: 2 }, { after: 0, through: 0 }, { after: 1.5, through: 2 }, { after: 0, through: 2, more: 1 }];
    for (const params of refused) expect(AuditExportedParams.safeParse(params).success, JSON.stringify(params)).toBe(false);
    const spec = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.audit_exported;
    expect(spec.targetType).toBe("audit");
    for (const id of ["7", "999999999999999"]) expect(spec.targetId.safeParse(id).success, id).toBe(true);
    for (const id of ["0", "07", "-1", "1e3", "1000000000000000", uuid]) expect(spec.targetId.safeParse(id).success, id).toBe(false);
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.gap_closed.targetType).toBe("restore_gap");
    expect(GapClosedParams.parse({ disposition: "not_needed" })).toEqual({ disposition: "not_needed" });
    for (const disposition of ["reapplied", "imported", ""]) expect(GapClosedParams.safeParse({ disposition }).success, disposition).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3f Task 6: the mark names the last line's place and its hash; a line carries the chain's members as stored", () => {
    expect(AuditMarkRequest.parse({ through: 7, hash: hex })).toEqual({ through: 7, hash: hex });
    for (const body of [{ through: 0, hash: hex }, { through: 7, hash: hex.toUpperCase() }, { through: 7 }, { through: 7, hash: hex, after: 1 }]) {
      expect(AuditMarkRequest.safeParse(body).success, JSON.stringify(body)).toBe(false);
    }
    const line = {
      v: 1,
      place: 7,
      id: 9,
      at,
      actor: uuid,
      action: "case_decided",
      targetType: "case",
      targetId: uuid,
      requestId: null,
      staffSession: uuid,
      keyId: uuid,
      actionHash: hex,
      stepUp: JSON.stringify({ signature: "x" }),
      metadata: JSON.stringify({ params: {} }),
      prevHash: hex,
      hash: hex,
    };
    expect(AuditExportLine.parse(line)).toEqual(line);
    everyFieldRequired(AuditExportLine, line);
    // The jsonb columns are the text PostgreSQL printed, never parsed: an object is refused.
    expect(AuditExportLine.safeParse({ ...line, metadata: { params: {} } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditExportLine.safeParse({ ...line, extra: 1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a page is asked for by cursor, by place (at) or from the newest, with sign-ins as the one filter", () => {
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ cursor: "42" })).toEqual({ cursor: 42 });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ at: "7", action: "staff_sign_in" })).toEqual({ at: 7, action: "staff_sign_in" });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ cursor: "999999999999999" }).cursor).toBe(999_999_999_999_999);
    for (const value of ["0", "-1", "1.5", "01", "1e3", "", " 4", "abc", "1000000000000000"]) {
      expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ cursor: value }).success, value).toBe(false);
      expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ at: value }).success, value).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ action: "role_granted" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A cursor reads older rows and at reads from a place: both at once name no page.
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "4", at: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { is, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { PgDialect, PgTable, getTableConfig, pgTable } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, authRole, bytea, notifyRole, xid8 } from "../src/schema/helpers";
import * as schema from "../src/schema/index";

const tables = Object.values(schema).filter((v) => is(v, PgTable)) as PgTable[];
const byName = new Map(tables.map((t) => [getTableConfig(t).name, getTableConfig(t)]));

describe("auth schema", () => {
  test("auth tables live in the auth schema", () => {
    for (const name of ["users", "devices", "sessions", "email_codes", "passkeys", "auth_events"]) {

  });
});

describe("row level security", () => {

  });
});
