```ts
});

describe("passkeys 1c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** The foreign keys of one local column: the table and columns they point at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string, name: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .foreignKeys.filter((k) => k.reference().columns.some((c) => c.name === name))
      .map((k) => ({ table: getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, columns: k.reference().foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }));

  test("bytea is the bytea SQL type and hands Buffers both ways", () => {
    const table = pgTable("bytea_probe", { value: bytea("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    const bytes = Buffer.from([0, 1, 254, 255]);
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
    // postgres.js already parses bytea into a Buffer; a driver that answers a plain Uint8Array gets one too.
    const read = probe.mapFromDriverValue(new Uint8Array([0, 1, 254, 255]));
    expect(Buffer.isBuffer(read)).toBe(true);
    expect(read).toEqual(bytes);
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  test("users carry an optional WebAuthn user handle in bytea, unique among the accounts that have one", () => {
    const handle = column("users", "webauthn_user_id");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(false);
    const idx = byName.get("users")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "users_webauthn_user_id_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["webauthn_user_id"]);
    expect(idx?.config.where).toBeDefined();
  });

  test("passkeys record the AAGUID, the backup and verification flags, the creating device and a suspected copy", () => {
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    for (const name of ["backup_eligible", "uv_initialized"]) {
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe("boolean");
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.default, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("passkeys", "created_device_id")).toEqual([{ table: "devices", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.getSQLType()).toBe("timestamp with time zone");
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    // One row per credential: the index the foundation created stays.
    const idx = byName.get("passkeys")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "passkeys_credential_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["credential_id"]);
  });

  test("sessions carry a random handle that is unique, the factors they proved and the passkey that started them", () => {
    const handle = column("sessions", "handle");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    const idx = byName.get("sessions")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "sessions_handle_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["handle"]);
    const factors = column("sessions", "factors");
    expect(factors?.getSQLType()).toBe("jsonb");
    expect(factors?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(factors?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    expect(column("sessions", "passkey_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("sessions", "passkey_id")).toEqual([{ table: "passkeys", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
  });

  test("adding, removing and a counter regression of a passkey are security events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    // The slice ends at 1c's last value: 3a appends the staff events after it.
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("account_deleted"), values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "account_deleted",
      "passkey_added",
      "passkey_removed",
      "passkey_counter_regression",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("explore 2c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local column: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] }) => config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);

  test("profiles carry the author's Explore switch, on by default", () => {
    const flag = column("profiles", "show_in_explore");
    expect(flag?.getSQLType()).toBe("boolean");
    expect(flag?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(flag?.default).toBe(true);
  });

  test("explore_runs numbers each ranking with an identity and records its time, formula, counts and duration", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_runs")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("explore_runs")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["as_of", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["formula", "smallint", true],
      ["candidates", "integer", true],
      ["items", "integer", true],
      ["took_ms", "integer", true],
    ]);
    const generation = column("explore_runs", "generation");
    expect(generation?.primary).toBe(true);
    // Always generated: an insert cannot choose its generation, so the numbers come from the sequence alone.
    expect(generation?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    // The refresh writes every other value itself, the refresh time included, which tests move.
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault).map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["generation"]);
    expect(cfg.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("explore_items holds a ranking's posts by position, each post once, and goes with its ranking, its post or its author", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_items")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    // No score or count is stored: the position is the order.
    expect(shape("explore_items")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["position", "integer", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", true],
      ["author_id", "uuid", true],
    ]);
    expect(cfg.primaryKeys.map((k) => k.columns.map((c) => c.name))).toEqual([["generation", "position"]]);
    expect(cfg.indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique])).toEqual([["explore_items_generation_post_idx", ["generation", "post_id"], true]]);
    expect(foreignKeys("explore_items")).toEqual({
      generation: { table: "explore_runs", columns: ["generation"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      post_id: { table: "posts", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      author_id: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
  });

  test("both tables have row level security and one full-access policy for the API role", () => {
    // The loop under "row level security" covers them too; this pins the policy each one has.
    for (const name of ["explore_runs", "explore_items"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(cfg.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("likes and reposts have a BRIN index on created_at for the refresh's window; bookmarks, which Explore never reads, has none", () => {
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts"]) {
      const brin = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin");
      expect(brin.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique, i.config.where]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_created_brin`, ["created_at"], false, undefined]]);
    }
    expect(byName.get("bookmarks")!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin")).toEqual([]);
    // The factory's other indexes stay the same on all three tables.
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts", "bookmarks"]) {
      const others = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method !== "brin");
      expect(others.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.method]).sort(), name).toEqual([
        [`${name}_post_idx`, "btree"],
        [`${name}_user_created_idx`, "btree"],
      ]);
    }
  });
});

describe("staff console 3a", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** Every index as its name, its columns and whether it is unique, by name. */
  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.unique])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const uniques = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name)]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);

  test("the seven staff events close the auth event type, after 1c's passkey events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "staff_enrollment_issued",
      "staff_key_added",
      "staff_key_revoked",
      "staff_key_counter_regression",
      "staff_sign_in",
      "staff_signed_out",
      "staff_session_revoked",
    ]);
  });

  test("the three staff tables live in the auth schema, with row level security and one policy for the auth role", () => {
    for (const name of ["staff_keys", "staff_enrollments", "staff_sessions"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.schema, name).toBe("auth");
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([[`${name}_auth_all`, "all", authRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("a staff key records its credential, its origin and relying party ID, its dates and whether it was revoked or suspect", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["credential_id", "text", true],
      ["public_key", "text", true],
      ["counter", "bigint", true],
      ["transports", "text[]", true],
      ["name", "text", true],
      ["aaguid", "uuid", false],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["suspect_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    // No user handle of its own: staff registrations use the account's webauthn_user_id.
    expect(column("staff_keys", "user_handle")).toBeUndefined();
    // The development cleaner deletes accounts as the superuser; a key must stop that delete, never go with it.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_keys")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["staff_keys_credential_idx", ["credential_id"], true],
      ["staff_keys_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    // The pair the staff sessions' foreign key names.
    expect(uniques("staff_keys")).toEqual([["staff_keys_id_user_id_unique", ["id", "user_id"]]]);
    expect(checks("staff_keys")).toEqual(["staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked"]);
  });

  test("an enrolment keeps only its token's hash, the console it was issued for, its expiry and when it was used", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["token_hash", "text", true],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_enrollments")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["staff_enrollments_token_hash_idx", ["token_hash"], true],
      ["staff_enrollments_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
  });

  test("a staff session keeps its token's hash, a unique handle, its key and account together, both expiries and the browser label", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "text", true],
      ["handle", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["key_id", "uuid", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["idle_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["absolute_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["browser", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "handle")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // The key's foreign key names the account as well, so a session's key always belongs to its account.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_sessions")).toEqual({
      user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      "key_id,user_id": { table: "staff_keys", columns: ["id", "user_id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
    expect(indexes("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["staff_sessions_handle_idx", ["handle"], true],
      ["staff_sessions_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    expect(checks("staff_sessions")).toEqual(["staff_sessions_lifetime"]);
  });

  test("audit_log gains the staff session's handle, the key, the action's hash and the step-up, all optional", () => {
    const added = [
      ["staff_session", "uuid"],
      ["key_id", "uuid"],
      ["action_hash", "text"],
      ["step_up", "jsonb"],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type] of added) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(false);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(checks("audit_log")).toEqual(["audit_log_step_up_complete"]);
  });

  test("audit_log's chain columns are not null, with placeholder defaults that the trigger always overwrites", () => {
    const chain = [
      ["chain_version", "smallint", 0],
      ["chain_seq", "bigint", 0],
      ["prev_hash", "text", ""],
      ["hash", "text", ""],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type, placeholder] of chain) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.default, name).toBe(placeholder);
    }
    // One index serves the viewer and audit-verify; there is none on (created_at, id).
    expect(indexes("audit_log")).toEqual([["audit_log_chain_seq_idx", ["chain_seq"], true]]);
  });

  test("audit_head holds one row, the newest place and hash, which the API role may only read", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("audit_head")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("audit_head")).toEqual([
      ["id", "smallint", true],
      ["seq", "bigint", true],
      ["hash", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("audit_head", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault)).toEqual([]);
    expect(checks("audit_head")).toEqual(["audit_head_single_row"]);
    expect(cfg.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    expect(policies("audit_head")).toEqual([["audit_head_api_select", "select", apiRole]]);
  });
});

describe("moderation cases 3c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);
  const index = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === name)?.config;
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] } | undefined) => config?.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);
  /** An index's predicate as the SQL the migration holds. */
  const predicate = (config: { where?: SQL } | undefined) => (config?.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(config.where).sql : undefined);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** The columns declared unique by themselves, each with the name of its constraint. */
  const uniques = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .columns.filter((c) => c.isUnique)
      .map((c) => [c.uniqueName, [c.name]])
      .sort();

  /** A check's expression as the migration holds it. */
  const checkSql = (table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(byName.get(table)!.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;

  const MODERATION_TABLES = ["cases", "intakes", "intake_items", "decisions", "decision_actions", "seal_posts", "appeals", "staff_texts", "evidence_snapshots", "case_access_log", "moderation_limits", "media_holds"];
  const AUTH_TABLES = ["notifier_contacts", "notifier_confirmations", "notifier_suppressions", "staff_personal_accounts"];

  test("the twelve moderation tables are public, with row level security and one policy for the API role", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBeUndefined(); // public
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      // The grants do the restricting (migration 0015); moderation_limits is read only, so its one policy is a SELECT one.
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual(name === "moderation_limits" ? [["moderation_limits_api_select", "select", apiRole]] : [[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("no moderation table has a column named like an email or an address", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      for (const c of byName.get(name)!.columns) expect(c.name, `${name}.${c.name}`).not.toMatch(/email|address/i);
    }
  });

  test("xid8 is the xid8 SQL type and hands the transaction id over as a string", () => {
    const table = pgTable("xid8_probe", { value: xid8("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("xid8");
    // A 64-bit counter: a string keeps every digit, where a JavaScript number would not.
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue("18446744073709551615")).toBe("18446744073709551615");
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue("773")).toBe("773");
  });

  test("one open case a target: the partial unique index, the queue's index and the target's index", () => {
    const open = index("cases", "cases_one_open_per_target");
    expect(open?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(open)).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(open)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    const queue = index("cases", "cases_queue_idx");
    expect(queue?.unique).toBe(false);
    expect(indexColumns(queue)).toEqual(["lane", "oldest_open_at"]);
    expect(predicate(queue)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    expect(indexColumns(index("cases", "cases_target_idx"))).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id", "opened_at"]);
    expect(checks("cases")).toEqual(["cases_closed_answered", "cases_lane", "cases_seq_order"]);
    expect(column("cases", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // No foreign key on the target: it names two tables.
    expect(foreignKeys("cases")).toEqual({});
  });

  test("an item's partial unique indexes: one target a notice, one re-examination an item, one item per reporter, case and ground", () => {
    const target = index("intake_items", "intake_items_target_once");
    expect(target?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(target)).toEqual(["intake_id", "target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(target)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is null");

    const reexamines = index("intake_items", "intake_items_reexamines_once");
    expect(reexamines?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reexamines)).toEqual(["reexamines_item_id"]);
    expect(predicate(reexamines)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is not null");

    const reporter = index("intake_items", "intake_items_reporter_once");
    expect(reporter?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reporter)).toEqual(["case_id", "reporter_account_id", "alleges_illegal"]);
    expect(predicate(reporter)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is null");

    const seq = index("intake_items", "intake_items_case_seq_idx");
    expect(seq?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(seq)).toEqual(["case_id", "seq"]);
    expect(seq?.where).toBeUndefined();

    // The freeze's probe, and the release's.
    const suspect = index("intake_items", "intake_items_suspect_open_idx");
    expect(indexColumns(suspect)).toEqual(["case_id"]);
    expect(predicate(suspect)).toBe("suspect and answered_by is null");
    expect(predicate(index("intake_items", "intake_items_revision_idx"))).toBe("revision_pending_at is not null");
    expect(indexColumns(index("intake_items", "intake_items_answered_by_idx"))).toEqual(["answered_by"]);
  });

  test("an item records whether it is suspect and the handle an account was named by, and the database holds both halves of that", () => {
    const suspect = column("intake_items", "suspect");
    expect(suspect?.getSQLType()).toBe("boolean");
    expect(suspect?.notNull).toBe(true);
    // The trigger forces it; the default is there so that no insert must name a forced column.
    expect(suspect?.default).toBe(false);
    const named = column("intake_items", "named_handle");
    expect(named?.getSQLType()).toBe("text");
    expect(named?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(checks("intake_items")).toEqual([
      "intake_items_case",
      "intake_items_lane",
      "intake_items_named_handle",
      "intake_items_position",
      "intake_items_shown",
      "intake_items_statement",
      "intake_items_statement_len",
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("intake_items")).toEqual({
      intake_id: { table: "intakes", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      case_id: { table: "cases", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },

    });
  });

  test("no check lets a row through on a null: a statement always has its digest, a salt its form, and the two comparisons with a nullable value are null-safe", () => {
    // A CHECK passes when its expression is null, so `digest = encode(...)` alone would accept a statement with no digest.
    for (const [table, name] of [
      ["intake_items", "intake_items_statement"],
      ["appeals", "appeals_statement"],
    ] as const) {
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_digest" is not null and "${table}"."statement_digest" = encode(sha256(`);
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'`);
    }
    expect(checkSql("staff_texts", "staff_texts_digest")).toContain(`"staff_texts"."salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "staff_texts"."digest" = encode(sha256(`);
    expect(checkSql("intake_items", "intake_items_case")).toBe(
      `("intake_items"."case_id" is null) = ("intake_items"."seq" is null) and ("intake_items"."case_id" is not null or "intake_items"."outcome" is not distinct from 'not_available')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decisions", "decisions_keyword")).toBe(`"decisions"."category_keyword" is null or "decisions"."ground" is not distinct from 'illegal'`);
  });

  test("the columns of decisions that the database forces: their types, and which carry a default", () => {
    // [name, SQL type, not null, default]; undefined where the column has none and the trigger of 0016 alone fills it.
    const forced = [
      ["appeal_id", "uuid", false, undefined],
      ["answers_from_seq", "integer", false, undefined],
      ["source", "decision_source", true, undefined],
      ["automated_detection", "boolean", true, false],
      ["automated_decision", "text", true, "not_automated"],
      ["territorial_scope", "text", true, "worldwide"],
      ["decided_at", "timestamp with time zone", true, undefined],
      ["xact", "xid8", true, undefined],
      ["puid", "text", true, undefined],
      // 3f: null while its author is not told (an order's held notice), which decisions_informed allows only with no mail.
      ["informed_at", "timestamp with time zone", false, undefined],
      ["suspect", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["unseen", "boolean", true, false],
      ["needs_admin", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["ended_interim", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["author_mail", "delivery_state", true, "none"],
      ["author_mail_at", "timestamp with time zone", false, undefined],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type, notNull, fallback] of forced) {
      const c = column("decisions", name);
      expect(c?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(c?.notNull, name).toBe(notNull);
      expect(c?.default, name).toBe(fallback);

    expect(uniques("decisions")).toEqual([["decisions_puid_unique", ["puid"]]]);

  test("the ledger: a measure once a decision, lifted at most once, and the columns the database forces", () => {
    expect(shape("decision_actions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["decision_id", "uuid", true],
      ["kind", "action_kind", true],
      ["media_id", "uuid", false],
      ["subject_account_id", "uuid", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", false],
      ["reverses_action_id", "uuid", false],
      ["no_effect", "text", false],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      // 3e (design, section 6.1): three the key signs, four the trigger forces.
      ["days", "smallint", false],
      ["announced", "boolean", false],
      ["basis", "text", false],
      ["rests_on", "uuid[]", false],
      ["starts_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["ends_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["replaced", "boolean", false],
      // 3f (design, section 6.2): one the trigger forces from the order, one the key signs on a reinstatement.
      ["withhold_author", "boolean", false],
      ["order_ground", "text", false],
    ]);
    // None of the forced columns has a default: the triggers of 0016 and 0021 alone fill them.
    for (const name of ["subject_account_id", "post_id", "reverses_action_id", "no_effect", "created_at", "days", "announced", "basis", "rests_on", "starts_at", "ends_at", "replaced", "withhold_author", "order_ground"]) {
      expect(column("decision_actions", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    const once = byName.get("decision_actions")!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name), u.nullsNotDistinct]);
    expect(once).toEqual([["decision_actions_once", ["decision_id", "kind", "media_id"], true]]);
    const reversed = index("decision_actions", "decision_actions_reversed_once");
    expect(reversed?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reversed)).toEqual(["reverses_action_id"]);
    expect(predicate(reversed)).toBe("reverses_action_id is not null");
    expect(checks("decision_actions")).toEqual(["decision_actions_announced", "decision_actions_basis", "decision_actions_days", "decision_actions_no_effect", "decision_actions_order_ground"]);
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_order_ground")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."order_ground" in ('withdrawn', 'annulled', 'scrutiny', 'not_authentic', 'wrong_item')`);
    // Each check names columns only: no value of action_kind, which a check may not name in the migration that adds it.
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_days")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."days" between 1 and 30`);
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_basis")).toBe(
      `"decision_actions"."basis" in ('strikes', 'threat', 'terrorist', 'flood', 'protective', 'threat_repeat', 'ladder_end', 'reports')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_announced")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."announced" is null or "decision_actions"."basis" is not null`);
    expect(foreignKeys("decision_actions")).toEqual({
      decision_id: { table: "decisions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      reverses_action_id: { table: "decision_actions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
    });
    // 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals, in the order the migration adds them.
    expect(schema.actionKind.enumValues).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
      // 3f: the measure of an order decision and its reversal.
      "disable_by_order",
      "reinstate_by_order",
    ]);
  });

describe("the contact point and the alert channel 3f", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const checkSql = (table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(byName.get(table)!.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);
  const uniques = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name)]);
  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/release.ts`

```ts
import {
  AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE,
  RELEASE_NOTICE_POSTS_MAX,
  RELEASE_POSTS_MAX,
  RETENTION,
  SealReleasedParams,
  type AuthorNoticesPage,
  type ReleaseNoticeView,
  type SealRelease,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { AccountMailResult, ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { boundLockWaits, isBoundReached, isDeadlock } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { staffAlert } from "./alerts";
import { decodeListCursor, encodeListCursor } from "./author";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { RETRY_MARGIN_MS } from "./decide";
import { appendConfirmedAudit, iso, raisedMessage, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The release (3d design, sections 6.2, 7.2, 7.14 and 9.6): the one-way end of korbat's keeping of the images of a seal
 * for good, on a leave or an instruction to destroy that the command line recorded, by an admin's confirmed action. The
 * database decides whether it can stand (seal_release, and releases_confirmed at commit); this file reads the release
 * block a case shows, runs the confirmed action's transaction, tells every staff account, and sends the author's notice
 * at once or, while a hold on telling stands, in the dispatch round that finds the last hold ended. It names no image
 * row: the release erases them inside the database's function, and the media module's disposal drops them.
 */

/** A time as ISO text in UTC, to the microsecond, for a list's cursor. */
const microsOf = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`);

interface FactsRow {
  reported: boolean;
  their_reference: string | null;
  answer: SealRelease["answer"];
  answered_at: string | null;
  handed_over_at: string | null;
  quarantined: boolean;
  preserved: boolean;
  leave_id: string | null;
  leave_from: "authority" | "court" | null;
  leave_reference: string | null;
  leave_received_on: string | null;
  leave_untold: boolean | null;
  leave_untold_until: string | null;
  tell_held: boolean;
}

/**
 * CaseDecision.release (sections 7.2, 8.5 and 10.3) for each of these seals for good in force, keyed by the seal's
 * ledger row: the facts of release_facts, the lowest RELEASE_POSTS_MAX posts of the seal not yet released (which the
 * params the key signs must name), how many more remain, silence_days, and the seal's newest release with its posts and
 * their image rows as the seal counted them.
 */
export async function releaseBlocks(q: Runner, actionIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, SealRelease>> {
  const blocks = new Map<string, SealRelease>();
  if (actionIds.length === 0) return blocks;
  const [rules] = await rows<{ silence_days: number | null }>(q, sql`select r.silence_days from public.release_rules() r`);
  for (const actionId of actionIds) {
    const [f] = await rows<FactsRow>(
      q,
      sql`select f.reported, f.their_reference, f.answer, ${iso("f.answered_at")} as answered_at, ${iso("f.handed_over_at")} as handed_over_at,
                 f.quarantined, f.preserved, f.leave_id, f.leave_from, f.leave_reference, to_char(f.leave_received_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as leave_received_on,
                 f.leave_untold, ${iso("f.leave_untold_until")} as leave_untold_until, f.tell_held
            from public.release_facts(${actionId}::uuid) f`,
    );
    const open = await rows<{ post_id: string }>(
      q,
      sql`select s.post_id from public.seal_posts s
           where s.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid and not exists (select 1 from public.release_posts r where r.post_id = s.post_id)
           order by s.post_id`,
    );
    const [newest] = await rows<{ released_at: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; backups_clear_at: string; held: boolean }>(
      q,
      sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, r.basis, ${iso("r.backups_clear_at")} as backups_clear_at, r.author_notice = 'held' as held
            from public.releases r where r.seal_action_id = ${actionId}::uuid order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc limit 1`,
    );
    const [released] = await rows<{ posts: number; images: number }>(
      q,
      sql`select count(*)::int as posts, coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int as images
            from public.seal_posts s join public.release_posts r on r.post_id = s.post_id where s.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid`,
    );
    const postIds = open.slice(0, RELEASE_POSTS_MAX).map((row) => row.post_id);
    blocks.set(actionId, {
      reported: f!.reported,
      theirReference: f!.their_reference,
      answer: f!.answer,
      answeredAt: f!.answered_at,
      handedOverAt: f!.handed_over_at,
      quarantined: f!.quarantined,
      preserved: f!.preserved,
      leave:
        f!.leave_id === null
          ? null
          : { id: f!.leave_id, from: f!.leave_from!, reference: f!.leave_reference!, receivedOn: f!.leave_received_on!, untold: f!.leave_untold === true, untoldUntil: f!.leave_untold_until },
      tellHeld: f!.tell_held,
      postIds,
      remaining: open.length - postIds.length,
      silenceDays: rules!.silence_days,
      releasedAt: newest?.released_at ?? null,
      basis: newest?.basis ?? null,
      backupsClearAt: newest?.backups_clear_at ?? null,
      noticeHeld: newest === undefined ? null : newest.held,
      releasedPosts: released!.posts,
      releasedImages: released!.images,
    });
  }
  return blocks;
}

/** The locks a release may wait for: the subject's profile, the case, the leave, the admin's auth row, the image rows and the audit head. */
const RELEASE_WAITS = 6;

/** What a release that committed answers: the seal's case, which the route answers as it now stands. */
export type ReleaseOutcome = { caseId: string; releaseId: string } | "ended" | "late";

/**
 * POST /api/staff/seals/:action/release, once its step-up verified (section 7.2): one transaction on the API's pool,
 * built as recordConfirmed builds a decision's. Every lock wait is bounded by what is left of the challenge; the subject's
 * profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE first, as in every deciding transaction; then seal_release, which takes the seal's case and
 * checks everything in the database's order; last the confirmed audit row seal_released on the seal, with the params as
 * the key confirmed them and the release's id, which releases_confirmed holds the row to at commit. "ended" and "late"
 * as for a decision; once more after a deadlock while the challenge has time. After the commit, unwaited for: the alert
 * seal_released to every staff account and the author's notice, unless it was born held.
 */
export async function releaseSeal(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<ReleaseOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never releases: a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "seal_released" || confirmed.target.type !== "seal" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) throw new Error("a seal is released only with the step-up that confirmed it");
  const params = SealReleasedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  const actionId = confirmed.target.id;
  // A ledger row never changes: its subject and its case are read before the transaction, as decide reads a post's author.
  const [seal] = await rows<{ subject: string; case_id: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select a.subject_account_id as subject, d.case_id from public.decision_actions a join public.decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
         where a.id = ${actionId}::uuid and a.kind::text = 'seal_media'`,
  );
  if (seal === undefined) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx): Promise<{ releaseId: string } | "late"> => {
        if (!(await boundLockWaits(tx, confirmed.expiresAt, RELEASE_WAITS))) return "late";
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [seal.subject], "no key update");
        const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select public.seal_release(${actionId}::uuid, ${params.basis}, ${params.leaveId}::uuid, ${session.userId}::uuid) as id`);
        await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
          actorId: session.userId,
          keyId: confirmed.keyId,
          action: "seal_released",
          targetType: "seal",
          targetId: actionId,
          metadata: { params: confirmed.params, releaseId: row!.id },
          staffSession: session.handle,
          actionHash: confirmed.actionHash,
          stepUp: confirmed.assertion,
          requestId: ctx.requestId,
          expiresAt: confirmed.expiresAt,
        });
        return { releaseId: row!.id };
      });
      if (outcome === "late") return "late";
      deps.background.start(() => afterRelease(deps, outcome.releaseId, params.postIds.length));
      return { caseId: seal.case_id, releaseId: outcome.releaseId };
    } catch (err) {
      const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_ended") return "ended";
      if (refusal === "staff_confirmation_late") return "late";
      if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isBoundReached(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt > 1 || confirmed.expiresAt.getTime() - deps.now().getTime() <= RETRY_MARGIN_MS) return "late";
    }
  }
}

/**
 * What follows a release's commit, each part in a try of its own (section 7.2, after the commit): the alert seal_released
 * to every staff account, the admin who released included, without a throttle (3c gives the milder lifting of a seal
 * the same); then the author's notice, when it was not born held. Never throws.
 */
async function afterRelease(deps: ModerationDeps, releaseId: string, posts: number): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await staffAlert(deps, null, 0, { template: "seal_released", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), posts, uploads: 0 } });
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, releaseId }, "moderation: the staff accounts were not alerted to a release");
  }
  try {
    await sendReleaseNotice(deps, releaseId);
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, releaseId }, "moderation: a release's notice was not sent; the dispatch round sends it");
  }
}

/** A mail's result as the notice's state. A relay that cannot take the mail now throws, and the notice stays pending. */
const NOTICE_STATE: Record<AccountMailResult, "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "failed"> = {
  sent: "sent",
  suppressed: "suppressed",
  no_address: "no_address",
  refused: "failed",
};

/** The release's author: the seal's subject, or for a replay the author of its posts; null when neither is there. */
const AUTHOR = (alias: string) =>
  sql.raw(`coalesce((select a.subject_account_id from public.decision_actions a where a.id = ${alias}.seal_action_id),
                    (select p.author_id from public.posts p where p.id = any(${alias}.post_ids) order by p.id limit 1))`);

/**
 * The view of a release that releaseNoticeParagraphs reads (ReleaseNoticeView), read for anyone or for its author alone
 * with `owner`; null for a release that is not there, not the owner's, or (unless `held` is allowed) whose notice is held.
 * `images` is the image rows the release erased, as the seals counted them (seal_posts.images, which nothing changes).
 */
export async function releaseView(q: Runner, releaseId: string, options: { owner?: string; allowHeld?: boolean } = {}): Promise<(ReleaseNoticeView & { authorId: string | null }) | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ id: string; basis: "leave" | "period"; released_at: string; backups_clear_at: string; upload: boolean; post_ids: string[]; author_id: string | null; held: boolean; seal_decision: string | null; images: number }>(
    q,
    sql`select r.id, r.basis, ${iso("r.released_at")} as released_at, ${iso("r.backups_clear_at")} as backups_clear_at, r.upload_refusal_id is not null as upload,
               r.post_ids::text[] as post_ids, ${AUTHOR("r")} as author_id, r.author_notice = 'held' as held,
               coalesce((select a.decision_id from public.decision_actions a where a.id = r.seal_action_id),
                        (select a.decision_id from public.seal_posts s join public.decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id
                          where s.post_id = any(r.post_ids) order by a.created_at desc, a.id limit 1)) as seal_decision,
               coalesce((select sum(x.images) from (select max(s.images) as images from public.seal_posts s where s.post_id = any(r.post_ids) group by s.post_id) x), 0)::int as images
          from public.releases r where r.id = ${releaseId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (row === undefined) return null;
  if (options.owner !== undefined && row.author_id !== options.owner) return null;
  if (row.held && !options.allowHeld) return null;
  const posts = await rows<{ id: string; created_at: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select p.id, ${iso("p.created_at")} as created_at from public.posts p where p.id = any(${`{${row.post_ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) order by p.created_at, p.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICE_POSTS_MAX}`,
  );
  return {
    id: row.id,
    basis: row.basis,
    releasedAt: row.released_at,
    backupsClearAt: row.backups_clear_at,
    upload: row.upload,
    posts: posts.map((post) => ({ id: post.id, createdAt: post.created_at })),
    postCount: row.post_ids.length,
    images: row.images,
    sealDecisionId: row.seal_decision,
    authorId: row.author_id,
  };
}

/**
 * The author's notice of one release, if it is pending: in a transaction that holds the release's row FOR UPDATE while
 * the mail is sent, so the send after the commit and the dispatch round never both send it. The mail's result is the
 * notice's state; a relay that could not take it leaves it pending for the next round. Answers whether it was sent.
 */
export async function sendReleaseNotice(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth">, releaseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    const [locked] = await rows<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select r.id from public.releases r where r.id = ${releaseId}::uuid and r.author_notice = 'pending' for update`);
    if (locked === undefined) return false;
    const view = await releaseView(tx, releaseId, { allowHeld: false });
    if (view === null || view.authorId === null) {
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'none', author_notice_at = now() where id = ${releaseId}::uuid`);
      return false;
    }
    const { authorId, ...notice } = view;
    const state = NOTICE_STATE[await deps.auth.mailAccount(authorId, { template: "release_notice", view: notice })];
    await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = ${state}, author_notice_at = now() where id = ${releaseId}::uuid`);
    return state === "sent";
  });
}

/** How many releases' notices one round takes at most. */
const RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND = 50;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * The dispatch round's releases (sections 7.2 and 7.14): first every held notice whose release the author may now be
 * told of (release_tellable) moves to pending, in the round that finds the last hold ended and never before, and is
 * mailed at once; then every pending notice the send after its commit left (older than `due`) is mailed, or given up
 * after the give-up days of 3c, counted from when it became pending. A row that fails is logged and left as it was.
 * Answers how many were sent.
 */
export async function releaseNotices(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date, due: Date, logUnsent: (err: unknown, ids: Record<string, string>) => void): Promise<number> {
  let sent = 0;
  const held = await rows<{ id: string }>(deps.apiDb, sql`select r.id from public.releases r where r.author_notice = 'held' order by r.released_at, r.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND}`);
  for (const { id } of held) {
    try {
      const moved = await rows<{ id: string }>(
        deps.apiDb,
        sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'pending', author_notice_at = now()
             where id = ${id}::uuid and author_notice = 'held' and public.release_tellable(id) returning id`,
      );
      if (moved.length > 0 && (await sendReleaseNotice(deps, id))) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { releaseId: id });
    }
  }
  const pending = await rows<{ id: string; since: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select r.id, ${iso("coalesce(r.author_notice_at, r.released_at)")} as since from public.releases r
         where r.author_notice = 'pending' and coalesce(r.author_notice_at, r.released_at) < ${due.toISOString()}::timestamptz
         order by r.released_at, r.id limit ${RELEASE_NOTICES_PER_ROUND}`,
  );
  for (const { id, since } of pending) {
    try {
      if (now.getTime() - Date.parse(since) > RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays * DAY_MS) {
        await deps.apiDb.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'failed', author_notice_at = now() where id = ${id}::uuid and author_notice = 'pending'`);
        deps.log.warn({ kind: "release_notice", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
        continue;
      }
      if (await sendReleaseNotice(deps, id)) sent++;
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(err, { releaseId: id });
    }
  }
  return sent;
}

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/notices (sections 9.6 and 10.2): the releases about the viewer's posts, newest first, 20 a page,
 * never one whose notice is held: nothing of the app shows a release while a hold on telling stands.
 */
export async function authorNotices(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, viewer: string, cursor?: string): Promise<AuthorNoticesPage> {
  const after = cursor === undefined ? null : decodeListCursor(cursor);
  const found = await rows<{ id: string; at: string; key: string }>(
    deps.apiDb,
    sql`select r.id, ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, ${microsOf("r.released_at")} as key
          from public.releases r
         where r.author_notice <> 'held' and ${AUTHOR("r")} = ${viewer}::uuid
           and (${after === null} or (r.released_at, r.id) < (${after?.at ?? null}::timestamptz, ${after?.id ?? null}::uuid))
         order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc
         limit ${AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE + 1}`,
  );
  const page = found.slice(0, AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE);
  const last = page[page.length - 1];
  return {
    notices: page.map((row) => ({ kind: "release" as const, id: row.id, at: row.at })),
    nextCursor: found.length > AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE && last ? encodeListCursor({ at: last.key, id: last.id }) : null,
  };
}

/** GET /api/moderation/releases/:release: the notice for its author alone, and not_found while it is held or for anyone else. */
export async function authorRelease(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, viewer: string, releaseId: string): Promise<ReleaseNoticeView> {
  const view = await releaseView(deps.apiDb, releaseId, { owner: viewer });
  if (view === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const { authorId: _author, ...notice } = view;
  return notice;
}

/**
 * The appeals' mark (sections 7.2 and 8.7): for each of these decisions whose seal has released posts, the newest
 * release's time and ground, keyed by the decision's id.
 */
export async function releasedSeals(q: Runner, decisionIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, { at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>> {
  const marks = new Map<string, { at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>();
  if (decisionIds.length === 0) return marks;
  const found = await rows<{ decision_id: string; at: string; basis: "leave" | "period" }>(
    q,
    sql`select distinct on (a.decision_id) a.decision_id, ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, r.basis
          from public.decision_actions a join public.releases r on r.seal_action_id = a.id
         where a.decision_id = any(${`{${decisionIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and a.kind::text = 'seal_media'
         order by a.decision_id, r.released_at desc, r.id desc`,
  );
  for (const row of found) marks.set(row.decision_id, { at: row.at, basis: row.basis });
  return marks;
}

/** Home's [home.released] (sections 8.2 and 10.3): the releases of the last DESTRUCTIVE_DAYS, newest first, with their seal's case. */
export async function recentReleases(q: Runner, days: number, max: number): Promise<{ kind: "seal_released"; at: string; caseId: string | null; refusalId: null }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ at: string; case_id: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select ${iso("r.released_at")} as at, d.case_id
          from public.releases r
          left join public.decision_actions a on a.id = r.seal_action_id
          left join public.decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
         where r.replay_of is null and r.released_at >= now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int)
         order by r.released_at desc, r.id desc limit ${max}`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: "seal_released" as const, at: row.at, caseId: row.case_id, refusalId: null }));
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/app/settings/cases/releases/[id].tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import type { ReleaseNoticeView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { ReleaseNoticeDetail } from "@/components/moderation/ReleaseNotice";
import { SettingsNav } from "@/components/SettingsNav";
import { ErrorText, Loading, TextLink } from "@/components/ui";
import { ApiError, errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { moderation } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { CASES_WORDS, DECISION_WORDS, RELEASE_TEXTS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";

type Shown = { kind: "loading" } | { kind: "missing" } | { kind: "failed"; message: string } | { kind: "release"; view: ReleaseNoticeView; appealOpen: boolean };

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, section 9.6): a release's notice, under Settings, Cases; its entry in "About you" leads here. The
 * API answers only for the author of the released posts, and not at all while the author may not be told yet; anything
 * else reads as one sentence, whatever the id named. Whether an appeal of the sealing decision waits is read from that
 * decision, which the author may read.
 */
export default function Release() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown>({ kind: "loading" });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setShown({ kind: "loading" });
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const view = await moderation.release(id);
        // [release.appeal]: the decision that sealed, when its appeal waits. A failure to read it leaves the line out.
        let appealOpen = false;
        if (view.sealDecisionId !== null) {
          appealOpen = await moderation.decision(view.sealDecisionId).then(
            (decision) => decision.appeal?.state === "pending",
            () => false,
          );
        }
        if (!cancelled) setShown({ kind: "release", view, appealOpen });
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (err instanceof ApiError && (err.status === 404 || err.code === "invalid_request")) setShown({ kind: "missing" });
        else setShown({ kind: "failed", message: errorMessage(err) });
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [id]);

  return (
    <AppShell>
      <ScrollView contentContainerClassName="px-4 pb-16 pt-4">
        <Text accessibilityRole="header" className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-50">
          {CASES_WORDS.title}
        </Text>
        <SettingsNav current="cases" />
        <View className="mt-6 w-full max-w-xl">
          {shown.kind === "loading" ? <Loading /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "missing" ? <ErrorText message={RELEASE_TEXTS.notFound} /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "failed" ? <ErrorText message={shown.message} /> : null}
          {shown.kind === "release" ? <ReleaseNoticeDetail view={shown.view} appealOpen={shown.appealOpen} /> : null}
          <TextLink label={DECISION_WORDS.back} href="/settings/cases" />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/moderation/ReleaseNotice.tsx`

```tsx
import { Text, View } from "react-native";
import type { ReleaseNoticeView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { releaseNoticeParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { TextLink } from "@/components/ui";
import { RELEASE_TEXTS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2 and 9.6; W.6): the notice of a release of sealed images of the reader's posts, on its
 * screen under Settings, Cases. Its paragraphs are RELEASE_NOTICE's, rendered by the one function the mail uses, and no
 * control: a release cannot be undone. It links the decision that sealed, and while an appeal of that decision waits
 * it says so ([release.appeal]): the release closed nothing. It names no authority, no reference and no assessment, and
 * draws no image.
 */
export function ReleaseNoticeDetail({ view, appealOpen }: { view: ReleaseNoticeView; appealOpen: boolean }) {
  return (
    <View>
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {RELEASE_TEXTS.title}
      </Text>
      {releaseNoticeParagraphs(view).map((paragraph, index) => (
        <Text key={index} className="mt-3 text-base leading-6 text-zinc-200">
          {paragraph}
        </Text>
      ))}
      {appealOpen ? <Text className="mt-3 text-base leading-6 text-zinc-100">{RELEASE_TEXTS.appeal}</Text> : null}
      {view.sealDecisionId === null ? null : <TextLink label={RELEASE_TEXTS.decision} href={`/settings/cases/${view.sealDecisionId}`} />}
    </View>
  );
}
```
