      // Same origin only, never cached, and never redirected: the staff API answers every request itself.
      response = await deps.fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        redirect: "error",
      });
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError(0, "network");
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const envelope = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => null));
      const code = envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.code : response.status === 404 ? "not_found" : "internal";
      // The API cleared both staff cookies with this answer; the store shows sign-in in place. The cookie is gone from
      // the page by now, so what the request carried, read before it was sent, is the only record that it was there.
      if (code === "staff_session_required") hooks.onSessionRequired(Boolean(csrf));
      throw new ApiError(response.status, code, undefined, envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.details : undefined);
    }

    let value: T | string;
    if (schema === null) {
      value = undefined as T;
    } else if (schema === "text") {
      // A body that breaks off on the way ends here as a shorter text, or as a network failure.
      try {
        value = await response.text();
      } catch {
        throw new ApiError(0, "network");
      }
    } else {
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => undefined));
      if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError(response.status, "invalid_answer");
      value = parsed.data;
    }
    // Only a marked success restarts the idle timer. A refused request moved nothing; one that did move the idle end but
    // failed later, or whose answer the schemas refused, only makes the timer read /me early, and it follows the answer.
    if (call.activity === true) hooks.onActivity();
    return value;
  }

  const query = (q: AuditQuery): string => {
    // Fixed order, numbers only: nothing a person typed reaches the address unchecked.
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (q.action !== undefined) params.set("action", q.action);
    if (q.cursor !== undefined) params.set("cursor", String(q.cursor));
    if (q.at !== undefined) params.set("at", String(q.at));
    // 3f Task 6: a key's id is a checked lower-case uuid and a time an instant the screen checked; both are encoded.
    if (q.key !== undefined) params.set("key", q.key);
    if (q.from !== undefined) params.set("from", q.from);
    if (q.to !== undefined) params.set("to", q.to);
    const text = params.toString();
    return text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`;
  };

  return {
    hooks,
    me: async (call: Call = {}) => {
      const me = await request("GET", "/api/staff/me", StaffMe, call);
      hooks.onMe(me);
      return me;
    },
    sessions: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/sessions", StaffSessionsResponse, call),
    keys: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/keys", StaffKeysResponse, call),
    audit: (q: AuditQuery, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/audit${query(q)}`, AuditPage, call),
    signOut: (call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/signout", null, call),
    signInOptions: (call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/options", StaffSignInOptionsResponse, call),
    signInVerify: (body: StaffSignInVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/verify", StaffSignInVerifyResponse, call, body),
    enrollOptions: (body: StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/options", StaffEnrollOptionsResponse, call, body),
    enrollVerify: (body: StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/verify", StaffEnrollVerifyResponse, call, body),
    stepUpOptions: (body: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/step-up/options", StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, call, body),
    /** The handle must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    revokeSession: (handle: string, body: StaffSessionRevokeRequest, call: Call = {}) =>
      request<void>("DELETE", `/api/staff/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}`, null, call, body),

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3). A case's address is built from a checked id; every other value goes in
    // a body or, for the queue's cursor, is one the API itself handed out, encoded.
    overview: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/overview", StaffOverview, call),
    /** A page of the queue. Its refreshes carry no mark: they are the page's own, never its person's. */
    queue: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/queue${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, QueuePage, call),
    caseView: async (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => sameCase(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}`, CaseView, call)),
    takeSnapshot: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/snapshots`, StaffSnapshotTaken, call, {}),
    saveText: (id: CaseId, body: StaffTextSaveRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextSaved, call, body),
    texts: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextsResponse, call),
    openFinding: (body: FindingRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/findings", FindingResponse, call, body),
    /**
     * A decision on a case, with the key's confirmation: the case must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up
     * confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the case as it now stands, and it is that case's.
     */
    decide: async (caseId: string, body: CaseDecisionRequest, call: Call = {}, gap: string | null = null) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || (gap !== null && !isLowerUuid(gap))) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      // 3f Task 6: a decision that takes a lost one again names the restore gap it closes, as the query member `gap`.
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions${gap === null ? "" : `?gap=${gap}`}`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3e: the Standing screen's four lists. */
    standing: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/standing", StandingLists, call),
    /** A page of the pending appeals, newest first. The cursor is one the API itself handed out, encoded. */
    appeals: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/appeals${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, AppealsPage, call),
    /**
     * The review of the appeal of a decision, with the key's confirmation: the decision must already be the lower-case
     * uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the decision's case as it now stands,
     * and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    review: async (caseId: string, decisionId: string, body: AppealReviewRequest, call: Call = {}, gap: string | null = null) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || !isLowerUuid(decisionId) || (gap !== null && !isLowerUuid(gap))) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/decisions/${decisionId}/review${gap === null ? "" : `?gap=${gap}`}`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3f: a page of the messages at the contact point, newest first, all or only those nobody has handled. The cursor is
     * one the API itself handed out, encoded.
     */
    contact: (cursor: string | null, open: boolean, call: Call = {}) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (cursor !== null) params.set("cursor", cursor);
      if (open) params.set("open", "1");
      const text = params.toString();
      return request("GET", `/api/staff/contact${text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`}`, ContactPage, call);
    },
    /** 3f: closes a message as what it was. Its id must be a lower-case uuid; the route answers 204. */
    closeContact: async (messageId: string, body: ContactCloseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(messageId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request<void>("POST", `/api/staff/contact/${messageId}/close`, null, call, body);
    },
    /** 3f: the orders not closed and those closed in the last 30 days. */
    orders: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/orders", OrdersPage, call),
    /** 3f: one order. An answer about another order than the one asked is no answer. */
    order: async (id: OrderId, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/orders/${id}`, OrderView, call)),
    /** 3f: opens an order, with or without a message, without a key. */
    openOrder: (body: OrderOpenRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/orders", OrderView, call, body),
    /** 3f: more links for an order, without a key. */
    addOrderItems: async (id: OrderId, body: OrderItemsRequest, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/items`, OrderView, call, body)),
    /** 3f: a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    recordOrderEvent: async (id: string, body: OrderEventRecordRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/events`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f Task 3: "Disable for an order"; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    effectOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderEffectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/effect`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f: a correction of what the order shows, with the step-up only under the rule admin. */
    correctOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderCorrectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/correct`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3f Task 6 (7.16): the audit log's tail after `after` up to `through`, confirmed with the key, as the text of its JSON
     * lines; the screen checks the lines before anything is saved or marked. A refusal is an ApiError as for any call.
     */
    exportAudit: async (body: AuditExportedParams & { stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON }, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/audit/export", "text", call, body),
    /** 3f Task 6: the keeper's confirmation that the whole file is held: its last line's place and hash; 204, or copy_mismatch. */
    markCopy: (body: AuditMarkRequest, call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/audit/export/mark", null, call, body),
    /** 3f Task 6: what an import after a restore found lost. */
    restore: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/restore", RestoreView, call),
    /** 3f Task 6: an admin's "Not needed" on a gap; its id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    closeGap: async (gapId: string, body: { disposition: "not_needed"; stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON }, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(gapId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/restore/gaps/${gapId}/close`, RestoreView, call, body);
    },
    /**
     * 3d Task 2: an admin's release of a seal for good, with the key's confirmation: the seal's ledger row must already be
     * the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the seal's case as it now
     * stands, and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    releaseSeal: async (caseId: string, actionId: string, body: SealReleaseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(actionId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/seals/${actionId}/release`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** The item must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    reveal: async (itemId: string, body: IdentityRevealRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(itemId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/items/${itemId}/reveal`, RevealResponse, call, body);
    },
  };
}

  keep: {

    /** [replace.reply] */

  home: {

    strikes: (n: number) => `Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: ${n}.`,
  },
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 5 (design, sections 8.3, 8.4 and 8.7)
  /** 8.3: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it. Both cite R6; the composer sets it. */

    warnLabel: "Warn about reporting",
    restrictLabel: "Restrict reporting",
    /** Beside both controls. */
    rule: "Both measures cite R6; the composer sets it.",
    /** [warn.what], with the account's counts as this page read them. */
    warnWhat: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `A warning restricts nothing. It tells the account that ${unfounded} of the ${reports} reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded, lists them, and says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction. A report counts once, however many of its items were marked, and by the day it was sent. A notice of illegal content is never counted.`,
    /** [warn.short] */
    warnShort: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>

This account has ${unfounded} of ${reports}. One report never reaches the number alone.`,
    /** [warn.standing] */

"day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination stay open to it.`,

    restrictNoWarning: "Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.",
    /** [restrict.short] */
    restrictShort: (marksSince: number, warnedOn: string) => `Not open: ${marksSince} of the reports the account sent since the warning of ${warnedOn} were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`,

    restrictRunning: (restrictedUntil: string) => `Not open: a restriction runs until ${restrictedUntil}.`,

    liftWarning: "Lift the warning about reporting",

    /** [mark.never], once, when an item the decision answers cannot be marked. */

    /** [mark.undone] */

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile; and the refusals of
  // Task 2's order routes.
  "message_handled",
  "order_needs_message",
  "order_exists",
  "order_closed",
  "order_event_refused",
  "already_released",
  // 3f Task 3 (design, sections 8.5 and 8.9): the refusals of giving effect to an order.
  "order_changed",
  "order_not_verified",
  "order_cap",
  // 3f Task 6 (design, sections 8.7 to 8.9): a gap that is closed or that a decision does not fit, and a copy mark the
  // database did not take.
  "gap_mismatch",
  "copy_mismatch",
  // 3d Task 2 (design, section 8.8): the release's refusals and its check at commit.
  "release_not_open",
  "release_not_reported",
  "release_not_quarantined",
  "release_preserved",
  "release_no_leave",
  "release_period_unset",
  "release_period_running",
  "release_mismatch",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** 3f Task 6 [copy.broken] (8.7): a download that broke off, whose mark the database refused or the console never sent. */
const COPY_BROKEN = "The download broke off, or its lines do not continue each other. Nothing was recorded as copied: press again.";

/** 3f [open.duplicate]: an order of this state, authority and reference is recorded already (order_exists). */
const OPEN_DUPLICATE =
  "An order of this authority with this reference is already recorded. If that record is wrong, correct it on its screen; if it is closed, an admin reopens it there. Do not open the order a second time under a changed reference.";

/** The console's words for each of them. A recusal reads the same whether the conflict concerns the author or a reporter. */

  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",

  reply_not_open: "This measure takes no reply: it has ended or was lifted.",

  order_cap: `You have given effect to ${ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay} order items in 24 hours, the most one staff account may. Another staff member goes on; tell the operator at once.`,

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 8.2, 8.3 and 18): the console's sentences of authorities' orders, each under the design's key
 * (`home.contact` is [home.contact]). Every number in one is printed from the answer or from ORDER_RULES, never typed, and
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.
 */

  home: {
    title: "Authorities",
    /** [home.contact], in three parts: the words before the link to Contact point, the link's own words, and the rest. */

/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8.1, 8.2 and 8.4): the words of sealed files and their custody, the quarantine, the release and
 * held uploads, each under its key. Every number is printed from the answer or from a constant (QUARANTINE_RULES), never
 * typed; every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. Task 1 has the quarantine's.
 */
export const CUSTODY_WORDS = {
  /** The home screen's block below "Authorities", each line only while it applies. */
  homeTitle: "Sealed files and programs",
  /** [home.quarantine], while a move into the quarantine or back is due. */
  homeQuarantine: (dueIn: number, dueOut: number, oldest: string) =>
    `Files to move or return: ${dueIn} images to move into the quarantine, ${dueOut} to return to the image store, the oldest due since ${oldest}. Whoever has the server runs the README's steps under Quarantine (staff.js quarantine-list). Until then a sealed image's files are still in the image store, and an image whose seal was lifted is not shown.`,
  /** Its addition once the oldest due move is older than the alert's threshold. */
  homeQuarantineLate: `More than ${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours} hours: every staff account is alerted daily until the move is recorded.`,
  /** [case.custody.in], on a seal for good in force. */
  custodyIn: (moved: number, files: number, movedAt: string | null) => (moved > 0 && movedAt !== null ? `Files: ${moved} of ${files} are in the quarantine, since ${movedAt}.` : "Files: not moved to the quarantine yet."),
  custodyInRest: "The others are still in the image store until whoever has the server moves them (the README, Quarantine).",
  /** [case.custody.return], while files of a lifted seal are still in the quarantine. */
  custodyReturn: (toReturn: number) =>
    `Files to return: the seal was lifted and ${toReturn} files of its images are still in the quarantine. The images are shown again once whoever has the server has returned them (the README, Quarantine).`,
  /** [case.custody.lost], under a seal for good in force, and after a lifted seal. */
  custodyLost: (lost: number, inForce: boolean) =>
    inForce
      ? `Files lost: ${lost}. They were found in neither the image store nor the quarantine and are recorded as lost; there is nothing to move, hand over or destroy for them.`
      : `Files lost: ${lost}. Their images cannot be shown again; their author was told so.`,
} as const;

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 8.2, 8.5 and 8.7): the console's words of the release, each under the design's key
 * (`what` is [release.what]). Every number is printed from the answer or from the contracts' constants, never typed;
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. An authority's reference and a leave's are
 * an outsider's text, drawn framed, never in a label's place.
 */
export const RELEASE_WORDS = {
  title: "Release",
  /** The block's labels and values (8.5's table). */
  facts: {
    reported: { label: "Reported to an authority", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
    theirReference: { label: "The authority's reference", frame: "As recorded from the authority", none: "not recorded" },
    answer: {
      label: "The authority's assessment",
      values: { illegal: "illegal", not_illegal: "not illegal", no_assessment: "no assessment", other: "another answer" } as Record<string, string>,
      none: "none recorded",
    },
    answeredAt: { label: "Assessed on", none: "no answer" },
    handedOverAt: { label: "Files handed over on", none: "nothing was handed over" },
    leave: { label: "Leave or instruction to destroy", none: "none recorded", from: { authority: "from the authority", court: "from a court" } as Record<string, string> },
    leaveReference: { label: "Its reference", none: "none recorded" },
    leaveDay: { label: "Its day", none: "none recorded" },
    tell: {
      label: "The author may be told",
      atOnce: "at once",
      untold: (until: string | null) => `not yet: the leave is recorded as not to be told to the person, ${until === null ? "with no end recorded" : `until ${until}`}`,
      record: "not yet: the record of the report, or an authority's order about one of these posts, says that the person is not to be told",
    },
    quarantined: { label: "Files in the quarantine", yes: "all of them, by the record", no: "not all: the move is not recorded" },
    preserved: { label: "Preserved for an order", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
  },
  what: "A release ends korbat's keeping of these sealed images for good. It marks the posts as released and erases their image rows now. Whoever has the server then destroys the files in the quarantine, and the digest of each destroyed file is recorded as the proof. It cannot be undone: nothing brings a destroyed file back. The seal stays in the record as a measure, and the post's text is not touched.",
  tells:
    `The author is told what korbat did: that it released the images, and that an authority's or a court's leave or instruction is its ground. The notice names no authority and no reference and says nothing of what any authority found. It is sent at once, or, while the leave, the record of the report or an authority's order says that the person is not to be told, when the last of these has ended and never before.  * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",

  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

```tsx
import { MEASURES, type AppealRow } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, describeError, RELEASE_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { dateTime, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";

/**
 * The appeals screen (3c design, sections 7.7 and 8): the appeals no review has answered yet, newest first, each with
 * its case, the decision it appeals, the end of that decision's appeal window, and whether the reading person may
 * review it. It shows no statement: what an appellant wrote is read on the case's page, whose read is logged and
 * counted. Everything a row shows is a time, a rule's id, a measure's label or one of the console's own sentences.
 */

/** What the decision of a row did, in the composer's labels for its measures. */
const actionsOf = (row: AppealRow): string => row.actions.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label).join(", ");

/** The marks of a row: whether this person may review it, whether its review is an admin's, and whether nobody may review it now. */
export function marksOf(row: AppealRow): string[] {
  const marks: string[] = [row.mayReview ? APPEAL_WORDS.mayReview : APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview];
  if (row.needsAdmin) marks.push(APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin);
  if (row.reviewer !== "available") marks.push(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer[row.reviewer]);
  return marks;
}

export interface AppealsViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<AppealRow[]>;
  /** Whether the API named a further page. */
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
}

export function AppealsView({ rows, more, loadingMore, onLoadMore, onOpenCase }: AppealsViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="appeals-title">
      <h2 id="appeals-title">Appeals</h2>
      <p className="hint">{`${APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule} ${APPEAL_WORDS.statementOnCase}`}</p>
      {/* 3e Task 4 (8.5): [appeals.order] */}
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.appealsOrder}</p>
      <Loaded
        value={rows}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No appeal waits.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="scroll">
              <table className="queue">
                <caption className="visually-hidden">Appeals that wait for a review</caption>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Filed</th>
                    <th scope="col">Decision</th>
                    <th scope="col">Its appeal window ends</th>
                    <th scope="col">Review</th>
                    <th scope="col">
                      <span className="visually-hidden">Open</span>
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {list.map((row) => {
                    const id = parseCaseId(row.caseId);
                    return (
                      <tr key={row.id}>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.filedAt}>{dateTime(row.filedAt)}</time>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          {`Decided ${dateTime(row.decidedAt)}, ${row.legal ? "on the law" : `under ${row.ruleId ?? "a rule"}`}: ${actionsOf(row)}`}
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.deadline}>{dateTime(row.deadline)}</time>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          {[...(row.standingFirst ? [`${STANDING_WORDS.appealsFirst}.`] : []), ...marksOf(row)].join(" ")}
                          {/* 3d Task 2 [appeals.released] (8.7): the appeal of a seal whose posts were released stays open. */}
                          {row.released ? <p className="notice">{RELEASE_WORDS.appealReleased(dateTime(row.released.at), row.released.basis)}</p> : null}
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          {id ? (
                            <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                              Open the case
                            </CaseLink>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        }
      />
      {more ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore} aria-busy={loadingMore}>
          Load more
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * Reads the list from its start through as many pages as the screen shows, one after the other. Each read is its
 * person's own: the screen is opened, or "Load more" clicked; the list never reads itself again on a timer.
 */
export async function readAppeals(api: StaffApi, pages: number): Promise<{ rows: AppealRow[]; next: string | null }> {
  const rows: AppealRow[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let page = 0; page < Math.max(1, pages); page++) {
    const answer = await api.appeals(cursor, { activity: true });
    rows.push(...answer.appeals);
    cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) break;
  }
  return { rows, next: cursor };
}

export function Appeals({ api, onOpenCase }: { api: StaffApi; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<AppealRow[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    readAppeals(api, 1).then(
      (answer) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.rows });
        setNext(answer.next);
      },
      (err: unknown) => alive.current && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
    );
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.appeals(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.appeals] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  return <AppealsView rows={rows} more={next !== null} loadingMore={loadingMore} onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} />;
}
```
