### Replace `apps/api/src/cli/restore.ts` (whole file)

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's recovery (3f design, sections 6.6, 7.16, 7.17 and 8.11, "Recovery and the counts"):
 *
 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js audit-export [--after <place>] > file.jsonl
 *   cat <files> | docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js restore-import [<place>:<hash> ...]
 *
 * audit-export is the keeper's download from the server: the rows after a place as JSON lines on standard output, in the
 * console's form (AuditExportLine), and its own copy mark with the audit row copy_marked under the system actor, since its
 * output goes to a file on the server and no browser has to confirm it. It runs on the API's role, as audit-head does.
 *
 * restore-import runs after a restore, as the migrator, in one transaction, with the keeper's files concatenated on
 * standard input, oldest first: every file from the one that holds the restored head's place onward. It checks every
 * line with the chain's canonical text in this program's own code (staff/chain.ts) and nothing of the database's; the
 * lines at or below the restored head are checked and not imported, and the run above it must continue the head. A
 * changed line refuses everything (tail_not_continuous); a hole is reported, and the unbroken run from the head is
 * imported. It writes again the plain records the lost rows describe, with their original times and an imported mark,
 * and one row of restore_gaps for every lost decision and every lost record it can only note; never a decision or a
 * measure: a person takes each lost measure again, under a key, from the console's After a restore screen.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AuditExportLine, GAP_CLASSES, GAP_SITE_CLASSES, MEASURES, type ActionKind, type GapClass } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { insertOrder, postLink, type NewOrderItem } from "../moderation";
import { CHAIN_ZERO_HASH, appendAuditRow, canonicalText, chainHash, exportLines } from "../staff";
import { Refusal, isoOf, refuse, rows } from "./orders";

/** The recovery commands, each with its first line of STAFF_USAGE. */
export const RESTORE_COMMANDS = ["audit-export", "restore-import"] as const;
export type RestoreCommandName = (typeof RESTORE_COMMANDS)[number];

export const RESTORE_USAGE = [
  "  audit-export [--after <place>]         print the audit log's rows after the place (after the command line's own last copy",
  "                                         when left out) as JSON lines, and record the copy; run it in the api service",
  "  restore-import [<place>:<hash> ...] < files   after a restore: check the keeper's files, oldest first, against the restored",
  "                                         head, write the lost records again and list the gaps; as the migrator, with -T",
];

/** A place as the keeper copies it, as audit-verify takes it: at most 15 digits and a lower-case hex sha256. */
const KEPT_PLACE = /^([1-9][0-9]{0,14}):([0-9a-f]{64})$/;
const PLACE = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})$/;

export type RestoreCommand = { command: "audit-export"; after: number | null } | { command: "restore-import"; kept: { seq: number; hash: string }[] };

/** Reads a recovery command's words. */
export function parseRestoreArgs(command: RestoreCommandName, rest: readonly string[]): RestoreCommand {
  if (command === "audit-export") {
    if (rest.length === 0) return { command, after: null };
    if (rest.length === 2 && rest[0] === "--after" && PLACE.test(rest[1]!)) return { command, after: Number(rest[1]) };
    throw new Error(`audit-export: takes --after <place>, a place as audit-head prints it`);
  }
  return {
    command,
    kept: rest.map((arg) => {
      const match = KEPT_PLACE.exec(arg);
      if (!match) throw new Error(`restore-import: not a kept place: ${arg} (a kept place is <chain_seq>:<hash>, as audit-head prints it)`);
      return { seq: Number(match[1]), hash: match[2]! };
    }),
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- audit-export

/** What audit-export did: the places it printed and how many rows, or nothing newer. */
export type ExportDone = { from: number; to: number; rows: number } | { from: null; to: null; rows: 0 };

/**
 * audit-export (7.16 step 5, 8.11) on the API's role: the rows after `after` (the command line's own newest copy mark, or
 * 0, when none is given) up to the head as it stands when the command starts, each as one JSON line handed to `write`,
 * oldest first; then, once every line is written, one transaction with the copy mark under the system actor and the
 * audit row copy_marked, last. Nothing newer writes nothing.
 */
export async function auditExport(apiDb: Db, after: number | null, write: (line: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<ExportDone> {
  const [head] = await rows<{ seq: string }>(apiDb, sql`select h.seq::text as seq from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1`);
  const through = Number(head?.seq ?? 0);
  const [own] = await rows<{ place: string }>(apiDb, sql`select m.place::text as place from public.copy_marks m where m.staff_id = ${SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID}::uuid order by m.at desc, m.id desc limit 1`);
  const start = after ?? Number(own?.place ?? 0);
  if (through <= start) return { from: null, to: null, rows: 0 };
  let count = 0;
  for await (const line of exportLines(apiDb, start, through)) {
    await write(JSON.stringify(line));
    count++;
  }
  await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    // The API role inserts these two columns alone; the trigger forces the mark's time.
    await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID}::uuid, ${through}::bigint)`);
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "copy_marked", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { after: start, through, rows: count } });
  });
  return { from: start + 1, to: through, rows: count };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- restore-import: the lines

/** A line of the keeper's files, read, with its line number on standard input and its metadata as parsed. */
interface TailLine {
  n: number;
  line: AuditExportLine;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/** Every line refused for the same sentence: a changed file, never a missing one. */
const refused = (n: number, head: { seq: number; hash: string }): never => {
  throw new Refusal(`restore-import: refused: line ${n} does not continue the restored head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}; nothing was written`);
};

/**
 * Reads the input's lines (blank lines are skipped) and checks each by itself: it is an AuditExportLine, and its hash
 * recomputes from its own members with the canonical text and the line's prevHash. A line that fails either is a changed
 * file, refused whole. A line repeated exactly (two downloads that overlap) is read once; a place read twice with two
 * hashes is a changed file.
 */
export function readTail(input: Buffer, head: { seq: number; hash: string }): TailLine[] {
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const lines: TailLine[] = [];
  const byPlace = new Map<number, string>();
  const text = input.toString("utf8").split(LF);
  for (const [index, raw] of text.entries()) {
    if (raw.trim() === "") continue;
    const n = index + 1;
    let parsed: AuditExportLine;
    let metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      parsed = AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(raw));
      metadata = JSON.parse(parsed.metadata) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const recomputed = chainHash(
        parsed.prevHash,
        canonicalText({
          chainVersion: parsed.v,
          chainSeq: parsed.place,
          id: parsed.id,
          createdAt: new Date(parsed.at),
          actorId: parsed.actor,
          action: parsed.action,
          targetType: parsed.targetType,
          targetId: parsed.targetId,
          requestId: parsed.requestId,
          staffSession: parsed.staffSession,
          keyId: parsed.keyId,
          actionHash: parsed.actionHash,
          stepUpText: parsed.stepUp,
          metadataText: parsed.metadata,
        }),
      );
      // A time that does not print back as it was written would hash another text: the line was changed.
      if (recomputed !== parsed.hash || new Date(parsed.at).toISOString() !== parsed.at) return refused(n, head);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Refusal) throw err;
      return refused(n, head);
    }
    const seen = byPlace.get(parsed.place);
    if (seen !== undefined) {
      if (seen !== parsed.hash) return refused(n, head);
      continue;
    }
    byPlace.set(parsed.place, parsed.hash);
    lines.push({ n, line: parsed, metadata });
  }
  return lines;
}

/** What the walk found: the lines checked below the head, the run to import, and the hole that ends it, if any. */
export interface Walked {
  checked: number;
  run: TailLine[];
  hole: { after: number; before: number } | null;
}

/**
 * The walk of 7.17 step 2.1 over lines in input order. Every line names the line before it where that line is in the
 * input (a line at the next place with another prevHash, or a line at a place not after the one before, is a changed
 * file); the line at the head's place holds the head's hash; a kept place the input holds holds the hash the keeper
 * noted. Above the head the first line must be the head's next place and name the head's hash (input that begins
 * above that is refused: the lost rows cannot be downloaded again); the run stops at the first line whose place is not
 * the next one, which is the hole the import reports.
 */
export function walkTail(lines: readonly TailLine[], head: { seq: number; hash: string }, kept: readonly { seq: number; hash: string }[]): Walked {
  for (const place of kept) {
    const found = lines.find((entry) => entry.line.place === place.seq);
    if (found !== undefined && found.line.hash !== place.hash) refused(found.n, head);
  }
  let checked = 0;
  const run: TailLine[] = [];
  let hole: Walked["hole"] = null;
  let prev: TailLine | null = null;
  for (const entry of lines) {
    const { line } = entry;
    if (prev !== null) {
      if (line.place <= prev.line.place) refused(entry.n, head);
      if (line.place === prev.line.place + 1 && line.prevHash !== prev.line.hash) refused(entry.n, head);
    }
    if (line.place <= head.seq) {
      if (line.place === head.seq && line.hash !== head.hash) refused(entry.n, head);
      checked++;
    } else if (hole === null) {
      const last = run[run.length - 1];
      if (last === undefined) {
        // The first line above the head continues it, or the input is refused whole.
        if (line.place !== head.seq + 1 || line.prevHash !== (head.seq === 0 ? CHAIN_ZERO_HASH : head.hash)) refused(entry.n, head);
        run.push(entry);
      } else if (line.place === last.line.place + 1) run.push(entry);
      else hole = { after: last.line.place, before: line.place };
    }
    prev = entry;
  }
  return { checked, run, hole };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- restore-import: what a lost row writes again

/** What the import wrote again, for its lines and its audit row. */
interface Counts {
  orders: number;
  items: number;
  events: number;
  notifications: number;
  productions: number;
}

/** One gap as the import wrote it, for the printed list. */
interface WrittenGap {
  class: GapClass;
  place: number;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  actedAt: string;
  open: boolean;
}

/** The class of a lost decision (6.6): by the measures its signed actions hold, and for a seal by the decision's kind. */
export function decisionClass(params: { kind?: unknown; actions?: unknown }): GapClass {
  const kinds = Array.isArray(params.actions) ? params.actions.map((action) => (action as { kind?: unknown }).kind).filter((kind): kind is ActionKind => typeof kind === "string" && kind in MEASURES) : [];
  const measures = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
  if (measures.includes("seal_media")) return params.kind === "interim" ? "seal_interim" : "seal_final";
  if (measures.some((kind) => kind === "suspend" || kind === "terminate")) return "standing";
  if (measures.length > 0) return "restriction";
  if (kinds.length > 0) return "reversal";
  return "no_measure";
}

/** The columns a correction of an order's record changes, by the member names its audit row carries. */
const CORRECTED_COLUMNS: Record<string, string> = {
  kind: "kind",
  memberState: "member_state",
  authority: "authority",
  reference: "reference",
  channel: "channel",
  sectionC: "section_c",
  emergency: "emergency",
  withholdFromAuthor: "withhold_from_author",
  crossBorder: "cross_border",
};

/** The writer of one import, in its transaction: the gaps it writes and what it wrote again. */
class Importer {
  readonly counts: Counts = { orders: 0, items: 0, events: 0, notifications: 0, productions: 0 };
  readonly gaps: WrittenGap[] = [];
  constructor(
    private readonly tx: DbTx,
    private readonly importId: string,
    private readonly appOrigin: string | null,
  ) {}

  /** One gap of the lost row: open for a decision or a record it could only note, closed as imported for one it wrote again. */
  async gap(entry: TailLine, cls: GapClass, open: boolean, target: { type: string | null; id: string | null } = { type: entry.line.targetType, id: entry.line.targetId }): Promise<void> {
    const { line } = entry;
    await this.tx.execute(sql`
      insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
      values (${this.importId}::uuid, ${line.place}::bigint, ${line.hash}, ${line.action}, ${target.type}, ${target.id}, ${line.metadata}::jsonb,
              ${line.at}::timestamptz, now(), ${cls}, ${open ? null : sql`now()`}, ${open ? null : "imported"})`);
    this.gaps.push({ class: cls, place: line.place, targetType: target.type, targetId: target.id, actedAt: line.at, open });
  }

  /** A staff account by its id when the restored database holds its profile, else null: a profile is a foreign key. */
  private async staff(id: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (id === SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID) return null;
    const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select p.id from public.profiles p where p.id = ${id}::uuid`);
    return row?.id ?? null;
  }

  /** Whether the order is there; and, since a lost row of it is written again, its imported_at, which exempts its old events (0031). */
  private async touch(orderId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const touched = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`update public.legal_orders set imported_at = coalesce(imported_at, now()) where id = ${orderId}::uuid returning id`);
    return touched.length > 0;
  }

  /** An item's link as the import writes it: the post's address when the lost row named a post, else the link's digest (6.6). */
  private link(item: Record<string, unknown>): NewOrderItem {
    if (typeof item.postId === "string") {
      if (this.appOrigin === null) refuse("restore-import", "APP_ORIGIN must be set for the migrate service, to write an imported item's address");
      return { link: postLink(this.appOrigin!, item.postId), postId: item.postId };
    }
    return { link: `sha256:${String(item.linkSha256)}`, postId: null };
  }

  /** order_opened: the order, its items and its event `opened`, with their original times, through insertOrder; and the event `imported`. */
  async orderOpened(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    const [exists] = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select id from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
    if (exists === undefined) {
      const items = (m.items as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [];
      const messageId = typeof m.messageId === "string" ? ((await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select id from public.contact_messages where id = ${m.messageId}::uuid`))[0]?.id ?? null) : null;
      await insertOrder(this.tx, {
        id: orderId,
        kind: m.kind as never,
        memberState: String(m.memberState),
        authority: String(m.authority),
        reference: String(m.reference),
        channel: m.channel as never,
        messageId,
        sectionC: m.sectionC === true,
        emergency: m.emergency === true,
        crossBorder: m.crossBorder === true,
        withholdFromAuthor: m.withholdFromAuthor === true,
        openedBy: await this.staff(entry.line.actor),
        items: items.map((item) => this.link(item)),
        imported: {
          openedAt: new Date(String(m.openedAt)),
          openedVia: m.via === "cli" ? "cli" : "console",
          receivedAt: typeof m.receivedAt === "string" ? new Date(m.receivedAt) : null,
          sentAt: typeof m.sentAt === "string" ? new Date(m.sentAt) : null,
          items: items.map((item) => ({ id: String(item.itemId), position: Number(item.position), addedAt: new Date(String(item.addedAt)) })),
        },
      });
      await this.tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, via) values (${orderId}::uuid, 'imported', now(), 'cli')`);
      this.counts.orders++;
      this.counts.items += items.length;
      this.counts.events += 2;
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** order_items_added: the items, with their own ids, positions and times. */
  async itemsAdded(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      for (const item of (entry.metadata.items as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? []) {
        const { link, postId } = this.link(item);
        await this.tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id, added_at)
          values (${String(item.itemId)}::uuid, ${orderId}::uuid, ${Number(item.position)}::smallint, ${link}, ${postId}::uuid, ${String(item.addedAt)}::timestamptz)
          on conflict do nothing`);
        this.counts.items++;
      }
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /**
   * order_corrected: the changed members' new values in one update (the CHECKs hold at each row update, as order_correct
   * writes them), with the withholding and the preservation the order's kind forces; the items it closed; its event.
   */
  async corrected(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const changed = (m.changed as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [];
      const to = (member: string) => changed.find((change) => change.member === member)?.to ?? null;
      // The withholding and the preservation are written in the same statement, from the new values: the CHECK on a
      // removal order holds at each row update, and a column may be set once in one statement.
      const sets = changed
        .filter((change) => typeof change.member === "string" && change.member in CORRECTED_COLUMNS && change.member !== "withholdFromAuthor")
        .map((change) => sql`${sql.raw(CORRECTED_COLUMNS[change.member as string]!)} = ${change.to as string | boolean}`);
      const kind = sql`coalesce(${to("kind") as string | null}::text, kind)`;
      await this.tx.execute(sql`
        update public.legal_orders
           set ${sets.length > 0 ? sql`${sql.join(sets, sql`, `)}, ` : sql``}
               withhold_from_author = coalesce(${to("withholdFromAuthor") as boolean | null}::boolean, withhold_from_author) or ${kind} = 'tco_removal'
                                      or coalesce(${to("sectionC") as boolean | null}::boolean, section_c),
               preserve = ${kind} = 'tco_removal'
         where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      for (const change of changed.filter((entry) => entry.member === "closeItems")) {
        await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set closed_at = ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz, closed_reason = ${String(change.reason)}
                                   where id = ${String(change.itemId)}::uuid and order_id = ${orderId}::uuid and disabled_at is null`);
      }
      await this.event(orderId, { id: typeof m.eventId === "string" ? m.eventId : null, kind: "corrected", ground: String(m.rule), at: entry.line.at, by: await this.staff(entry.line.actor), via: "console" });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** order_event_recorded: the console's event, and what it set on the order (a closing, a reopening, the extension). */
  async consoleEvent(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const params = (m.params as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const kind = String(params.kind);
      if (kind === "closed_without_effect") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      if (kind === "reopened") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = null where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      if (kind === "hold_extended") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_extended = true where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      await this.event(orderId, {
        id: typeof m.eventId === "string" ? m.eventId : null,
        kind,
        ground: typeof params.ground === "string" ? params.ground : null,
        at: entry.line.at,
        effectiveAt: typeof m.effectiveAt === "string" ? m.effectiveAt : null,
        by: await this.staff(entry.line.actor),
        via: "console",
      });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** One event of an order with its original time, as the migrator, whose insert the trigger does not force. */
  private async event(orderId: string, e: { id: string | null; kind: string; ground: string | null; at: string; effectiveAt?: string | null; by: string | null; via: string; itemId?: string | null }): Promise<void> {
    await this.tx.execute(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_events (id, order_id, item_id, kind, at, effective_at, ground, by_staff, via)
      values (coalesce(${e.id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), ${orderId}::uuid, ${e.itemId ?? null}::uuid, ${e.kind}, ${e.at}::timestamptz, ${e.effectiveAt ?? null}::timestamptz,
              ${e.ground}, ${e.by}::uuid, ${e.via})
      on conflict do nothing`);
    this.counts.events++;
  }

  /**
   * order_recorded: a command line's event, with what the command set on the order, from the facts its audit row holds.
   * A text the command recorded (the reasons, the remedies, the scope, how a check was made, a hold's basis) is named
   * there by its digest alone and stays lost: its event is written, its column is not.
   */
  async cliEvent(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    const at = entry.line.at;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const set = (assignments: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set ${assignments} where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      const time = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : null);
      const event = String(m.event);
      let ground: string | null = null;
      let effectiveAt: string | null = null;
      let itemId: string | null = null;
      switch (event) {
        case "received_set":
          await set(sql`received_at = ${time(m.receivedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "sent_at_set":
          await set(sql`sent_at = ${time(m.sentAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "due_set":
          await set(sql`due_at = ${time(m.dueAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "verified":
          await set(sql`verified_at = ${time(m.verifiedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "issued_at_set":
          await set(sql`issued_at = ${time(m.issuedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "document_recorded":
          await set(sql`document_sha256 = ${String(m.documentSha256)}, document_bytes = ${Number(m.documentBytes)}::bigint`);
          break;
        case "reopened":
          await set(sql`closed_at = null`);
          break;
        case "tell_person_set":
          await set(sql`tell_person = ${String(m.rule)}, tell_person_at = ${time(m.at)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "hold_until_set":
          await set(sql`authority_hold_until = ${time(m.until)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "hold_extended":
          await set(sql`hold_extended = true`);
          effectiveAt = time(m.received);
          break;
        case "hold_ended":
          ground = String(m.reason);
          await set(sql`hold_ended_at = ${at}::timestamptz, hold_end_reason = ${ground}`);
          break;
        case "scrutiny_requested":
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "scrutiny_decided":
          ground = String(m.outcome);
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "person_told":
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "preservation_extended":
          itemId = String(m.itemId);
          await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_until = ${time(m.until)}::timestamptz where id = ${itemId}::uuid and order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
          break;
      }
      await this.event(orderId, { id: null, kind: event, ground, at, effectiveAt, by: null, via: "cli", itemId });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /**
   * order_effected: one gap of the class order_effect an item, and each item's first disabling and preservation as the
   * lost row dates them (LAB F): an item whose preservation never ended keeps preserve_until, so its post is frozen at once,
   * before any measure is back, and the disabling taken again starts no new period. No decision, no measure.
   */
  async effected(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const decisionIds = (entry.metadata.decisionIds as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
    for (const itemId of Object.keys(decisionIds).sort()) {
      await this.tx.execute(sql`
        update public.legal_order_items i
           set disabled_at = coalesce(i.disabled_at, ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz),
               preserve_until = case when o.preserve and i.preserve_ended_at is null then coalesce(i.preserve_until, public.order_preserve_until(${entry.line.at}::timestamptz)) else i.preserve_until end
          from public.legal_orders o
         where o.id = i.order_id and i.id = ${itemId}::uuid and i.action_id is null`);
      await this.gap(entry, "order_effect", true, { type: "order_item", id: itemId });
    }
  }

  /** case_decided and appeals_reviewed: one open gap, of the class the lost decision's signed actions give it. */
  async decided(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, decisionClass((entry.metadata.params as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {}), true);
  }

  /**
   * notification_recorded: the step `opened` writes the record again, owed, with its original opening and imported_at,
   * its case, its seal and its duties, and its account as the restored case names it; every later step (sent, declined,
   * answered, event), whose row holds too little to write it (an authority, a channel, a reason), is a gap of the class
   * record, which the operator closes by entering it again with its command and --gap.
   */
  async notification(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    if (m.step !== "opened") return this.gap(entry, "record", true);
    const caseId = typeof m.caseId === "string" ? m.caseId : null;
    const seal = typeof m.sealActionId === "string" ? m.sealActionId : null;
    const duties = Array.isArray(m.duties) ? (m.duties as string[]) : [];
    const written = await rows<{ id: string }>(
      this.tx,
      sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (id, state, duties, case_id, seal_action_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at)
          select ${entry.line.targetId}::uuid, 'owed', ${`{${duties.join(",")}}`}::text[], ${caseId}::uuid, ${seal}::uuid,
                 (select case when k.target_type = 'account' then k.target_id else (select p.author_id from public.posts p where p.id = k.target_id) end
                    from public.cases k where k.id = ${caseId}::uuid),
                 ${typeof m.at === "string" ? m.at : entry.line.at}::timestamptz, ${seal === null ? "cli" : "system"}, now()
          on conflict do nothing
          returning id`,
    );
    this.counts.notifications += written.length;
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** A production, or an access for an authority, which the import can only note: a gap of the class record. */
  async noted(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, "record", true);
  }

  /**
   * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 6.2 and 7.3 step 1): a lost release of a seal is a gap of the class release, which
   * staff.js release-replay closes: the restored database again treats its images as sealed and kept.
   */
  async released(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }

  /**
   * A lost leave (release_leave_recorded): a gap of the class release, which release-leave --gap closes when the operator
   * records it again, under the id its line names; none for a leave that a later line of the copy withdraws (it supported
   * no release), and none where the restored database holds the leave as the line records it (nothing was lost). A line
   * that ended an open hold on telling of a leave the database holds is a gap that release-leave --end-untold --gap closes.
   */
  async leaveRecorded(entry: TailLine, withdrawnLater: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<void> {
    const leaveId = entry.metadata.leaveId;
    if (typeof leaveId !== "string" || withdrawnLater.has(leaveId)) return;
    const [held] = await rows<{ until: string | null }>(this.tx, sql`select ${isoOf("l.untold_until")} as until from public.release_leaves l where l.id = ${leaveId}::uuid`);
    if (held !== undefined && held.until === (entry.metadata.untoldUntil ?? null)) return;
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }

  /**
   * A lost withdrawal of a leave (release_leave_withdrawn): a gap of the class release only where the restored database
   * holds the leave and shows it standing, which release-leave --withdraw --gap closes; a leave it does not hold supported
   * no release and is not recorded again.
   */
  async leaveWithdrawn(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const leaveId = entry.metadata.leaveId;
    if (typeof leaveId !== "string") return;
    const [held] = await rows<{ withdrawn: boolean }>(this.tx, sql`select l.withdrawn_at is not null as withdrawn from public.release_leaves l where l.id = ${leaveId}::uuid`);
    if (held === undefined || held.withdrawn) return;
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }
}

/** Runs one lost row through the importer, by its action; a row that describes neither a record nor a decision writes nothing. */
async function importLine(importer: Importer, entry: TailLine, withdrawnLater: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<void> {
  switch (entry.line.action) {
    // 3d Task 2: a release of a seal, a leave recorded and a leave withdrawn, each a gap of the class release.
    case "seal_released":
      return importer.released(entry);
    case "release_leave_recorded":
      return importer.leaveRecorded(entry, withdrawnLater);
    case "release_leave_withdrawn":
      return importer.leaveWithdrawn(entry);
    case "order_opened":
      return importer.orderOpened(entry);
    case "order_items_added":
      return importer.itemsAdded(entry);
    case "order_corrected":
      return importer.corrected(entry);
    case "order_event_recorded":
      return importer.consoleEvent(entry);
    case "order_recorded":
      return importer.cliEvent(entry);
    case "order_effected":
      return importer.effected(entry);
    case "case_decided":
    case "appeals_reviewed":
      return importer.decided(entry);
    case "notification_recorded":
      return importer.notification(entry);
    case "production_recorded":
      return importer.noted(entry);
    case "preserved_accessed":
      // An access for an authority opened a production of its own (Task 5); an access for a review or a complaint did not.
      if (typeof entry.metadata.productionId === "string") return importer.noted(entry);
      return;
    default:
      // A sign-in, a key's or a session's row, a retention round, a copy, a message closed, a reveal: no record of 3f and
      // no measure. The mailbox and the operator's notes are their record.
      return;
  }
}

/** What restore-import reports: its lines on standard output, or its one sentence of refusal. */
export type ImportDone = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * restore-import (7.17 step 2, 8.11), as the migrator, in one transaction with the 10-second lock timeout: reads the
 * restored head, checks the input (readTail, walkTail), writes again what the unbroken run from the head describes and the
 * gaps, and last the audit row restore_imported under the system actor, with the first and last places, the counts by
 * class, the hole and the SHA-256 of the input as given (the files arrive concatenated, so one digest names them all).
 */
export async function restoreImport(migrateDb: Db, kept: readonly { seq: number; hash: string }[], input: Buffer, appOrigin: string | null): Promise<ImportDone> {
  const c = "restore-import";
  try {
    const lines = await migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      const [row] = await rows<{ seq: string; hash: string }>(tx, sql`select h.seq::text as seq, h.hash from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1`);
      const head = { seq: Number(row!.seq), hash: row!.hash };
      const walked = walkTail(readTail(input, head), head, kept);
      const importer = new Importer(tx, randomUUID(), appOrigin);
      // 3d Task 2: a leave that a later line of the copy withdraws gets no gap: it supported no release.
      const withdrawnLater = new Set(walked.run.filter((entry) => entry.line.action === "release_leave_withdrawn").map((entry) => String(entry.metadata.leaveId)));
      for (const entry of walked.run) await importLine(importer, entry, withdrawnLater);
      const first = walked.run[0]?.line.place ?? null;
      const last = walked.run[walked.run.length - 1]?.line.place ?? null;
      const byClass = Object.fromEntries(GAP_CLASSES.map((cls) => [cls, importer.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.class === cls).length]).filter(([, n]) => (n as number) > 0));
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
        action: "restore_imported",
        targetType: null,
        targetId: null,
        requestId: null,
        metadata: {
          firstPlace: first,
          lastPlace: last,
          counts: byClass,
          holes: walked.hole === null ? [] : [[walked.hole.after, walked.hole.before]],
          files: [createHash("sha256").update(input).digest("hex")],
        },
      });
      return describeImport(c, head, walked, importer, lastLineAt(input));
    });
    return { ok: true, lines };
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Refusal) return { ok: false, problem: err.message };
    throw err;
  }
}

/** The time of the input's last line: the keeper's last download, after which nothing is in these files. */
function lastLineAt(input: Buffer): string | null {
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const text = input.toString("utf8").split(LF).filter((line) => line.trim() !== "");
  try {
    return text.length === 0 ? null : (AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(text[text.length - 1]!)).at as string);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The lines 8.11 prints after an import: what continued the head, what was written again, the gaps in their order, what to do. */
function describeImport(c: string, head: { seq: number; hash: string }, walked: Walked, importer: Importer, lastAt: string | null): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const first = walked.run[0]?.line.place;
  const last = walked.run[walked.run.length - 1]?.line.place;
  out.push(
    first === undefined
      ? `${c}: the files hold nothing after the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} (${walked.checked} earlier lines checked, not imported).`
      : `${c}: places ${first} to ${last} continue the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} (${walked.checked} earlier lines checked, not imported).`,
  );
  const n = importer.counts;
  out.push(`${c}: written again: ${n.orders} orders, ${n.items} items, ${n.events} events, ${n.notifications} notification records, ${n.productions} productions.`);
  const open = importer.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.open).sort((a, b) => GAP_CLASSES.indexOf(a.class) - GAP_CLASSES.indexOf(b.class) || Date.parse(a.actedAt) - Date.parse(b.actedAt) || a.place - b.place);
  out.push(`${c}: gaps, in the order to take them again:`);
  for (const [index, gap] of open.entries()) out.push(`${c}: ${index + 1}. ${gap.class}, ${gap.targetType ?? "no target"} ${gap.targetId ?? ""}`.trimEnd() + `, first done ${gap.actedAt}`);
  if (open.length === 0) out.push(`${c}: none.`);
  const site = open.filter((gap) => GAP_SITE_CLASSES.includes(gap.class)).length;
  out.push(
    site > 0
      ? `${c}: The app's site stays closed until gaps 1 to ${site} are closed on the console's After a restore screen.`
      : `${c}: No order disabling and no seal was lost: the app's site may open once the operator has read the rest.`,
  );
  out.push(`${c}: Not in these files: anything after ${lastAt ?? "the head"}, the keeper's last download. Compare the contact-point mailbox since then with the orders above; open what is missing with order-open.`);
  if (walked.hole !== null) out.push(`${c}: the files hold nothing between place ${walked.hole.after} and place ${walked.hole.before}: what happened there is not imported`);
  return out;
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/cli/staff-cases.ts` (whole file)

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13): link, unlink, limits, text-verify
 * and access-request (3f's notification-facts, in records.ts, replaces account-facts). staff.ts parses their arguments,
 * reads their settings and opens their connections;
 * this file holds what each does, over the connections it is handed. Each sets the 10-second lock timeout in every
 * transaction it opens, writes its audit row in the transaction of its change and as that transaction's last statement
 * (the insert holds the chain's head until the commit), and says so when it changed nothing it was asked to.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { ALERT_KINDS, MEASURE_KINDS, snapshotDigest, textDigest, type SnapshotDigestInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { moderationLimits, profiles, staffPersonalAccounts, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { imageModerationStates, releasedUnerased } from "../media";
import { accessDraftForAccount, accessDraftForContacts, type AccountAccessDraft, type ContactsAccessDraft } from "../moderation";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";

/** What a command reads and writes through: its own connection, or a transaction a test hands in. */
type Runner = Db | DbTx;

const rowsOf = async <T>(q: Runner, query: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<T[]> => (await q.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];
const uuidArray = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

/** Runs `change` in a transaction that waits at most 10 seconds for a lock, as every staff command waits. */
function changing<T>(db: Runner, change: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    return change(tx);
  });
}

/** A handle as the operator types it, with or without its at sign, in the lower case the profiles hold. */
export const handleArg = (arg: string): string => arg.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- link and unlink

export type Changed = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * Records, or with `remove` takes back, that a personal account is a staff member's own (the recusal check of 3c reads
 * the links; no API role can). As the migrator, in one transaction: the staff account's row and the personal account's
 * are locked FOR SHARE, so neither can be promoted, demoted or taken down under the check; a link is recorded only for
 * a live staff account and a live account that is not staff. The audit row names the staff account and nothing of the
 * link, which must not spread.
 */
export async function changeLink(migrateDb: Runner, staffEmail: string, personalHandle: string, remove: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(personalHandle);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [staff] = await tx
      .select({ id: users.id, role: users.role })
      .from(users)
      .where(and(sql`lower(${users.email}) = lower(${staffEmail})`, isNull(users.deletedAt)))
      .limit(1)
      .for("share");
    if (!staff) return { ok: false, problem: `no live account for ${staffEmail}` };
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    if (remove) {
      const gone = await tx.delete(staffPersonalAccounts).where(and(eq(staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId, staff.id), eq(staffPersonalAccounts.personalUserId, profile.id))).returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
      if (gone.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
      await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_removed", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
      return { ok: true, lines: [`unlink: @${handle} is no longer linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
    }
    if (staff.role === "user") return { ok: false, problem: `${staffEmail} is not staff (its role is user)` };
    const [personal] = await tx.select({ id: users.id, role: users.role, deletedAt: users.deletedAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1).for("share");
    if (!personal || personal.deletedAt !== null) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not a live account` };
    if (personal.id === staff.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is the staff account itself, which is always a party where it is one` };
    if (personal.role !== "user") return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is a staff account (its role is ${personal.role}); only a personal account is linked` };
    const added = await tx.insert(staffPersonalAccounts).values({ staffUserId: staff.id, personalUserId: personal.id }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
    if (added.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is already linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_added", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`link: @${handle} is linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- limits

/** The five limits on staff, in the order the command takes them. */
export interface StaffLimits {
  decisionsPerHour: number;
  decisionsPerDay: number;
  caseOpensPerDay: number;
  findingsPerDay: number;
  revealsPerDay: number;
}

const describeLimits = (l: StaffLimits) => `${l.decisionsPerHour} decisions an hour, ${l.decisionsPerDay} decisions a day, ${l.caseOpensPerDay} case opens a day, ${l.findingsPerDay} findings a day, ${l.revealsPerDay} reveals a day`;

/**
 * Sets the limits' one row, as the migrator: an upsert, so it also works on a database whose row is missing, that
 * changes the row only when one of the five numbers differs. Its audit row carries the five numbers and is written only
 * when the row was inserted or changed.
 */
export async function setLimits(migrateDb: Runner, limits: StaffLimits): Promise<Changed> {
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const l = moderationLimits;
    const written = await tx
      .insert(l)
      .values({ id: 1, ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: l.id,
        set: { ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` },
        setWhere: sql`(${l.decisionsPerHour}, ${l.decisionsPerDay}, ${l.caseOpensPerDay}, ${l.findingsPerDay}, ${l.revealsPerDay}) is distinct from
                      (${limits.decisionsPerHour}::int, ${limits.decisionsPerDay}::int, ${limits.caseOpensPerDay}::int, ${limits.findingsPerDay}::int, ${limits.revealsPerDay}::int)`,
      })
      .returning({ id: l.id });
    if (written.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `the limits already are ${describeLimits(limits)}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "moderation_limits_set", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { ...limits } });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`limits: set to ${describeLimits(limits)}. Keep these numbers in your own records: a restore brings back the ones of its backup.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- alert-test

/**
 * 3f's review (operations6): alert-test [--on-call], the test push that the runbook's hand-over of the on-call phone and
 * its upgrade of ntfy ask for, since nobody on call can publish: the phones only subscribe. One alert_test row, to every
 * staff phone or (--on-call) to the phone on call alone, with its time, which the watcher publishes at its next round,
 * and the audit row alert_test_sent with the scope. A row of this kind is pushed only and never mailed.
 */
export async function alertTest(migrateDb: Runner, onCall: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const scope = onCall ? "on_call" : "all";
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts)
                         values ('alert_test', ${ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.priority}, ${scope}, jsonb_build_object('at', public.alert_time(now())))`);
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "alert_test_sent", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { scope } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      lines: [`alert-test: a test push to ${onCall ? "the phone on call" : "every staff phone"} is owed; the watcher publishes it at its next round, within a minute. If it does not ring, look at the console's home screen and tell the operator.`],
    };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- access-request

/**
 * Drafts the moderation part of an answer to a GDPR access request and records that it did, on the API role: for a
 * handle the account's cases and its own reports, for an address the notices of the contacts the auth module found for
 * it (`contactsOf`, which alone can read a contact). The audit row carries counts only, and names the account for a
 * handle and nobody for an address.
 */
export async function accessRequest(
  apiDb: Runner,
  appOrigin: string,
  who: { handle: string } | { email: string },
  contactsOf: (email: string) => Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]>,
  // 3f (W.8): for a handle, which of its cases an authority asked to keep from the person, read as the migrator.
  authorityHolds?: (caseIds: readonly string[]) => Promise<Map<string, string | null>>,
): Promise<{ ok: true; draft: AccountAccessDraft | ContactsAccessDraft } | { ok: false; problem: string }> {
  if ("handle" in who) {
    const handle = handleArg(who.handle);
    const [profile] = await apiDb.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const draft = await accessDraftForAccount(apiDb, appOrigin, profile, authorityHolds);
    await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: draft.cases.length, contacts: 0 } }));
    return { ok: true, draft };
  }
  const contacts = await contactsOf(who.email);
  const draft = await accessDraftForContacts(apiDb, appOrigin, contacts);
  await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: 0, contacts: contacts.length } }));
  return { ok: true, draft };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- text-verify

/** One thing text-verify found wrong, and what it is about: an audit row by its place, or a decision, a post, an image or a seal by its id. */
export interface TextProblem {
  about: "audit" | "decision" | "post" | "image" | "seal" | "order" | "gap";
  id: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface TextReport {
  ok: boolean;
  /** The confirmed rows read, and the decisions, posts, images and seals in force checked. */
  auditRows: number;
  decisions: number;
  posts: number;
  images: number;
  seals: number;
  /** The first problems, in the order found. */
  problems: TextProblem[];
  problemCount: number;
}

/** How many rows text-verify reads at a time. */
export const TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const PAGE = TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;

/** The actions whose params name saved texts and snapshots by their digests. */
const CONFIRMED_ACTIONS = ["case_decided", "appeals_reviewed", "identity_revealed", "order_effected"];
/** The params members that name a saved text. */
const TEXT_MEMBERS = ["factsDigest", "reasonDigest", "legalReferenceDigest"];

interface NamingRow {
  place: number;
  action: string;
  actorId: string;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  params: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** 3f: for an order_effected row, the order's item under which its decisionIds name the decision. */
  itemId?: string;
}

const isObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
/** An action as the key signed it and as the ledger holds it: its kind, its image, and (3e) the days and whether it was announced. */
const actionKey = (action: { kind: unknown; mediaId: unknown; days?: unknown; announced?: unknown }) =>
  [action.kind, action.mediaId, action.days, action.announced].map((part) => (part === null || part === undefined ? "" : String(part))).join(":");

/**
 * text-verify (3c design, section 7.13), read-only on the API's role. audit-verify proves that the record was not
 * rewritten; this proves that what the record's confirmed rows name is still what korbat holds, and that what posts and
 * images show is what the record says. Three checks, each in this command's own code:
 *
 *   1. Every digest in the params of a confirmed row (a decision, a review, a reveal) names a saved text that korbat
 *      still holds and that recomputes to it, an erased text, a snapshot still held that recomputes to it, or an erased
 *      snapshot. A text or a snapshot that is missing was removed around the erasures, which keep each row and its digest.
 *   2. Every decision is named by exactly one such row, written by the deciding account on the decision's case (for a
 *      review, on the reviewed decision), whose params equal the decision's own columns and whose actions equal its
 *      ledger rows as a set (3e: with each row's days and whether it was announced; the marks the decision set equal the
 *      params' `unfounded`, and a withdrawal for another measure its `replaced`). A signed mark that korbat's own rules
 *      deleted is no difference: its report was sent on a UTC day before the frame of the reporting counts (the
 *      retention job's step), or korbat no longer knows who sent the report (the sender's account was purged, which
 *      deletes its marks; an intake whose record was erased also forgets its sender, so a mark deleted by hand from such
 *      a report is not told apart). A row that names a decision korbat does not hold is reported too.
 *   3. Every post's level and every image's state equal what the ledger of measures gives, worked out here from the
 *      ledger's rows, the cases' closures, the items and the erasure marks, as the database's own writer derives them;
 *      and every post a seal in force lists still has the number of image rows the seal recorded.
 *
 * So a change made around the triggers, by the migrator or by hand, is reported: a decision or a measure altered or
 * removed, a level or a state set, a sealed image row destroyed or lost in a restore. `keep` bounds the problems kept.
 */
export async function textVerify(q: Runner, keep = 100): Promise<TextReport> {
  const problems: TextProblem[] = [];
  let problemCount = 0;
  const problem = (about: TextProblem["about"], id: string, message: string) => {
    problemCount++;
    if (problems.length < keep) problems.push({ about, id, message });
  };

  // ---- 1. the confirmed rows and what their digests name
  const naming = new Map<string, NamingRow[]>();
  let auditRows = 0;
  for (let after = 0; ; ) {
    const page = await rowsOf<{ id: number; place: number; action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: unknown }>(
      q,
      sql`select id::int as id, chain_seq::int as place, action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from audit_log
           where action = any(${textArray(CONFIRMED_ACTIONS)}) and id > ${after} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    const wanted: { place: number; member: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    const wantedSnapshots: { place: number; id: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    for (const row of page) {
      auditRows++;
      const metadata = isObject(row.metadata) ? row.metadata : {};
      const params = isObject(metadata.params) ? metadata.params : null;
      if (params === null) {
        problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, carries no params`);
        continue;
      }
      for (const member of TEXT_MEMBERS) if (typeof params[member] === "string") wanted.push({ place: row.place, member, digest: params[member] });
      if (typeof params.snapshotId === "string" && typeof params.snapshotDigest === "string") wantedSnapshots.push({ place: row.place, id: params.snapshotId, digest: params.snapshotDigest });
      if (row.action === "order_effected") {
        // 3f: one row names up to ten order decisions, each under its item (metadata.decisionIds).
        const named = isObject(metadata.decisionIds) ? Object.entries(metadata.decisionIds) : [];
        if (named.length === 0) problem("audit", String(row.place), "its action, order_effected, names no decision");
        for (const [itemId, decisionId] of named) {
          if (typeof decisionId !== "string") continue;
          naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params, itemId }]);
        }
      } else if (row.action !== "identity_revealed") {
        const decisionId = typeof metadata.decisionId === "string" ? metadata.decisionId : null;
        if (decisionId === null) problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, names no decision`);
        else naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params }]);
      }
    }
    if (wanted.length > 0) {
      const texts = await rowsOf<{ digest: string; text: string | null; salt: string | null }>(q, sql`select digest, text, salt from staff_texts where digest = any(${textArray([...new Set(wanted.map((w) => w.digest))])})`);
      const byDigest = new Map(texts.map((t) => [t.digest, t]));
      for (const w of wanted) {
        const held = byDigest.get(w.digest);
        if (!held) problem("audit", String(w.place), `its ${w.member} names no saved text`);
        // An erased text keeps its row and its digest: that is retention at work, and nothing to report.
        else if (held.text !== null && (held.salt === null || (await textDigest(held.salt, held.text).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest)) problem("audit", String(w.place), `the text its ${w.member} names no longer recomputes to that digest`);
      }
    }
    if (wantedSnapshots.length > 0) {
      const found = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { id: string; digest: string; erased: boolean }>(
        q,
        sql`select id, digest, erased_at is not null as erased, salt, target_type::text as target_type, target_id,
                   to_char(taken_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as taken_at, author_handle, post_state::text as post_state,
                   to_char(post_created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as post_created_at, reply_to_id, quote_of_id, body, media, display_name, bio, handle
              from evidence_snapshots where id = any(${uuidArray([...new Set(wantedSnapshots.map((w) => w.id))])})`,
      );
      const byId = new Map(found.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      for (const w of wantedSnapshots) {
        const s = byId.get(w.id);
        if (!s) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotId names no snapshot");
        else if (s.digest !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotDigest is not the digest of the snapshot it names");
        else if (!s.erased) {
          const input = { salt: s.salt, targetType: s.target_type, targetId: s.target_id, takenAt: s.taken_at, authorHandle: s.author_handle, postState: s.post_state, postCreatedAt: s.post_created_at, replyToId: s.reply_to_id, quoteOfId: s.quote_of_id, body: s.body, media: s.media, displayName: s.display_name, bio: s.bio, handle: s.handle } as unknown as SnapshotDigestInput;
          if ((await snapshotDigest(input).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest");
        }
      }
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  // ---- 2. every decision against the one row that names it
  let decisions = 0;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; d: Record<string, unknown>; actions: { kind: string; mediaId: string | null; days: number | null; announced: boolean | null }[]; marks: string[]; forgotten: string[]; replaced: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select d.id, to_jsonb(d) as d,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', a.kind, 'mediaId', a.media_id, 'days', a.days, 'announced', a.announced)) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as actions,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(m.item_id) from unfounded_marks m where m.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as marks,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(i.id) from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id
                            where i.answered_by = d.id
                              and ((n.received_at at time zone 'UTC')::date <= (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - (select k.report_frame_days from standing_rules() k)
                                   or n.reporter_id is null)), '[]'::jsonb) as forgotten,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.replaced) as replaced
            from decisions d where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`d.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by d.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const { id, d, actions, marks, forgotten, replaced } of page) {
      decisions++;
      seen.add(id);
      const named = naming.get(id) ?? [];
      if (named.length !== 1) {
        problem("decision", id, named.length === 0 ? "no confirmed row of the audit log names it" : `${named.length} rows of the audit log name it (places ${named.map((row) => row.place).join(", ")})`);
        continue;
      }
      const row = named[0]!;
      if (d.kind === "order") {
        // 3f (section 8.11): an order decision against its order_effected row: the deciding account, its order, its item,
        // the order's facts as signed (unless an order_corrected row since changed them), and one disable_by_order.
        const [order] = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { corrected: boolean }>(
          q,
          sql`select o.id, o.kind, o.member_state, o.authority, o.reference, o.section_c, o.emergency, o.withhold_from_author,
                     exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action = 'order_corrected' and l.target_id = o.id::text and l.chain_seq > ${row.place}) as corrected
                from legal_order_items i join legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where i.id = ${String(d.order_item_id)}::uuid`,
        );
        const differing: string[] = [];
        if (row.action !== "order_effected") differing.push("action");
        if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
        if (order === undefined || row.targetType !== "order" || row.targetId !== order.id || row.itemId !== d.order_item_id) differing.push("target");
        if (order !== undefined && !order.corrected) {
          const facts = { kind: order.kind, memberState: order.member_state, authority: order.authority, reference: order.reference, sectionC: order.section_c, emergency: order.emergency, withholdFromAuthor: order.withhold_from_author };
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(facts)) if ((row.params[key] ?? null) !== value) differing.push(key);
        }
        if (actions.length !== 1 || actions[0]!.kind !== "disable_by_order") differing.push("actions");
        if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
        continue;
      }
      const review = d.kind === "review";
      const expected: Record<string, unknown> = review
        ? { stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, appealId: d.appeal_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest }
        : {
            kind: d.kind, stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, throughSeq: d.through_seq, reviewsDecisionId: d.reviews_decision_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome,
            ground: d.ground, ruleId: d.rule_id, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, categoryKeyword: d.category_keyword,
            factsDigest: d.facts_digest, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest, legalReferenceDigest: d.legal_reference_digest,
          };
      const differing: string[] = [];
      if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
      if (row.action !== (review ? "appeals_reviewed" : "case_decided") || row.targetType !== (review ? "decision" : "case") || row.targetId !== (review ? d.reviews_decision_id : d.case_id)) differing.push("target");
      for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(expected), ...Object.keys(row.params)])) {
        if (key === "actions" || key === "unfounded" || key === "replaced") continue;
        if ((expected[key] ?? null) !== (row.params[key] ?? null)) differing.push(key);
        if (!(key in expected)) differing.push(key);
      }
      // 3e: the marks the decision set, as the sorted item ids its params signed, and whether it withdrew a suspension for
      // another measure; a review signs neither, and a row signed before 3e lacks both, which reads as none and false.
      if (!review) {
        const signed = row.params.unfounded === undefined ? [] : Array.isArray(row.params.unfounded) ? row.params.unfounded.map(String) : null;
        // 3e Task 7: a signed mark with no row is no difference when korbat's own rules may have deleted it (above).
        const held = new Set(marks);
        const expected = signed?.filter((item) => held.has(item) || !forgotten.includes(item));
        if (expected === undefined || [...expected].sort().join("|") !== [...marks].sort().join("|")) differing.push("unfounded");
        if ((row.params.replaced ?? false) !== replaced) differing.push("replaced");
      }
      const recorded = Array.isArray(row.params.actions) ? row.params.actions.filter(isObject).map((a) => actionKey({ kind: a.kind, mediaId: a.mediaId, days: a.days, announced: a.announced })) : null;
      if (recorded === null || [...recorded].sort().join("|") !== actions.map(actionKey).sort().join("|")) differing.push("actions");
      if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const [decisionId, named] of naming) if (!seen.has(decisionId)) problem("decision", decisionId, `the audit row at place ${named[0]!.place} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`);

  // ---- 3. levels and states, worked out from the ledger
  const measures = MEASURE_KINDS as readonly string[];
  const removedPosts = new Set<string>();
  const withheldPosts = new Set<string>();
  // 3f: a disable_by_order in force that keeps the post from its author too; one that does not counts as a removal.
  const disabledPosts = new Set<string>();
  const removedImages = new Set<string>();
  const withheldImages = new Set<string>();
  const sealsInForce = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; kind: string; post_id: string | null; media_id: string | null; decision_kind: string; case_open: boolean; suspect_open: boolean; reversed: boolean; withhold_author: boolean | null }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select a.id, a.kind::text as kind, a.post_id, a.media_id, d.kind::text as decision_kind, c.closed_at is null as case_open, a.withhold_author,
                 exists (select 1 from intake_items i where i.case_id = d.case_id and i.suspect and i.answered_by is null and i.created_at <= d.decided_at) as suspect_open,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as reversed
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
           where a.kind::text = any(${textArray(measures)}) and ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`a.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by a.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const m of page) {
      // In force: no row reverses it, and a measure taken while deciding lasts while its case is open, a seal taken while
      // deciding while its case holds an unanswered suspect item that arrived no later than it.
      const inForce = !m.reversed && (m.decision_kind !== "interim" || (m.kind === "seal_media" ? m.suspect_open : m.case_open));
      if (!inForce) continue;
      if (m.kind === "remove" && m.post_id) removedPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "disable_by_order" && m.post_id) (m.withhold_author ? disabledPosts : removedPosts).add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold" && m.post_id) withheldPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "remove_media" && m.media_id) removedImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold_media" && m.media_id) withheldImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "seal_media") sealsInForce.add(m.id);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  // The posts each seal in force lists, with the image rows it recorded for each.
  const listed: { actionId: string; postId: string; images: number }[] = [];
  const sealedPosts = new Set<string>();
  if (sealsInForce.size > 0) {
    const found = await rowsOf<{ action_id: string; post_id: string; images: number }>(q, sql`select action_id, post_id, images::int as images from seal_posts where action_id = any(${uuidArray([...sealsInForce])}) order by action_id, post_id`);
    for (const row of found) {
      listed.push({ actionId: row.action_id, postId: row.post_id, images: row.images });
      sealedPosts.add(row.post_id);
    }
  }

  let posts = 0;
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; state: string; level: string; erased: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select id, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`id > ${after}::uuid`} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const post of page) {
      posts++;
      const level =
        !post.erased && disabledPosts.has(post.id) ? "disabled" : post.erased || removedPosts.has(post.id) || disabledPosts.has(post.id) ? "removed" : withheldPosts.has(post.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (post.level !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its level is stored as ${post.level}, and the ledger of measures gives ${level}`);
      // The state mirrors the level unless the author deleted the post, which is terminal.
      else if (post.state !== "deleted_by_author" && post.state !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its state is stored as ${post.state}, and its level is ${level}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  let images = 0;
  const imagesOn = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page = await imageModerationStates(q as Db, after, PAGE);
    for (const image of page) {
      images++;
      if (sealedPosts.has(image.postId)) imagesOn.set(image.postId, (imagesOn.get(image.postId) ?? 0) + 1);
      const state = sealedPosts.has(image.postId) ? "sealed" : image.erasedAt !== null || removedImages.has(image.id) ? "removed" : withheldImages.has(image.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (image.moderationState !== state) problem("image", image.id, `its state is stored as ${image.moderationState}, and the ledger of measures gives ${state}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const row of listed) {
    const now = imagesOn.get(row.postId) ?? 0;
    if (now !== row.images) problem("seal", row.actionId, `it lists post ${row.postId} with ${row.images} image ${row.images === 1 ? "row" : "rows"}, and the post has ${now} now`);
  }

  // ---- 4. 3f (section 8.11): an order's item and its measure name each other; every console event has its audit row.
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string; order_id: string; message: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select i.id, i.order_id, 'it is recorded as disabled, and no measure of an order decision names it' as message
          from legal_order_items i where i.disabled_at is not null
           and not exists (select 1 from decisions d join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id where d.order_item_id = i.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order')
           -- 3f Task 6: an item whose disabling a restore lost holds its first disabling's time from the import, and no
           -- measure until a person takes it again (or an admin finds it not needed); its gap is the record of that.
           and not exists (select 1 from restore_gaps g where g.class = 'order_effect' and g.target_type = 'order_item' and g.target_id = i.id::text)
        union all
        select i.id, i.order_id, 'a measure in force names it, and the item names another measure' as message
          from legal_order_items i join decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order'
         where exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.id = a.id) and i.action_id is distinct from a.id`,
  )) {
    problem("order", row.order_id, `item ${row.id}: ${row.message}`);
  }
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string; order_id: string; kind: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select e.id, e.order_id, e.kind from legal_order_events e
         where e.via = 'console' and e.kind not in ('opened', 'effect_given', 'reinstated')
           and not exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action in ('order_event_recorded', 'order_corrected') and l.target_id = e.order_id::text and l.metadata ->> 'eventId' = e.id::text)`,
  )) {
    problem("order", row.order_id, `its ${row.kind} event ${row.id} has no audit row`);
  }
  // ---- 5. 3f Task 6 (sections 6.6 and 8.11): every gap closed as not needed has its confirmed audit row gap_closed.
  for (const row of await rowsOf<{ id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select g.id from restore_gaps g
         where g.disposition = 'not_needed'
           and not exists (select 1 from audit_log l where l.action = 'gap_closed' and l.target_type = 'restore_gap' and l.target_id = g.id::text and l.step_up is not null)`,
  )) {
    problem("gap", row.id, "it is closed as not needed, and no confirmed audit row gap_closed names it");
  }
  // ---- 6. 3d Task 2 (sections 6.2 and 8.10): a released post holds no image row that is not erased. The release and its
  // replay erase every row of their posts in their own transactions, so such a row is a write made around them. The
  // media module's index reads it, since no file outside it names the image table. (A quarantined file without an image
  // row or a release is reported by quarantine-list, which reads the quarantine as the migrator: this command reads on
  // the API's role, which holds no right on quarantine_files.)
  for (const row of await releasedUnerased(q as DbTx)) {
    problem("post", row.postId, `it is released and still holds ${row.images} image ${row.images === 1 ? "row" : "rows"} that ${row.images === 1 ? "is" : "are"} not erased`);
  }

  return { ok: problemCount === 0, auditRows, decisions, posts, images, seals: sealsInForce.size, problems, problemCount };
}

/** text-verify on the command line's own connection: one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, so every check reads one state of the database. */
export function textVerifyOn(apiDb: Db): Promise<TextReport> {
  return apiDb.transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      return textVerify(tx);
    },
    { isolationLevel: "repeatable read", accessMode: "read only" },
  );
}

/** How text-verify reports: what holds, or the first problems. */
export function describeTextReport(report: TextReport): string[] {
  const counted = `${report.auditRows} confirmed rows, ${report.decisions} decisions, ${report.posts} posts, ${report.images} images and ${report.seals} seals in force`;
  if (report.ok) return [`text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: ${counted}`];
  const shown = report.problems.slice(0, 20);
  const lines = [`text-verify: FAILED, ${report.problemCount} ${report.problemCount === 1 ? "problem" : "problems"} in ${counted}; the first:`];
  for (const p of shown) lines.push(`  ${p.about === "audit" ? "place" : p.about} ${p.id}: ${p.message}`);
  if (report.problemCount > shown.length) lines.push(`  and ${report.problemCount - shown.length} more`);
  return lines;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line (3a design, section 7). Run on the server only. enroll runs in the migrate service, as the
 * migrator, the one application role the running API never holds; the others run like grant-role:
 *
 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm migrate node dist/staff.js enroll <email>
 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js keys [<email>]

 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js release-show <release>

 *
 * The commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13) do their work in staff-cases.ts. link and unlink record a
 * staff member's personal accounts for the recusal check and limits sets the limits on staff, each as the migrator, in
 * the migrate service; 3f's notification-facts (cli/records.ts) replaces account-facts. text-verify holds what the record

 * `all` every key and staff session of the account and its unused enrolment links, and mails the owner; it is the only way

 * audit-head prints the audit log's newest place and hash, which the keeper holds off the server. audit-verify recomputes
 * the whole chain in its own code (the staff module's chain.ts), never asking the database for a text or a hash, since
 * whoever owns the database can replace its functions, and checks it against the places kept before: a rewrite that
 * recomputed every later hash still fails against a place kept before it. It also checks every step-up a row stores
 * against the public key, owner, origin and relying party ID of the key it names, so a confirmed action is in the record

import { auditHead, auditLog, authEvents, closeDb, createDb, profiles, staffEnrollments, staffKeys, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, createAuthRepo, notifierContactsFor, revokeStaffKeys, verifyRecordedAssertion, type StaffKeysRevokedReport } from "../auth";

export type StaffCommand =
```
